views.name: v_recon_matches_consolidated
views.definition:
SELECT id AS match_id,
    tenant_id,
    run_id,
    match_key,
    rule_id,
    cardinality,
    confidence,
    score,
    created_at,
    members -> 'A'::text AS side_a,
    members -> 'B'::text AS side_b,
    members -> 'C'::text AS side_c,
    jsonb_build_object('amount_delta', COALESCE((((members -> 'A'::text) ->> 'amount'::text)::numeric) - (((members -> 'B'::text) ->> 'amount'::text)::numeric), 0::numeric), 'has_diff', ((members -> 'A'::text) ->> 'amount'::text) IS DISTINCT FROM ((members -> 'B'::text) ->> 'amount'::text)) AS deltas
   FROM recon_matches m;

views.name: v_substantiation_status
views.definition:
SELECT id,
    tenant_id,
    signoff_id,
    account_code,
    account_name,
    currency,
    gl_balance,
    sub_ledger_balance,
    variance,
    tolerance,
    status,
    evidence,
    note,
    prepared_by,
    prepared_at,
    approved_by,
    approved_at,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    gl_source,
    recon_id,
    recon_run_id,
    ageing_buckets,
    supporting_items,
    variance_explanation,
    variance_category,
    reviewer_id,
    reviewed_at,
    last_recon_status,
    last_recon_at,
        CASE
            WHEN abs(COALESCE(variance, 0::numeric)) <= COALESCE(tolerance, 0::numeric) THEN 'green'::text
            WHEN abs(COALESCE(variance, 0::numeric)) <= (COALESCE(tolerance, 0::numeric) * 3::numeric) THEN 'amber'::text
            ELSE 'red'::text
        END AS traffic_light
   FROM balance_substantiations b;

views.name: v_schedule_priority_queue
views.definition:
SELECT s.id,
    s.tenant_id,
    s.definition_id,
    s.name,
    s.cron_expression,
    s.enabled,
    s.last_run_at,
    s.last_status,
    s.last_run_id,
    s.last_error,
    s.created_by,
    s.created_at,
    s.updated_at,
    s.mode,
    s.poll_interval_seconds,
    s.watermark_column,
    s.watermark_value,
    s.intraday_window_minutes,
    s.risk_score,
    s.risk_tier,
    s.priority_boost,
    s.value_threshold,
    s.volatility_30d,
    s.last_risk_eval_at,
    d.name AS recon_name,
    d.tenant_id AS recon_tenant_id
   FROM recon_schedules s
     JOIN recon_definitions d ON d.id = s.definition_id
  WHERE s.enabled = true
  ORDER BY (s.risk_score + s.priority_boost::numeric) DESC NULLS LAST, s.last_run_at NULLS FIRST;

views.name: tenant_custom_domains_public

SELECT host,

   FROM tenant_custom_domains
  WHERE verification_status = 'verified'::text;

views.name: tenant_scoped_tables_audit
views.definition:
SELECT c.relname AS table_name,
    c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled,
    c.relforcerowsecurity AS rls_forced,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM pg_policies p
          WHERE p.schemaname = 'public'::name AND p.tablename = c.relname) AS policy_count
   FROM pg_class c
     JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
     JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid
  WHERE n.nspname = 'public'::name AND c.relkind = 'r'::"char" AND a.attname = 'tenant_id'::name AND NOT a.attisdropped;

views.name: v_mkt_certification_report
views.definition:
SELECT t.id,
    t.slug,
    t.title,
    c.name AS category,
    t.domain_key,
    t.pack_type::text AS pack_type,
    t.certification::text AS certification,
    t.spec_valid,
    t.certification_score,
    t.recon_score,
    t.ai_score,
    t.governance_score,
    t.refactor_gaps,
    t.removal_reason,
    t.install_count,
    t.updated_at
   FROM mkt_templates t
     LEFT JOIN mkt_template_categories c ON c.id = t.category_id;

views.name: v_marketplace_ratings_unified
views.definition:
SELECT mr.id,
    mr.listing_id,
    mr.tenant_id,
    mr.user_id,
    mr.rating AS stars,
    mr.review,
    mr.created_at,
    'canonical'::text AS source
   FROM marketplace_ratings mr
UNION ALL
 SELECT mtr.id,
    ml.id AS listing_id,
    mtr.tenant_id,
    mtr.user_id,
    mtr.stars,
    mtr.review,
    mtr.created_at,
    'legacy_mkt'::text AS source
   FROM mkt_template_ratings mtr
     JOIN marketplace_listings ml ON ml.legacy_mkt_template_id = mtr.template_id;

views.name: v_marketplace_analytics
views.definition:
SELECT ml.id AS listing_id,
    ml.slug,
    ml.title,
    ml.kind,
    ml.tier,
    ml.channel,
    ml.status,
    ml.install_count,
    count(DISTINCT mi.tenant_id) AS installed_tenants,
    count(DISTINCT wtu.workspace_id) AS active_workspaces,
    count(wtu.id) AS usage_events,
    COALESCE(avg(vru.stars)::numeric(3,2), NULL::numeric) AS rating_avg,
    count(vru.id) AS rating_count,
    max(mi.installed_at) AS last_installed_at,
    max(wtu.created_at) AS last_used_at
   FROM marketplace_listings ml
     LEFT JOIN marketplace_installs mi ON mi.listing_id = ml.id
     LEFT JOIN tenant_templates tt ON tt.source_template_id = ml.legacy_mkt_template_id
     LEFT JOIN workspace_template_usage wtu ON wtu.tenant_template_id = tt.id
     LEFT JOIN v_marketplace_ratings_unified vru ON vru.listing_id = ml.id
  GROUP BY ml.id, ml.slug, ml.title, ml.kind, ml.tier, ml.channel, ml.status, ml.install_count;

functions.name: recon_result_missing_sides
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.recon_result_missing_sides(_payload jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(side ORDER BY side),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT side FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(_payload->'missing_sides')='array' AND jsonb_array_length(_payload->'missing_sides')>0 THEN _payload->'missing_sides'
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(_payload->'missing_side')='string' AND length(_payload->>'missing_side')>0 THEN jsonb_build_array(_payload->'missing_side')
      ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) sides(side)
  ) normalized
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.governance_review_snapshot(_tenant uuid, _subject uuid, _group uuid, _workspace uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE g public.tenant_groups%ROWTYPE; m public.tenant_group_members%ROWTYPE;
 s public.tenant_members%ROWTYPE; w public.workspaces%ROWTYPE; rights jsonb; grants jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO s FROM public.tenant_members WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND user_id=_subject AND active;
 SELECT * INTO g FROM public.tenant_groups WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND id=_group;
 SELECT * INTO m FROM public.tenant_group_members WHERE group_id=_group AND user_id=_subject;
 IF s.id IS NULL OR g.id IS NULL OR m.user_id IS NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current scoped membership missing' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments a JOIN public.business_units b ON b.id=a.bu_id AND b.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
   WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant AND a.group_id=_group AND NOT b.is_archived)
   AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units b WHERE b.id=g.bu_id AND b.tenant_id=_tenant AND NOT b.is_archived) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current group business-unit association missing' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
 IF _workspace IS NOT NULL THEN
   SELECT * INTO w FROM public.workspaces WHERE id=_workspace AND tenant_id=_tenant AND status='active';
   IF w.id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=w.id AND tenant_id=_tenant AND user_id=_subject)
     OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units target WHERE target.id=w.business_unit_id AND target.tenant_id=_tenant AND NOT target.is_archived
       AND (target.id=g.bu_id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments a JOIN public.business_units assigned ON assigned.id=a.bu_id AND assigned.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
         WHERE a.group_id=_group AND a.tenant_id=_tenant AND NOT assigned.is_archived
           AND (a.bu_id=target.id OR (a.inherit_descendants AND target.path OPERATOR(public.<@) assigned.path))))) THEN
     RAISE EXCEPTION 'Workspace context is not an actual scoped membership' USING ERRCODE='PT409'; END IF;
 END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(permission_id ORDER BY permission_id),'[]') INTO rights FROM (
   SELECT DISTINCT rp.permission_id FROM public.tenant_group_roles gr
   JOIN public.rbac_role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id=gr.role_id WHERE gr.group_id=_group) p;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x ORDER BY x::text),'[]') INTO grants FROM (
   SELECT jsonb_build_object('resource_type','reconciliation','resource_id',r.recon_id,'bu_id',r.bu_id,'action',r.action,
     'environment',d.environment,'workspace_id',to_jsonb(d)->>'workspace_id') x
     FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants r JOIN public.recon_definitions d ON d.id=r.recon_id AND d.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
     WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.principal_type='group' AND r.principal_id=_group
   UNION ALL
   SELECT jsonb_build_object('resource_type',reg.resource_type,'resource_id',reg.id,'bu_id',r.bu_id,'action',r.action,
     'environment',NULL,'workspace_id',NULL) FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants r
     JOIN public.data_resource_registry reg ON reg.id=r.registry_id AND reg.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
     WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.principal_type='group' AND r.principal_group_id=_group
   UNION ALL
   SELECT jsonb_build_object('resource_type',r.resource_type,'resource_id',r.resource_id,'bu_id',r.bu_id,'action',r.action,
     'environment',NULL,'workspace_id',NULL) FROM public.data_resource_bu_grants r
     WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.principal_type='group' AND r.principal_id=_group
 ) q;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('schema_version',1,'tenant_id',_tenant,'subject_user_id',_subject,'membership',to_jsonb(m),
  'tenant_membership',to_jsonb(s),'group',to_jsonb(g),'workspace',CASE WHEN w.id IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('id',w.id,'name',w.name,'business_unit_id',w.business_unit_id,'status',w.status) END,
  'workspace_membership',(SELECT to_jsonb(wm) FROM public.workspace_members wm WHERE wm.workspace_id=_workspace AND wm.tenant_id=_tenant AND wm.user_id=_subject),
  'group_roles',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(gr) ORDER BY gr.role_id),'[]') FROM public.tenant_group_roles gr WHERE gr.group_id=_group),
  'role_permissions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(rp) ORDER BY rp.role_id,rp.permission_id),'[]') FROM public.rbac_role_permissions rp WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_group_roles gr WHERE gr.group_id=_group AND gr.role_id=rp.role_id)),
  'business_units',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'name',b.name,'path',b.path,'is_archived',b.is_archived) ORDER BY b.id),'[]') FROM public.business_units b WHERE b.tenant_id=_tenant AND (b.id=g.bu_id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments a WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant AND a.group_id=_group AND a.bu_id=b.id) OR b.id=w.business_unit_id)),
  'bu_assignments',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.id),'[]') FROM public.bu_group_assignments a WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant AND a.group_id=_group),
  'grant_preimages',jsonb_build_object(
    'reconciliation',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.id),'[]') FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants r WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.principal_type='group' AND r.principal_id=_group),
    'data_registry',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.id),'[]') FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants r WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.principal_type='group' AND r.principal_group_id=_group),
    'data_legacy',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.id),'[]') FROM public.data_resource_bu_grants r WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.principal_type='group' AND r.principal_id=_group)),
  'resource_grants',grants,'current_rights',rights||(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(label ORDER BY label),'[]') FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT (r->>'resource_type')||':'||(r->>'resource_id')||':'||(r->>'action') label FROM jsonb_array_elements(grants) r) all_resource_rights),
  'effective_permissions',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.permission_id,p.source,p.role_id,p.group_id,p.bu_id),'[]') FROM public.effective_user_permissions(_subject,_tenant,NULL) p));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpdi_public_dataset_current(_tenant uuid, _dataset uuid, _actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE d public.data_prep_prepared_datasets%ROWTYPE;link private.dpdi_public_output_links%ROWTYPE;published private.dpdi_published_datasets%ROWTYPE;j private.dpdi_jobs%ROWTYPE;e private.dpdi_job_events%ROWTYPE;cfg public.data_prep_configuration_revisions%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO d FROM public.data_prep_prepared_datasets WHERE id=_dataset AND tenant_id=_tenant;SELECT * INTO link FROM private.dpdi_public_output_links WHERE dataset_id=d.id;SELECT * INTO published FROM private.dpdi_published_datasets WHERE id=link.private_dataset_id;SELECT * INTO j FROM private.dpdi_jobs WHERE id=published.job_id;SELECT * INTO cfg FROM public.data_prep_configuration_revisions WHERE id=published.configuration_id;e:=private.dpdi_head(j.id);
 RETURN d.id IS NOT NULL AND j.snapshot->>'mode'='prepare' AND j.snapshot->>'approval_origin'='dpdi_setup_review_v1' AND e.phase='success' AND e.blocking_records=0 AND cfg.payload_sha256=j.snapshot->>'configuration_sha256' AND d.upload_id=link.upload_id AND d.run_id=j.reserved_run_id AND d.rows=e.source_records AND d.business_date=published.business_date
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.dpdi_setup_review_decisions sd JOIN private.dpdi_setup_review_requests sr ON sr.id=sd.request_id WHERE sd.id=(j.snapshot->>'setup_review_decision_id')::uuid AND sd.decision='approved' AND sd.decided_by<>sr.requested_by AND sr.setup_id=j.setup_id AND sr.draft_version=j.draft_version)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.dpdi_publication_decisions pd JOIN private.dpdi_publication_requests pr ON pr.id=pd.request_id WHERE pd.id=published.publication_decision_id AND pd.decision='approved' AND pd.decided_by<>pr.requested_by AND pr.job_id=j.id AND pd.output_root_sha256=e.output_root_sha256)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_pipelines p WHERE p.id=d.pipeline_id AND p.tenant_id=_tenant AND p.version=d.pipeline_version AND p.status='approved' AND p.lifecycle_state='production' AND p.output_data_source_id=d.data_source_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_approved_configurations ac WHERE ac.tenant_id=_tenant AND ac.pipeline_id=d.pipeline_id AND ac.pipeline_version=d.pipeline_version AND ac.configuration_id=published.configuration_id AND ac.approved_by<>j.actor_id)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace_data_source_uploads u WHERE u.id=link.upload_id AND u.tenant_id=_tenant AND u.data_source_id=d.data_source_id AND u.content_sha256=d.content_sha256 AND u.row_count=d.rows AND jsonb_typeof(u.rows)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(u.rows)=d.rows AND private.dpw_hash(u.rows)=d.content_sha256)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_delivery_runs r WHERE r.id=d.run_id AND r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.pipeline_version=d.pipeline_version AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND r.state='success' AND private.dpw_hash(r.result)=r.result_sha256 AND r.result->>'job_id'=j.id::text AND r.result->>'structured_data_sha256'=e.output_root_sha256)
 AND private.data_prep_pipeline_scope_allows(_actor,_tenant,d.pipeline_id,'view') IS TRUE AND private.dpw_source_allows(_actor,_tenant,d.data_source_id,'view') IS TRUE
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.dpdi_run_inputs i WHERE i.job_id=j.id AND (NOT private.dpd_original_viewable(i.original_file_id) OR private.dpw_source_allows(_actor,_tenant,i.data_source_id,'view') IS DISTINCT FROM true));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_guard_data_prep_lifecycle()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF current_setting('app.data_prep_lifecycle', true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'on'
     AND (
       (NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status AND NEW.status IN ('approved','archived'))
       OR NEW.lifecycle_state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.lifecycle_state
       OR NEW.promotion_status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.promotion_status
       OR NEW.promotion_requested_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.promotion_requested_by
       OR NEW.promotion_requested_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.promotion_requested_at
       OR NEW.promoted_from_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.promoted_from_id
       OR NEW.promoted_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.promoted_at
       OR NEW.promoted_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.promoted_by
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Use the governed Data Prep lifecycle functions';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpw_account_actor(_tenant uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=auth.uid(); claims jsonb:=auth.jwt();
BEGIN
 IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR actor IS NULL
 OR public.rlnext_actor_allowed() IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR private.dpw_native_factor_attest(actor,_tenant,claims->>'aal',to_timestamp((claims->>'exp')::double precision)) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.account_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND user_id=actor AND active)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.membership_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN actor;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pgmq.read(queue_name text, vt integer, qty integer, conditional jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS SETOF pgmq.message_record
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    sql TEXT;
    qtable TEXT := pgmq.format_table_name(queue_name, 'q');
BEGIN
    sql := FORMAT(
        $QUERY$
        WITH cte AS
        (
            SELECT msg_id
            FROM pgmq.%I
            WHERE vt <= clock_timestamp() AND CASE
                WHEN %L != '{}'::jsonb THEN (message @> %2$L)::integer
                ELSE 1
            END = 1
            ORDER BY msg_id ASC
            LIMIT $1
            FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
        )
        UPDATE pgmq.%I m
        SET
            vt = clock_timestamp() + %L,
            read_ct = read_ct + 1
        FROM cte
        WHERE m.msg_id = cte.msg_id
        RETURNING m.msg_id, m.read_ct, m.enqueued_at, m.vt, m.message, m.headers;
        $QUERY$,
        qtable, conditional, qtable, make_interval(secs => vt)
    );
    RETURN QUERY EXECUTE sql USING qty;
END;
$function$

functions.name: metrics
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION pgmq.metrics(queue_name text)
 RETURNS pgmq.metrics_result
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    result_row pgmq.metrics_result;
    query TEXT;
    qtable TEXT := pgmq.format_table_name(queue_name, 'q');
BEGIN
    query := FORMAT(
        $QUERY$
        WITH q_summary AS (
            SELECT
                count(*) as queue_length,
                count(CASE WHEN vt <= NOW() THEN 1 END) as queue_visible_length,
                EXTRACT(epoch FROM (NOW() - max(enqueued_at)))::int as newest_msg_age_sec,
                EXTRACT(epoch FROM (NOW() - min(enqueued_at)))::int as oldest_msg_age_sec,
                NOW() as scrape_time
            FROM pgmq.%I
        ),
        all_metrics AS (
            SELECT CASE
                WHEN is_called THEN last_value ELSE 0
                END as total_messages
            FROM pgmq.%I
        )
        SELECT
            %L as queue_name,
            q_summary.queue_length,
            q_summary.newest_msg_age_sec,
            q_summary.oldest_msg_age_sec,
            all_metrics.total_messages,
            q_summary.scrape_time,
            q_summary.queue_visible_length
        FROM q_summary, all_metrics
        $QUERY$,
        qtable, qtable || '_msg_id_seq', queue_name
    );
    EXECUTE query INTO result_row;
    RETURN result_row;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpw_guard_batch()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'state')
 OR NOT((OLD.state='collecting' AND NEW.state='processing') OR (OLD.state='processing' AND NEW.state IN('prepared','failed'))
 OR (OLD.state='prepared' AND NEW.state='published')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.immutable_delivery_binding'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpw_guard_file()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR OLD.state<>'uploading' OR NEW.state<>'received' OR NEW.upload_id IS NULL OR NEW.received_at IS NULL
 OR NEW.structured_rows_sha256 IS NULL
 OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','upload_id','received_at','structured_rows_sha256']) IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','upload_id','received_at','structured_rows_sha256'])
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.immutable_input_intent' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: dpw_guard_pipeline
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpw_guard_pipeline()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE stage public.data_prep_pipelines%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF NEW.version=OLD.version+1 AND NEW.status='approved' AND NEW.promoted_from_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.promoted_from_id THEN
  SELECT * INTO stage FROM public.data_prep_pipelines WHERE id=NEW.promoted_from_id AND tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
  AND parent_pipeline_id=OLD.id AND lifecycle_state='staging' AND promotion_status='pending';
  IF FOUND AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.dpw_configuration_heads WHERE pipeline_id=stage.id) THEN
   -- The original body promotes steps/DQ. Add the same staged source/output
   -- configuration so an explicitly changed output source is never discarded.
   NEW.source_data_source_id:=stage.source_data_source_id;
   NEW.output_data_source_id:=coalesce(stage.output_data_source_id,OLD.output_data_source_id);
  END IF;
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.dpw_configuration_heads WHERE pipeline_id=OLD.id) AND OLD.status='approved'
 AND (NEW.name,NEW.description,NEW.source_data_source_id,NEW.output_data_source_id,NEW.steps,NEW.dq_rules,NEW.on_failure,NEW.version)
 IS DISTINCT FROM (OLD.name,OLD.description,OLD.source_data_source_id,OLD.output_data_source_id,OLD.steps,OLD.dq_rules,OLD.on_failure,OLD.version)
 AND NOT(NEW.version=OLD.version+1 AND NEW.status='approved' AND NEW.promoted_from_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.promoted_from_id
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_pipelines s WHERE s.id=NEW.promoted_from_id AND s.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
 AND s.parent_pipeline_id=OLD.id AND s.lifecycle_state='staging' AND s.promotion_status='pending'
 AND s.steps=NEW.steps AND s.dq_rules=NEW.dq_rules AND s.on_failure=NEW.on_failure))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.approved_configuration_immutable_use_staging' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_delivery_files WHERE upload_id=OLD.id)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_prepared_datasets WHERE upload_id=OLD.id)

functions.name: dpw_list_pipelines
functions.identity: _tenant_id uuid, _search text, _status text, _page integer, _page_size integer, _updated_from timestamp with time zone, _updated_through timestamp with time zone, _bu_id uuid
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dpw_list_pipelines(_tenant_id uuid, _search text DEFAULT NULL::text, _status text DEFAULT NULL::text, _page integer DEFAULT 1, _page_size integer DEFAULT 50, _updated_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, _updated_through timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, _bu_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=private.dpw_actor(_tenant_id); off integer:=private.dpw_page(_page,_page_size); result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF _status IS NOT NULL AND _status NOT IN('draft','approved','archived') OR length(coalesce(_search,''))>200 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.invalid_filter'; END IF;
 IF _updated_from IS NOT NULL AND _updated_through IS NOT NULL AND _updated_from>_updated_through THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.invalid_updated_period'; END IF;
 IF _bu_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units WHERE id=_bu_id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id AND NOT is_archived) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.current_bu_scope_denied'; END IF;
 WITH scoped AS (SELECT p.* FROM public.data_prep_pipelines p WHERE p.tenant_id=_tenant_id
 AND private.data_prep_pipeline_scope_allows(actor,_tenant_id,p.id,'view') IS TRUE
 AND (_bu_id IS NULL OR p.bu_id=_bu_id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_resource_registry r JOIN public.data_resource_registry_owner_bu owner ON owner.registry_id=r.id
 WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND r.data_prep_pipeline_id=p.id AND owner.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND owner.bu_id=_bu_id))),
 filtered AS (SELECT p.* FROM scoped p WHERE (_status IS NULL OR p.status=_status)
 AND (_updated_from IS NULL OR p.updated_at>=_updated_from) AND (_updated_through IS NULL OR p.updated_at<_updated_through)
 AND (_search IS NULL OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',p.id::text,p.public_uid,p.name,p.description)),lower(_search))>0
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_input_profiles f JOIN private.dpw_configuration_heads h ON h.configuration_id=f.configuration_id
 WHERE h.pipeline_id=p.id AND strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',f.feed_key,f.name,f.vendor,f.layout_id)),lower(_search))>0)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_delivery_files f WHERE f.pipeline_id=p.id AND f.tenant_id=_tenant_id
 AND private.dpw_source_allows(actor,_tenant_id,f.data_source_id,'view') IS TRUE
 AND strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',f.id::text,f.content_sha256,f.descriptor->>'filename')),lower(_search))>0)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_delivery_batches b WHERE b.pipeline_id=p.id AND b.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',b.id::text,b.business_date::text)),lower(_search))>0)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_delivery_runs r WHERE r.pipeline_id=p.id AND r.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND strpos(lower(r.id::text),lower(_search))>0)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_runs r WHERE r.pipeline_id=p.id AND r.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',r.id::text,r.run_uid)),lower(_search))>0)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_prepared_datasets d WHERE d.pipeline_id=p.id AND d.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND private.dpw_source_allows(actor,_tenant_id,d.data_source_id,'view') IS TRUE
 AND strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',d.id::text,d.upload_id::text,d.content_sha256)),lower(_search))>0))),
 paged AS (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT _page_size OFFSET off)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('actor_id',actor,'tenant_id',_tenant_id,'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),'page',_page,'page_size',_page_size,
 'summary',jsonb_build_object('total',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),'approved',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered WHERE status='approved'),'draft',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered WHERE status='draft'),
 'archived',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered WHERE status='archived'),'attention',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered p WHERE (
 SELECT recent.state FROM (
 SELECT b.state,b.created_at at FROM public.data_prep_delivery_batches b WHERE b.pipeline_id=p.id AND b.tenant_id=_tenant_id
 UNION ALL SELECT r.state,coalesce(r.finished_at,r.started_at) FROM public.data_prep_delivery_runs r WHERE r.pipeline_id=p.id AND r.tenant_id=_tenant_id
 UNION ALL SELECT r.status,coalesce(r.finished_at,r.started_at) FROM public.data_prep_runs r WHERE r.pipeline_id=p.id AND r.tenant_id=_tenant_id
 ) recent ORDER BY recent.at DESC LIMIT 1) IN('failed','blocked')),
 'from',_updated_from,'through',_updated_through,'upper_boundary','exclusive','timezone','UTC','bu_id',_bu_id,
 'denominator_label','Authorized pipelines matching search, status, updated UTC period and current BU filters','denominator',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered)),
 'pipelines',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p)||jsonb_build_object('feeds',private.dpw_feeds(p.id,p.version),'latest_batch',
 (SELECT to_jsonb(b) FROM public.data_prep_delivery_batches b WHERE b.pipeline_id=p.id AND b.tenant_id=_tenant_id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC,b.id LIMIT 1))) FROM paged p),'[]'::jsonb)) INTO result;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_reference_data_version_for_execution_pre_scope(_tenant_id uuid, _table_id uuid, _as_of date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS TABLE(resolved_version_id uuid, resolved_version_number integer, resolved_content_sha256 text, resolved_rows jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  matches integer;
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.reference_data_tables
    WHERE id = _table_id AND tenant_id = _tenant_id
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reference table not found';
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*)::integer INTO matches
  FROM public.reference_data_versions rdv
  WHERE rdv.table_id = _table_id AND rdv.tenant_id = _tenant_id
    AND rdv.status IN ('published','superseded')
    AND rdv.effective_from <= _as_of
    AND (rdv.effective_to IS NULL OR rdv.effective_to >= _as_of);
  IF matches = 0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'No published reference version for requested date'; END IF;
  IF matches > 1 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Ambiguous published reference versions for requested date'; END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT rdv.id, rdv.version_number, rdv.content_sha256,
         coalesce(jsonb_agg(r.row_data ORDER BY r.key_hash), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM public.reference_data_versions rdv
  JOIN public.reference_data_version_rows r ON r.version_id = rdv.id
  WHERE rdv.table_id = _table_id AND rdv.tenant_id = _tenant_id
    AND rdv.status IN ('published','superseded')
    AND rdv.effective_from <= _as_of
    AND (rdv.effective_to IS NULL OR rdv.effective_to >= _as_of)
  GROUP BY rdv.id, rdv.version_number, rdv.content_sha256;
END;
$function$

functions.name: purge_expired_recon_runs
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.purge_expired_recon_runs()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_count int := 0; r record;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN SELECT id, run_retention_days FROM public.tenants LOOP
    WITH del AS (
      DELETE FROM public.recon_runs
      WHERE tenant_id = r.id
        AND started_at < now() - make_interval(days => GREATEST(r.run_retention_days,1))
      RETURNING 1
    ) SELECT v_count + count(*) INTO v_count FROM del;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN v_count;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.kb_build_body(_scope text, _slug text, _title text, _cat_slug text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  img text;
  topic text;
  scope_label text;
  body text;
BEGIN
  -- Map category slug to a hero image filename
  img := CASE
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('workspace-getting-started','workspace-overview') THEN 'hero-workspace.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('workspace-dashboard','workspace-reports','tenant-reporting') THEN 'hero-reports.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('workspace-ingestion-hub','workspace-file-uploads','workspace-file-watchers','workspace-data-prep','workspace-reference-data','workspace-data-lineage') THEN 'hero-data.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('workspace-connections','tenant-channels','tenant-connectors','tenant-api-migration-chat','plat-github-sync') THEN 'hero-integrations.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('workspace-aidp','workspace-agent','tenant-ai-governance','tenant-ai-llm','tenant-ai-usage','plat-ai-gov','plat-llm') THEN 'hero-ai.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('workspace-rekon-studio','workspace-rekon-orchestrator','workspace-run-history','workspace-template-gallery','workspace-collateral-csa') THEN 'hero-rekon.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('workspace-exceptions','workspace-break-manager','workspace-proposed-matches','workspace-ageing') THEN 'hero-exceptions.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('workspace-regulatory-packs','workspace-manual-match-approvals','workspace-eod-sign-off','tenant-governance','plat-entitlements','plat-promotion') THEN 'hero-governance.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('workspace-audit','tenant-sso','tenant-scim','plat-rbac','plat-audit','plat-break-glass','plat-secrets') THEN 'hero-security.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('workspace-tickets','workspace-knowledge','tenant-tickets-knowledge','plat-kb-esc') THEN 'hero-support.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('tenant-settings','tenant-members','tenant-groups','tenant-business-units','tenant-features') THEN 'hero-tenant.jpg'
    WHEN _cat_slug IN ('plat-tenants','plat-families','plat-status-page') THEN 'hero-platform.jpg'
    ELSE 'hero-workspace.jpg'
  END;

  topic := initcap(replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(_cat_slug,''),'^(workspace|tenant|plat)-',''),'-',' '));

  scope_label := CASE
    WHEN _cat_slug LIKE 'plat-%' THEN 'Platform Administration'
    WHEN _cat_slug LIKE 'tenant-%' THEN 'Tenant Administration'
    ELSE 'Workspace'
  END;

  body := format($md$![%1$s](/kb/%2$s)

> **%1$s** — how it works in FVI, when to use it, and the exact steps to get value from it.

**Scope:** %3$s  ·  **Area:** %4$s  ·  **Estimated read:** 4 min

---

## Why this matters

**%1$s** is part of FVI's %3$s surface. Reconciliation teams use it to %5$s with full audit, RBAC, and 4-eyes safeguards. Mastering this screen shortens cycle time, reduces operational risk, and gives your auditors a clean evidentiary trail.

## Who this is for

- **Operators** running daily reconciliations and managing breaks.
- **Team leads** monitoring SLAs and approving exceptions.
- **Admins** configuring controls, integrations and governance.

## Prerequisites

- An active FVI account with access to this %6$s area.
- The relevant role: **Member** to view, **Approver** for 4-eyes actions, **Admin** for configuration.
- Any upstream data (sources, reference tables, mappings) already provisioned.

## Step-by-step

1. **Locate the feature.** Navigate to the **%4$s** area in the left rail and open **%1$s**.
2. **Review prerequisites.** Confirm you have the required role and that any upstream data is in place.
3. **Configure inputs.** Fill the form — required fields are marked with a red dot. Hover the (?) icon for inline help.
4. **Preview before commit.** Use the **Preview** button (where available) to validate against a sample before saving.
5. **Save and run.** Click **Save** — the change is versioned. For runnable features click **Run** to execute on demand.
6. **Verify outcomes.** Check the **Activity** or **Run History** panel for status, duration and produced artefacts.
7. **Audit trail.** Every change is recorded in `audit_log` with actor, before/after and hash-chained for tamper evidence.

## Screenshots & where to click

The hero image at the top of this article shows the typical layout for this screen:

- The **left rail** is your navigation between areas.
- The **top bar** carries scope switcher, Copilot, Themes, Tour and your profile.
- The **main canvas** holds the work area for %1$s.

## Tips & best practice

- Use **⌘K / Ctrl+K** to jump to this screen from anywhere.
- Tag your work — labels improve search and reporting later.
- For repeated tasks, schedule via **Rekon Orchestrator** instead of running manually.
- Enable **Copilot** (top-right) and ask "How do I use %1$s?" for an interactive walkthrough.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Button is greyed out | You lack the required role | Ask your tenant admin for the appropriate role |
| No data shown | Filters too narrow or data not yet ingested | Clear filters; check **Ingestion Hub → Run history** |
| Save fails with 403 | RLS blocked the write (wrong tenant or BU) | Confirm your Business Unit scope covers the record |
| Run errors | Mapping or rule mismatch | Open **Run history → run logs**; the line item shows the failing rule |

## Audit & compliance

Every change touching this screen writes a row into `audit_log` with `actor_user_id`, `before` and `after` payloads, and a `row_hash` chained to the previous row. Daily SHA-256 anchors in `audit_anchors` provide tamper-evidence suitable for SOC 2 and ISO 27001 evidence packs.

## Related articles

- **Workspace · Getting Started** — orient yourself in FVI
- **Workspace · Rekon Studio** — build reconciliations
- **Tenant · Governance** — controls and approvals
- **Platform · Audit** — chain verification

_Need help?_ Open **Support → New Ticket** from the top bar — your ticket routes to your tenant admins first, then escalates to platform support if needed.

    CASE WHEN scope_label = 'Workspace' THEN 'execute day-to-day reconciliation work' ELSE 'govern and oversee tenant operations' END,
    lower(scope_label)
  );

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpw_native_factor_attest(_actor uuid, _tenant uuid, _aal text, _expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE security public.tenant_security_settings%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF _actor IS NULL OR _tenant IS NULL OR _aal IS NULL OR _aal NOT IN('aal1','aal2')
 OR _expires_at IS NULL OR _expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id=_actor)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id=_actor AND u.banned_until>clock_timestamp())
 OR private.rlnext_account_allowed(_actor,NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR private.rlnext_account_allowed(_actor,_tenant) IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO security FROM public.tenant_security_settings WHERE tenant_id=_tenant;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF (security.mfa_required OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.rlnext_accounts a
 WHERE a.user_id=_actor AND a.mfa_required)) AND (_aal IS DISTINCT FROM 'aal2'
 OR private.rlnext_has_verified_mfa(_actor) IS DISTINCT FROM true) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- Managed MFA-required accounts are additionally checked by the unmodified
 -- native predicate for mfa_verified_at and the current verified TOTP factor.
 -- An unmanaged owner is not assigned a fictional rlnext row/factor history.
 RETURN true;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_aidp_outputs_block_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- Allow superseded_at to be set once (going from NULL to non-NULL); block everything else.
  IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'aidp_outputs is append-only'; END IF;
  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' THEN
    IF OLD.superseded_at IS NOT NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'aidp_outputs row already superseded'; END IF;
    IF NEW.id <> OLD.id OR NEW.value_text IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.value_text
       OR NEW.value_number IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.value_number
       OR NEW.value_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.value_date
       OR NEW.value_json IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.value_json
       OR NEW.confidence IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.confidence
       OR NEW.origin IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.origin THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'aidp_outputs is append-only; only superseded_at may be set';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.export_approved_environment_change_for_transport(_request_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  target public.environment_change_requests%ROWTYPE;
  requester_email text;
  approver_email text;
  payload jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO target FROM public.environment_change_requests WHERE id=_request_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR target.approval_stage<>'source_review' OR target.status<>'approved'
     OR target.decided_by IS DISTINCT FROM auth.uid() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only the source checker can transport an approved package';
  END IF;
  SELECT lower(email) INTO requester_email FROM auth.users WHERE id=target.requested_by;
  SELECT lower(email) INTO approver_email FROM auth.users WHERE id=target.decided_by;
  payload := jsonb_build_object(
    'upstream_change_request_uid',target.change_request_uid,
    'upstream_manifest_hash',target.manifest_hash,
    'source_request_status',target.status,
    'source_project_ref',target.source_project_ref,
    'source_tenant_id',target.source_tenant_id,
    'source_environment',target.source_environment,
    'target_project_ref',target.target_project_ref,
    'target_tenant_id',target.target_tenant_id,
    'target_environment',target.target_environment,
    'direction',target.direction,
    'title',target.title,
    'reason',target.reason,
    'manifest',target.manifest,
    'source_requester_email',requester_email,
    'source_approver_email',approver_email,
    'source_requester_email_hash',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(requester_email,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex'),
    'source_approver_email_hash',encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(approver_email,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  );
  PERFORM public.append_environment_change_event(_request_id,'package_exported',auth.uid(),
    jsonb_build_object('manifest_hash',target.manifest_hash,
      'upstream_change_request_uid',target.change_request_uid,
      'export_stage','payload_before_signing'));
  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(actor_user_id,tenant_id,scope,action,resource_type,resource_id,context)
  VALUES (auth.uid(),target.control_tenant_id,'tenant','environment_change.package_exported',
    'environment_change_request',_request_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('manifest_hash',target.manifest_hash,
      'upstream_change_request_uid',target.change_request_uid,
      'export_stage','payload_before_signing'));
  RETURN payload;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpw_snapshot(_pipeline uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE p public.data_prep_pipelines%ROWTYPE; cfg public.data_prep_configuration_revisions%ROWTYPE;

 SELECT * INTO p FROM public.data_prep_pipelines WHERE id=_pipeline;
 SELECT c.* INTO cfg FROM public.data_prep_configuration_revisions c JOIN private.dpw_configuration_heads h ON h.configuration_id=c.id
 WHERE h.pipeline_id=p.id AND c.pipeline_version=p.version;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('pipeline_id',p.id,'pipeline_version',p.version,'configuration_status',p.status,
 'configuration_id',cfg.id,'legacy_virtual',cfg.id IS NULL,'source_data_source_id',p.source_data_source_id,
 'output_data_source_id',p.output_data_source_id,'steps',p.steps,'dq_rules',p.dq_rules,'on_failure',p.on_failure,
 'business_fields',coalesce(cfg.payload->'business_fields','[]'::jsonb),'required_fields',coalesce(cfg.payload->'required_fields','[]'::jsonb),
 'policy',coalesce(cfg.payload->'policy',jsonb_build_object('allow_warn',false,'allow_drop_rows',false)),
 'feeds',private.dpw_feeds(p.id,p.version));
END $function$

functions.name: dpw_get_audit
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dpw_get_audit(_tenant_id uuid, _pipeline_id uuid, _batch_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _page integer DEFAULT 1, _page_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=private.dpw_authorize(_tenant_id,_pipeline_id,'view'); off integer:=private.dpw_page(_page,_page_size);
 events jsonb; total bigint;
BEGIN
 IF public.user_has_permission(actor,_tenant_id,'audit.log.read',NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.audit_read_permission_required'; END IF;
 IF _batch_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_delivery_batches WHERE id=_batch_id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id AND pipeline_id=_pipeline_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.audit_batch_scope_denied'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_delivery_files f WHERE f.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND f.pipeline_id=_pipeline_id AND (_batch_id IS NULL OR f.batch_id=_batch_id)
 AND private.dpw_source_allows(actor,_tenant_id,f.data_source_id,'view') IS DISTINCT FROM true) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.audit_source_read_denied'; END IF;
 WITH batches AS(SELECT * FROM public.data_prep_delivery_batches WHERE tenant_id=_tenant_id AND pipeline_id=_pipeline_id AND (_batch_id IS NULL OR id=_batch_id)),
 runs AS(SELECT r.* FROM public.data_prep_delivery_runs r JOIN batches b ON b.id=r.batch_id),
 files AS(SELECT f.* FROM public.data_prep_delivery_files f JOIN batches b ON b.id=f.batch_id),
 releases AS(SELECT q.* FROM public.data_prep_release_requests q JOIN batches b ON b.id=q.batch_id),
 exclusions AS(SELECT q.* FROM public.data_prep_exclusion_requests q JOIN batches b ON b.id=q.batch_id),
 chain AS(
 SELECT _pipeline_id::text id,NULL::uuid payload_run UNION SELECT id::text,NULL::uuid FROM batches
 UNION SELECT id::text,id FROM runs UNION SELECT f.id::text,i.run_id FROM files f LEFT JOIN public.data_prep_run_inputs i ON i.file_id=f.id
 UNION SELECT d.id::text,d.run_id FROM public.data_prep_prepared_datasets d JOIN batches b ON b.id=d.batch_id
 UNION SELECT id::text,run_id FROM releases UNION SELECT d.id::text,q.run_id FROM public.data_prep_release_decisions d JOIN releases q ON q.id=d.request_id
 UNION SELECT id::text,run_id FROM exclusions UNION SELECT d.id::text,q.run_id FROM public.data_prep_exclusion_decisions d JOIN exclusions q ON q.id=d.request_id
 UNION SELECT id::text,NULL::uuid FROM public.data_prep_configuration_revisions WHERE tenant_id=_tenant_id AND pipeline_id=_pipeline_id AND _batch_id IS NULL
 UNION SELECT id::text,NULL::uuid FROM public.data_prep_runs WHERE tenant_id=_tenant_id AND pipeline_id=_pipeline_id AND _batch_id IS NULL),
 selected AS(SELECT a.*,c.payload_run FROM public.audit_log a JOIN chain c ON c.id=a.resource_id
 WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND (a.action LIKE 'dpw.%' OR a.action LIKE 'data_prep.%')),
 paged AS(SELECT * FROM selected ORDER BY occurred_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT _page_size OFFSET off)
 SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM selected),coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('event_id',a.id::text,'occurred_at',a.occurred_at,
 'actor_id',a.actor_user_id,'actor_email',a.actor_email,'action',a.action,'resource_type',a.resource_type,'resource_id',a.resource_id,
 'context',CASE WHEN a.payload_run IS NULL OR private.dpw_run_payload_available(a.payload_run) THEN a.context ELSE private.dpw_redact_audit_context(a.context) END,
 'artifact_payload_available',CASE WHEN a.payload_run IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE private.dpw_run_payload_available(a.payload_run) END) ORDER BY a.occurred_at DESC,a.id DESC) FROM paged a),'[]'::jsonb)
 INTO total,events;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('actor_id',actor,'tenant_id',_tenant_id,'pipeline_id',_pipeline_id,'batch_id',_batch_id,'events',events,
 'audit_total',total,'page',_page,'page_size',_page_size,'evidence','recorded_native_events_no_external_anchor_verification_claim');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_start_data_prep_run(_tenant_id uuid, _pipeline_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor uuid:=auth.uid(); v_pipeline public.data_prep_pipelines%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR _pipeline_id IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members tm
      WHERE tm.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND tm.user_id=v_actor AND tm.active
        AND tm.role IN ('tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role,'tenant_analyst'::public.tenant_role))
  THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_pipeline FROM public.data_prep_pipelines
    WHERE id=_pipeline_id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id;
  IF NOT FOUND
    OR NOT private.registered_typed_resource_allows(v_actor,_tenant_id,'data_prep_pipeline',_pipeline_id,'view')
    OR NOT private.registered_typed_resource_allows(v_actor,_tenant_id,'data_prep_pipeline',_pipeline_id,'run')
    OR NOT private.registered_typed_resource_allows(v_actor,_tenant_id,'data_prep_pipeline',_pipeline_id,'edit')
  THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF v_pipeline.source_data_source_id IS NOT NULL AND (
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace_data_sources s
      WHERE s.id=v_pipeline.source_data_source_id AND s.tenant_id=_tenant_id)
    OR NOT private.registered_typed_resource_allows(v_actor,_tenant_id,'data_source',
      v_pipeline.source_data_source_id,'view'))
  THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  IF v_pipeline.output_data_source_id IS NOT NULL AND (
    NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace_data_sources s
      WHERE s.id=v_pipeline.output_data_source_id AND s.tenant_id=_tenant_id)
    OR NOT private.registered_typed_resource_allows(v_actor,_tenant_id,'data_source',
      v_pipeline.output_data_source_id,'ingest')
    OR NOT private.registered_typed_resource_allows(v_actor,_tenant_id,'data_source',
      v_pipeline.output_data_source_id,'edit')
    OR NOT private.registered_typed_resource_allows(v_actor,_tenant_id,'data_source',
      v_pipeline.output_data_source_id,'manage'))
  THEN RETURN false; END IF;
  RETURN true;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dpw_get_delivery(_tenant_id uuid, _pipeline_id uuid, _batch_id uuid, _page integer DEFAULT 1, _page_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=private.dpw_authorize(_tenant_id,_pipeline_id,'view'); b public.data_prep_delivery_batches%ROWTYPE;
 off integer:=private.dpw_page(_page,_page_size); files jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO b FROM public.data_prep_delivery_batches WHERE id=_batch_id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id AND pipeline_id=_pipeline_id;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.batch_not_found'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_delivery_files f WHERE f.batch_id=b.id AND private.dpw_source_allows(actor,_tenant_id,f.data_source_id,'view') IS DISTINCT FROM true)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.source_read_denied'; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f)||jsonb_build_object('rows_count',u.row_count,
 'columns',CASE WHEN private.dpw_attachment_viewable(f.id) THEN u.columns ELSE private.dpw_redact_columns(u.columns) END)
 ||jsonb_build_object('descriptor',CASE WHEN private.dpw_attachment_viewable(f.id) THEN f.descriptor ELSE private.dpw_redact_descriptor(f.descriptor) END,
 'payload_available',private.dpw_attachment_viewable(f.id),'retention',private.dpw_file_retention_metadata(f.id)) ORDER BY f.created_at,f.id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO files
 FROM public.data_prep_delivery_files f LEFT JOIN public.workspace_data_source_uploads u ON u.id=f.upload_id WHERE f.batch_id=b.id;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('actor_id',actor,'tenant_id',_tenant_id,'batch',to_jsonb(b),'files',files,
 'current_run_id',(SELECT id FROM public.data_prep_delivery_runs WHERE batch_id=b.id ORDER BY started_at DESC,id LIMIT 1),
 'correction_input_manifest',CASE WHEN b.correction_of IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE jsonb_build_object('batch_id',b.correction_of,
 'source_run_id',coalesce(b.configuration_snapshot->'exclusion_source_run_id',b.configuration_snapshot->'correction_source_run_id'),
 'files',coalesce(b.configuration_snapshot->'correction_source_files','[]'::jsonb),
 'available',jsonb_typeof(b.configuration_snapshot->'correction_source_files')='array',
 'origin',coalesce(b.configuration_snapshot->>'correction_manifest_origin','persisted_predecessor_binding')) END,
 'runs',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r)-'result') FROM public.data_prep_delivery_runs r WHERE r.batch_id=b.id),'[]'::jsonb),
 'datasets',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)) FROM public.data_prep_prepared_datasets d WHERE d.batch_id=b.id),'[]'::jsonb),
 'release_requests',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)) FROM public.data_prep_release_requests q WHERE q.batch_id=b.id),'[]'::jsonb),
 'release_decisions',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)) FROM public.data_prep_release_decisions d JOIN public.data_prep_release_requests q ON q.id=d.request_id WHERE q.batch_id=b.id),'[]'::jsonb),
 'exclusion_requests',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q)) FROM public.data_prep_exclusion_requests q WHERE q.batch_id=b.id),'[]'::jsonb),
 'exclusion_decisions',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(d)) FROM public.data_prep_exclusion_decisions d JOIN public.data_prep_exclusion_requests q ON q.id=d.request_id WHERE q.batch_id=b.id),'[]'::jsonb),
 'errors',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(CASE WHEN private.dpw_run_payload_available(x.run_id) THEN to_jsonb(x)
 ELSE (to_jsonb(x)-ARRAY['original_row','prepared_row','reasons'])||jsonb_build_object('payload_unavailable',true) END) FROM (SELECT e.* FROM public.data_prep_reject_lineage e JOIN public.data_prep_delivery_runs r ON r.id=e.run_id WHERE r.batch_id=b.id ORDER BY e.id LIMIT _page_size OFFSET off) x),'[]'::jsonb),
 'error_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.data_prep_reject_lineage e JOIN public.data_prep_delivery_runs r ON r.id=e.run_id WHERE r.batch_id=b.id),'page',_page,'page_size',_page_size);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dpw_get_pipeline(_tenant_id uuid, _pipeline_id uuid, _history_page integer DEFAULT 1, _history_page_size integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=private.dpw_authorize(_tenant_id,_pipeline_id,'view'); p public.data_prep_pipelines%ROWTYPE; history jsonb; cfg public.data_prep_configuration_revisions%ROWTYPE; owners jsonb;
 off integer:=private.dpw_page(_history_page,_history_page_size);
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO p FROM public.data_prep_pipelines WHERE id=_pipeline_id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id;
 SELECT c.* INTO cfg FROM public.data_prep_configuration_revisions c JOIN private.dpw_configuration_heads h ON h.configuration_id=c.id WHERE h.pipeline_id=p.id AND c.pipeline_version=p.version;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(owner.bu_id ORDER BY owner.bu_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO owners FROM public.data_resource_registry r JOIN public.data_resource_registry_owner_bu owner ON owner.registry_id=r.id AND owner.tenant_id=r.tenant_id WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND r.data_prep_pipeline_id=p.id;
 WITH historical AS (
 SELECT r.started_at,r.id,(to_jsonb(r)-'result')||jsonb_build_object('origin','reusable_delivery','original_lineage_state','persisted_native_inputs') AS item
 FROM public.data_prep_delivery_runs r WHERE r.pipeline_id=p.id AND r.tenant_id=_tenant_id
 UNION ALL
 SELECT r.started_at,r.id,jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'run_uid',r.run_uid,'status',r.status,'started_at',r.started_at,'finished_at',r.finished_at,
 'origin','legacy_data_prep_run','execution_protocol',r.execution_protocol,'recorded_rows_in',r.rows_in,'recorded_rows_out',r.rows_out,
 'count_evidence','recorded_legacy_not_reconstructed','native_configuration_snapshot',r.execution_snapshot,
 'original_lineage_state','not_captured','missing_originals',true)
 FROM public.data_prep_runs r WHERE r.pipeline_id=p.id AND r.tenant_id=_tenant_id)
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(x.item ORDER BY x.started_at DESC,x.id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO history FROM (
 SELECT * FROM historical ORDER BY started_at DESC,id LIMIT _history_page_size OFFSET off) x;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('actor_id',actor,'tenant_id',_tenant_id,'pipeline',to_jsonb(p),'feeds',private.dpw_feeds(p.id,p.version),
 'configuration',(coalesce(cfg.payload,'{}'::jsonb)-'_save_identity')||jsonb_build_object('configuration_id',cfg.id,'name',p.name,'description',p.description,'pipeline_version',p.version,
 'schema',coalesce(cfg.payload->'schema',jsonb_build_object('business_fields',cfg.payload->'business_fields','required_fields',cfg.payload->'required_fields')),
 'owning_business_unit_ids',owners,'policy',cfg.payload->'policy','feeds',private.dpw_feeds(p.id,p.version),'steps',p.steps,'dq_rules',p.dq_rules,'on_failure',p.on_failure,
 'source_data_source_id',p.source_data_source_id,'output_data_source_id',p.output_data_source_id,'origin',CASE WHEN cfg.id IS NULL THEN 'legacy_native_configuration' ELSE 'native_saved_revision' END),
 'batches',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)) FROM (SELECT * FROM public.data_prep_delivery_batches WHERE pipeline_id=p.id ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT 100) x),'[]'::jsonb),
 'batch_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.data_prep_delivery_batches WHERE pipeline_id=p.id),
 'runs',history,'history_page',_history_page,'history_page_size',_history_page_size,
 'new_delivery_run_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.data_prep_delivery_runs WHERE pipeline_id=p.id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id),
 'legacy_run_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.data_prep_runs WHERE pipeline_id=p.id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id),
 'run_total',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.data_prep_delivery_runs WHERE pipeline_id=p.id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id)+(SELECT count(*) FROM public.data_prep_runs WHERE pipeline_id=p.id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id));
END $function$

functions.name: reconcile_synthetic_environment_transport_once
functions.identity: _request_id uuid, _target_change_request_uid text, _target_manifest_hash text, _target_tenant_id uuid, _external_proof_sha256 text, _proof_verified_at timestamp with time zone, _corrective_actor_id uuid, _independent_checker_id uuid, _reason text
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reconcile_synthetic_environment_transport_once(_request_id uuid, _target_change_request_uid text, _target_manifest_hash text, _target_tenant_id uuid, _external_proof_sha256 text, _proof_verified_at timestamp with time zone, _corrective_actor_id uuid, _independent_checker_id uuid, _reason text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  source_row public.environment_change_requests%ROWTYPE;
  prior_setting text;
  eligible_count integer;
BEGIN
  IF to_regclass('public.environment_change_cutover_gate') IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transport reconciliation must precede importer pause';
  END IF;
  IF _target_change_request_uid IS NULL
     OR length(btrim(_target_change_request_uid)) NOT BETWEEN 8 AND 128
     OR _target_manifest_hash IS NULL OR _target_manifest_hash !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR _external_proof_sha256 IS NULL OR _external_proof_sha256 !~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'
     OR _proof_verified_at IS NULL
     OR _proof_verified_at > clock_timestamp()
     OR _proof_verified_at < clock_timestamp() - interval '2 minutes'
     OR length(btrim(coalesce(_reason,''))) NOT BETWEEN 20 AND 500 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Fresh, bounded target proof and reason are required';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO source_row FROM public.environment_change_requests
    WHERE id=_request_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR source_row.approval_stage<>'source_review'
     OR source_row.status<>'approved' OR source_row.transport_status<>'pending'
     OR source_row.target_change_request_uid IS NOT NULL
     OR source_row.source_project_ref<>'YOUR_PROJECT_REF'
     OR source_row.target_project_ref<>'YOUR_PROJECT_REF'
     OR source_row.direction<>'prod_to_dev'
     OR source_row.source_environment<>'prod'
     OR source_row.target_environment<>'dev'
     OR source_row.control_tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.source_tenant_id
     OR source_row.requested_at > clock_timestamp() - interval '14 days'
     OR source_row.requested_by IS NULL OR source_row.decided_by IS NULL
     OR source_row.requested_by=source_row.decided_by
     OR _target_manifest_hash IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.manifest_hash
     OR _target_tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM source_row.target_tenant_id
     OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenants t
       WHERE t.id=source_row.source_tenant_id
         AND t.slug::text='falcon-veritas-assurance-lab-prod') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Exact stale synthetic source transport is unavailable';
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO eligible_count
  FROM public.environment_change_requests r
  JOIN public.tenants t ON t.id=r.source_tenant_id
  WHERE t.slug::text='falcon-veritas-assurance-lab-prod'
    AND r.approval_stage='source_review' AND r.status='approved'
    AND r.transport_status='pending'
    AND r.source_project_ref='YOUR_PROJECT_REF'
    AND r.target_project_ref='YOUR_PROJECT_REF';
  IF eligible_count<>1
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.environment_change_events e
       WHERE e.request_id=_request_id AND e.event_type IN
         ('package_transmitted','transport_failed','transport_reconciled'))
     OR (SELECT e.event_type FROM public.environment_change_events e
       WHERE e.request_id=_request_id ORDER BY e.event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1) IS DISTINCT FROM 'approved' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Synthetic source is ambiguous or already transported';
  END IF;
  IF _corrective_actor_id IS NULL OR _independent_checker_id IS NULL
     OR _corrective_actor_id=_independent_checker_id
     OR _corrective_actor_id IN (source_row.requested_by,source_row.decided_by)
     OR _independent_checker_id IN (source_row.requested_by,source_row.decided_by) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Independent corrective administrators are required';
  END IF;
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM auth.users u
      WHERE u.id IN (_corrective_actor_id,_independent_checker_id)
        AND u.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL
        AND (u.banned_until IS NULL OR u.banned_until<=clock_timestamp())
        AND (
          EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m
            WHERE m.user_id=u.id AND m.tenant_id=source_row.control_tenant_id
              AND m.active AND m.role::text='tenant_admin')
          OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.platform_roles p
            WHERE p.user_id=u.id AND p.role::text='platform_admin')
        ))<>2 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Both corrective administrators must be active';
  END IF;
  PERFORM public.assert_environment_payload_safe(jsonb_build_object(
    'target_change_request_uid',_target_change_request_uid,'reason',_reason));
  prior_setting := current_setting('app.environment_change_lifecycle',true);
  PERFORM set_config('app.environment_change_lifecycle','on',true);
  UPDATE public.environment_change_requests
    SET transport_status='succeeded', transport_attempted_at=clock_timestamp(),
        target_change_request_uid=btrim(_target_change_request_uid)
    WHERE id=_request_id AND transport_status='pending';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Transport changed during reconciliation'; END IF;
  PERFORM set_config('app.environment_change_lifecycle',coalesce(prior_setting,''),true);
  PERFORM public.append_environment_change_event(_request_id,'transport_reconciled',
    _corrective_actor_id,jsonb_build_object(
      'target_change_request_uid',btrim(_target_change_request_uid),
      'target_manifest_hash',_target_manifest_hash,
      'target_tenant_id',_target_tenant_id,
      'external_proof_sha256',_external_proof_sha256,
      'proof_verified_at',_proof_verified_at,
      'independent_checker_id',_independent_checker_id,
      'reason',btrim(_reason),
      'original_decided_by_preserved',true));
  RETURN 'succeeded';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mkt_lead_kpis()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  result jsonb;
  pii_reader boolean := public.has_mkt_pii_read_access();
  last_7_count bigint;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT (
    public.has_mkt_role(auth.uid(), 'super_admin'::public.mkt_admin_role)
    OR public.has_mkt_role(auth.uid(), 'sales_admin'::public.mkt_admin_role)
    OR public.has_mkt_role(auth.uid(), 'marketing_admin'::public.mkt_admin_role)
    OR public.has_mkt_role(auth.uid(), 'ai_admin'::public.mkt_admin_role)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT count(*) INTO last_7_count
  FROM public.mkt_leads
  WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 days';

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'total', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.mkt_leads) >= 5
      THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM public.mkt_leads) ELSE NULL END,
    'restricted', NOT pii_reader,
    'suppressed', NOT pii_reader,
    'byStage', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(stage::text, total), '{}'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT stage, count(*) AS total
        FROM public.mkt_leads
        GROUP BY stage
      ) AS counts_by_stage
      WHERE pii_reader OR total >= 5
    ),
    'byTemp', jsonb_build_object(
      'hot', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.mkt_leads WHERE temperature = 'hot') >= 5
        THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM public.mkt_leads WHERE temperature = 'hot') ELSE NULL END,
      'warm', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.mkt_leads WHERE temperature = 'warm') >= 5
        THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM public.mkt_leads WHERE temperature = 'warm') ELSE NULL END,
      'cold', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR (SELECT count(*) FROM public.mkt_leads WHERE temperature = 'cold') >= 5
        THEN (SELECT count(*) FROM public.mkt_leads WHERE temperature = 'cold') ELSE NULL END
    ),
    'daily', (
      SELECT CASE WHEN pii_reader THEN COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(day, total), '{}'::jsonb) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
      FROM (
        SELECT to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day,
               count(*) AS total
        FROM public.mkt_leads
        GROUP BY 1
      ) AS counts_by_day
    ),
    'last7', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR last_7_count >= 5 THEN last_7_count ELSE NULL END
  ) INTO result;

  RETURN result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_kb_chunks(query_embedding vector, _tenant_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, match_count integer DEFAULT 5)
 RETURNS TABLE(article_id uuid, chunk_index integer, content text, title text, slug text, scope text, similarity double precision)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    c.article_id,
    c.chunk_index,
    c.content,
    a.title,
    a.slug,
    a.scope::text,
    1 - (c.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM public.kb_chunks c
  JOIN public.kb_articles a ON a.id = c.article_id
  WHERE a.status = 'published'
    AND (
      a.scope = 'platform'
      OR (_tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND a.tenant_id = _tenant_id)
    )
  ORDER BY c.embedding <=> query_embedding
  LIMIT match_count;
$function$

functions.name: webhook_health_stats
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.webhook_health_stats(p_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(delivered bigint, failed bigint, dead bigint, pending bigint, subscriptions bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.has_tenant_role(auth.uid(), p_tenant_id, 'tenant_admin')
     AND NOT public.has_tenant_role(auth.uid(), p_tenant_id, 'tenant_analyst') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.webhook_deliveries d
       JOIN public.webhook_subscriptions s ON s.id = d.subscription_id
      WHERE s.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        AND d.response_status BETWEEN 200 AND 299
        AND d.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS delivered,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.webhook_deliveries d
       JOIN public.webhook_subscriptions s ON s.id = d.subscription_id
      WHERE s.tenant_id = p_tenant_id
        AND d.response_status IS NOT NULL
        AND (d.response_status < 200 OR d.response_status >= 300)
        AND d.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS failed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.webhook_outbox
      WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND status = 'dead'
        AND created_at > now() - interval '24 hours') AS dead,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.webhook_outbox
      WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND status = 'pending') AS pending,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.webhook_subscriptions
      WHERE tenant_id = p_tenant_id AND enabled = true) AS subscriptions;
END $function$

functions.name: get_exception_dashboard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_exception_dashboard(_tenant_id uuid, _days integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  actor_id uuid := auth.uid();
  dashboard_as_of timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
  trend_start timestamptz;
  rate_state record;
  result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant_id is required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF _days IS NULL OR _days NOT IN (7, 30, 90) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'days must be one of 7, 30 or 90' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF actor_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: authenticated identity required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.tenant_members membership
    WHERE membership.tenant_id = _tenant_id
      AND membership.user_id = actor_id
      AND membership.active
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: active tenant membership required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NOT (
    public.is_platform_admin(actor_id)
    OR public.user_has_permission(actor_id, _tenant_id, 'break.read', NULL)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden: break.read permission required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO rate_state
  FROM private.exception_dashboard_rate_limit_hit(_tenant_id);
  IF NOT rate_state.allowed THEN
    RAISE SQLSTATE 'PGRST' USING
      MESSAGE = jsonb_build_object(
        'code', 'exception_dashboard_rate_limited',
        'message', 'Too many exception dashboard requests',
        'details', 'The per-user, per-tenant limit is 60 requests per minute.',
        'hint', 'Retry after the number of seconds in the Retry-After header.'
      )::text,
      DETAIL = jsonb_build_object(
        'status', 429,
        'headers', jsonb_build_object(
          'Retry-After', GREATEST(1, rate_state.retry_after_seconds)::text
        )
      )::text;
  END IF;

  trend_start := (
    ((dashboard_as_of AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - (_days - 1))::timestamp
    AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
  );

  WITH visible_definitions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id, tenant_id, name
    FROM public.recon_definitions
    WHERE tenant_id = _tenant_id
  ),
  visible_runs AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT id, tenant_id, definition_id
    FROM public.recon_runs
    WHERE tenant_id = _tenant_id
  ),
  scoped AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
      exception.id,
      exception.created_at,
      exception.severity,
      exception.priority,
      exception.assignee,
      CASE
        WHEN exception.lifecycle_state = 'written_off' OR exception.status = 'wont_fix'
          THEN 'written_off'
        WHEN exception.lifecycle_state = 'resolved' OR exception.status = 'resolved'
          THEN 'resolved'
        ELSE exception.lifecycle_state
      END AS canonical_status,
      NOT (
        exception.lifecycle_state IN ('resolved','written_off')
        OR exception.status IN ('resolved','wont_fix')
      ) AS is_open,
      GREATEST(
        0,
        floor(extract(epoch FROM (dashboard_as_of - exception.created_at)) / 86400)::integer
      ) AS age_days,
      definition.id AS reconciliation_id,
      COALESCE(definition.name, 'Unknown reconciliation') AS reconciliation_name
    FROM public.recon_exceptions exception
    LEFT JOIN visible_runs run
      ON run.id = exception.run_id
     AND run.tenant_id = exception.tenant_id
    LEFT JOIN visible_definitions definition
      ON definition.id = run.definition_id
     AND definition.tenant_id = exception.tenant_id
    WHERE exception.tenant_id = _tenant_id
      AND exception.created_at <= dashboard_as_of
  ),
  totals AS (
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'total', count(*),
      'open', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_open),
      'resolved', count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_open),
      'high_priority', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_open AND priority IN ('P1','P2')),
      'unassigned', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_open AND assignee IS NULL),
      'older_than_30_days', count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_open AND age_days > 30),
      'oldest_open_days', COALESCE(max(age_days) FILTER (WHERE is_open), 0)
    ) AS value
    FROM scoped
  ),
  severity_seed(name, ordinal) AS (
    VALUES ('critical', 1), ('high', 2), ('medium', 3), ('low', 4)
  ),
  severity_counts AS (
    SELECT severity AS name, count(*) AS count
    FROM scoped
    GROUP BY severity
  ),
  status_seed(name, ordinal) AS (
    VALUES
      ('new', 1), ('assigned', 2), ('investigating', 3),
      ('pending_counterparty', 4), ('resolved', 5), ('written_off', 6)
  ),
  status_counts AS (
    SELECT canonical_status AS name, count(*) AS count
    FROM scoped
    GROUP BY canonical_status
  ),
  ageing_counts AS (
    SELECT
      CASE
        WHEN age_days < 3 THEN '0–2'
        WHEN age_days < 8 THEN '3–7'
        WHEN age_days < 31 THEN '8–30'
        WHEN age_days < 91 THEN '31–90'
        ELSE '90+'
      END AS name,
      count(*) AS count
    FROM scoped
    WHERE is_open
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  ageing_seed(name, ordinal) AS (
    VALUES ('0–2', 1), ('3–7', 2), ('8–30', 3), ('31–90', 4), ('90+', 5)
  ),
  trend_days AS (
    SELECT generated.day::date AS day
    FROM generate_series(
      (trend_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
      (dashboard_as_of AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date,
      interval '1 day'
    ) AS generated(day)
  ),
  trend_counts AS (
    SELECT
      (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day,
      count(*) AS created,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_open) AS still_open
    FROM scoped
    WHERE created_at >= trend_start
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  reconciliation_counts AS (
    SELECT
      reconciliation_id AS id,
      reconciliation_name AS name,
      count(*) AS open_count,
      count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority IN ('P1','P2')) AS high_priority_count,
      max(age_days) AS oldest_open_days
    FROM scoped
    WHERE is_open
    GROUP BY reconciliation_id, reconciliation_name
    ORDER BY count(*) DESC,
             count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority IN ('P1','P2')) DESC,
             max(age_days) DESC,
             reconciliation_name
    LIMIT 10
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'as_of', dashboard_as_of,
    'window_days', _days,
    'totals', (SELECT value FROM totals),
    'by_severity', (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object('name', seed.name, 'count', COALESCE(counts.count, 0))
        ORDER BY seed.ordinal
      )
      FROM severity_seed seed
      LEFT JOIN severity_counts counts USING (name)
    ),
    'by_status', (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object('name', seed.name, 'count', COALESCE(counts.count, 0))
        ORDER BY seed.ordinal
      )
      FROM status_seed seed
      LEFT JOIN status_counts counts USING (name)
    ),
    'ageing', (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object('name', seed.name, 'count', COALESCE(counts.count, 0))
        ORDER BY seed.ordinal
      )
      FROM ageing_seed seed
      LEFT JOIN ageing_counts counts USING (name)
    ),
    'trend', (
      SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'date', to_char(days.day, 'YYYY-MM-DD'),
          'created', COALESCE(counts.created, 0),
          'still_open', COALESCE(counts.still_open, 0)
        )
        ORDER BY days.day
      )
      FROM trend_days days
      LEFT JOIN trend_counts counts USING (day)
    ),
    'by_reconciliation', (
      SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'id', ranked.id,
          'name', ranked.name,
          'open', ranked.open_count,
          'high_priority', ranked.high_priority_count,
          'oldest_open_days', ranked.oldest_open_days
        ) ORDER BY ranked.open_count DESC, ranked.high_priority_count DESC,
                   ranked.oldest_open_days DESC, ranked.name),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
      FROM reconciliation_counts ranked
    )
  ) INTO result;

  RETURN result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.match_kb_chunks_lexical(_query text, _tenant_id uuid, match_count integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(chunk_id uuid, article_id uuid, title text, slug text, scope text, content text, rank real)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    kc.id AS chunk_id,
    kc.article_id,
    ka.title,
    ka.slug,
    ka.scope::text,
    kc.content,
    ts_rank(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(kc.content, '')),
            websearch_to_tsquery('english', _query))::real AS rank
  FROM public.kb_chunks kc
  JOIN public.kb_articles ka ON ka.id = kc.article_id
  WHERE ka.status = 'published'
    AND (
      ka.scope = 'platform'
      OR (_tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND ka.tenant_id = _tenant_id)
    )
    AND to_tsvector('english', coalesce(kc.content, ''))
        @@ websearch_to_tsquery('english', _query)
  ORDER BY rank DESC
  LIMIT match_count;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpw_run_payload_state(_run uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE r public.data_prep_delivery_runs%ROWTYPE; expected bigint; recorded bigint; expiry timestamptz; purged boolean; held boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO r FROM public.data_prep_delivery_runs WHERE id=_run;
 SELECT count(*) INTO expected FROM public.data_prep_run_inputs WHERE run_id=_run;
 SELECT count(*),min(a.expires_at),coalesce(bool_or(t.file_id IS NOT NULL),false),coalesce(bool_or(private.dpw_attachment_has_hold(a.file_id)),false)
 INTO recorded,expiry,purged,held FROM public.data_prep_attachment_retention a JOIN public.data_prep_run_inputs i ON i.file_id=a.file_id AND i.run_id=_run
 LEFT JOIN public.data_prep_attachment_tombstones t ON t.file_id=a.file_id;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('available',r.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND expected>0 AND recorded=expected AND expiry>clock_timestamp() AND NOT purged,
 'state',CASE WHEN r.finished_at IS NULL THEN 'pending' WHEN recorded<>expected OR expected=0 THEN 'unqualified'
 WHEN purged THEN 'purged' WHEN expiry<=clock_timestamp() THEN 'expired' ELSE 'available' END,'expires_at',expiry,'legal_hold',held,
 'tombstones',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t)) FROM public.data_prep_attachment_tombstones t JOIN public.data_prep_run_inputs i ON i.file_id=t.file_id WHERE i.run_id=_run),'[]'::jsonb));
END $function$
