functions.name: evaluate_security_alerts
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.evaluate_security_alerts()
 RETURNS TABLE(rule_id uuid, tenant_id uuid, event_count integer, fired boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r RECORD;
  v_count integer;
  v_samples bigint[];
  v_severity_filter text[];
  v_min_ts timestamptz;
  v_incident_id uuid;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    SELECT * FROM public.security_alert_rules WHERE enabled = true
  LOOP
    -- Respect cooldown
    IF r.last_triggered_at IS NOT NULL
       AND r.last_triggered_at > now() - (r.cooldown_minutes || ' minutes')::interval
    THEN
      RETURN QUERY SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id, 0, false;
      CONTINUE;
    END IF;

    v_min_ts := now() - (r.window_minutes || ' minutes')::interval;
    v_severity_filter := CASE r.min_severity
      WHEN 'info' THEN ARRAY['info','warning','critical']
      WHEN 'warning' THEN ARRAY['warning','critical']
      ELSE ARRAY['critical']
    END;

    -- Per-tenant rule (tenant_id NOT NULL): scope to that tenant only.
    -- Platform-wide rule (tenant_id IS NULL): evaluate per-tenant of the matching events.
    IF r.tenant_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT count(*)::int,
             COALESCE(array_agg(id ORDER BY occurred_at DESC) FILTER (WHERE id IS NOT NULL), '{}')
        INTO v_count, v_samples
      FROM (
        SELECT id, occurred_at
        FROM public.security_events
        WHERE security_events.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
          AND event_type ILIKE r.event_type_pattern
          AND severity = ANY(v_severity_filter)
          AND occurred_at >= v_min_ts
        ORDER BY occurred_at DESC
        LIMIT 25
      ) s;

      IF v_count >= r.threshold THEN
        INSERT INTO public.security_alert_incidents
          (rule_id, tenant_id, event_count, window_minutes, severity, sample_event_ids, context)
        VALUES
          (r.id, r.tenant_id, v_count, r.window_minutes, r.severity, v_samples,
           jsonb_build_object('rule_code', r.code, 'pattern', r.event_type_pattern))
        RETURNING id INTO v_incident_id;

        UPDATE public.security_alert_rules
           SET last_triggered_at = now(), last_triggered_count = v_count
         WHERE id = r.id;

        -- Notify tenant admins (best-effort; ignore if notifications table is unavailable)
        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, tenant_id, kind, title, body, link_to, severity, context)
          SELECT tm.user_id, r.tenant_id, 'security_alert',
                 'Security alert: ' || r.code,
                 v_count || ' matching events in last ' || r.window_minutes || 'min',
                 '/security-audit',
                 r.severity,
                 jsonb_build_object('incident_id', v_incident_id, 'rule_id', r.id)
          FROM public.tenant_members tm
          WHERE tm.tenant_id = r.tenant_id
            AND tm.active = true
            AND tm.role = 'tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
        END;

        RETURN QUERY SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id, v_count, true;
      ELSE
        RETURN QUERY SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id, v_count, false;
      END IF;

    ELSE
      -- Platform-wide rule: group by tenant
      FOR v_count, v_samples, v_incident_id IN
        SELECT count(*)::int AS c,
               COALESCE(array_agg(s.id ORDER BY s.occurred_at DESC), '{}'::bigint[]) AS samples,
               s.tenant_id
        FROM public.security_events s
        WHERE s.event_type ILIKE r.event_type_pattern
          AND s.severity = ANY(v_severity_filter)
          AND s.occurred_at >= v_min_ts
        GROUP BY s.tenant_id
        HAVING count(*) >= r.threshold
      LOOP
        -- v_incident_id reused as tenant_id loop var; rebind:
        NULL;
      END LOOP;

      -- Re-run cleanly with proper loop variables:
      FOR r IN
        SELECT alert_rule.id AS rid, alert_rule.code, alert_rule.event_type_pattern, alert_rule.severity,
               alert_rule.window_minutes, alert_rule.threshold, alert_rule.cooldown_minutes,
               grp.tenant_id AS t_id, grp.c AS cnt, grp.samples
        FROM public.security_alert_rules alert_rule
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT s.tenant_id,
                 count(*)::int AS c,
                 COALESCE(array_agg(s.id ORDER BY s.occurred_at DESC), '{}'::bigint[]) AS samples
          FROM public.security_events s
          WHERE s.event_type ILIKE alert_rule.event_type_pattern
            AND s.severity = ANY(v_severity_filter)
            AND s.occurred_at >= now() - (alert_rule.window_minutes || ' minutes')::interval
          GROUP BY s.tenant_id
          HAVING count(*) >= alert_rule.threshold
        ) grp
        WHERE alert_rule.enabled = true AND alert_rule.tenant_id IS NULL
          AND (alert_rule.last_triggered_at IS NULL
            OR alert_rule.last_triggered_at <= now() - (alert_rule.cooldown_minutes || ' minutes')::interval)
      LOOP
        INSERT INTO public.security_alert_incidents
          (rule_id, tenant_id, event_count, window_minutes, severity, sample_event_ids, context)
        VALUES
          (r.rid, r.t_id, r.cnt, r.window_minutes, r.severity, r.samples,
           jsonb_build_object('rule_code', r.code, 'pattern', r.event_type_pattern, 'platform_rule', true))
        RETURNING id INTO v_incident_id;

        UPDATE public.security_alert_rules
           SET last_triggered_at = now(), last_triggered_count = r.cnt
         WHERE id = r.rid;

        BEGIN
          INSERT INTO public.notifications (user_id, tenant_id, kind, title, body, link_to, severity, context)
          SELECT tm.user_id, r.t_id, 'security_alert',
                 'Security alert: ' || r.code,
                 r.cnt || ' matching events in last ' || r.window_minutes || 'min',
                 '/security-audit',
                 r.severity,
                 jsonb_build_object('incident_id', v_incident_id, 'rule_id', r.rid)
          FROM public.tenant_members tm
          WHERE tm.tenant_id = r.t_id
            AND tm.active = true
            AND tm.role = 'tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role;
        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN NULL;
        END;

        RETURN QUERY SELECT r.rid, r.t_id, r.cnt, true;
      END LOOP;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_recon_run_autopack()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status IN ('completed','failed','cancelled')
     AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.status) THEN
    BEGIN
      PERFORM public.generate_recon_run_evidence_pack(NEW.id);
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      -- never block the run on evidence-pack errors; surface via audit_log
      INSERT INTO public.audit_log (tenant_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context)
      VALUES (NEW.tenant_id, 'tenant', 'recon.evidence_pack.failed', 'recon_run', NEW.id::text,
              jsonb_build_object('error', SQLERRM));
    END;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: step_up_grants_mark_expired
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.step_up_grants_mark_expired()
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  WITH expired AS (
    SELECT g.id, g.user_id
    FROM public.step_up_grants g
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.step_up_grant_lifecycle l
       WHERE l.grant_id = g.id AND l.action IN ('consumed','expired')
       LIMIT 1
    ) seen ON true
    WHERE g.consumed_at IS NULL
      AND g.expires_at < now()
      AND seen IS NULL
  ),
  ins AS (
    INSERT INTO public.step_up_grant_lifecycle (grant_id, action, actor_user_id)
    SELECT id, 'expired', user_id FROM expired
    RETURNING 1
  )
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM ins;
  RETURN v_count;
END;
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_collateral_csa_access_summary(_agreement_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(resource_type text, resource_id uuid, public_id text, access_state text, business_unit_names text[], business_unit_count integer, user_group_names text[], user_group_count integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor uuid:=auth.uid(); v_id uuid; v_tenant uuid; v_key text;
  v_registry uuid; v_admin boolean; v_owners text[]; v_groups text[];
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR _agreement_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(_agreement_ids) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    OR array_position(_agreement_ids,NULL) IS NOT NULL
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'between 1 and 100 CSA agreement IDs are required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  FOR v_id IN SELECT DISTINCT x FROM unnest(_agreement_ids) x ORDER BY x LOOP
    SELECT a.tenant_id,a.agreement_key INTO v_tenant,v_key
      FROM public.collateral_csa_agreements a WHERE a.id=v_id;
    IF v_tenant IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m
      WHERE m.tenant_id=v_tenant AND m.user_id=v_actor AND m.active) THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
    SELECT m.role='tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role INTO v_admin
      FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=v_tenant AND m.user_id=v_actor AND m.active;
    SELECT r.id INTO v_registry FROM public.data_resource_registry r
      WHERE r.tenant_id=v_tenant AND r.resource_type='collateral_csa_agreement'
        AND r.collateral_csa_agreement_id=v_id;
    IF v_registry IS NULL THEN
      IF NOT v_admin OR NOT private.collateral_csa_typed_allows(v_actor,v_tenant,v_id,'view')
      THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
      access_state:='unmapped'; v_owners:=ARRAY[]::text[]; v_groups:=ARRAY[]::text[];
    ELSE
      IF NOT private.collateral_csa_typed_allows(v_actor,v_tenant,v_id,'view') THEN CONTINUE; END IF;
      access_state:='mapped';
      SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT b.name ORDER BY b.name),ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO v_owners
        FROM public.data_resource_registry_owner_bu o
        JOIN public.business_units b ON b.id=o.bu_id AND b.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND NOT b.is_archived
        WHERE o.tenant_id=v_tenant AND o.registry_id=v_registry
          AND (v_admin OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants g
            WHERE g.tenant_id=o.tenant_id AND g.registry_id=o.registry_id AND g.bu_id=o.bu_id
              AND g.action='view' AND
              ((g.principal_type='user' AND g.principal_user_id=v_actor
                AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_user_assignments ua
                  JOIN public.business_units assigned ON assigned.id=ua.bu_id
                    AND assigned.tenant_id=ua.tenant_id AND NOT assigned.is_archived
                  WHERE ua.tenant_id=v_tenant AND ua.user_id=v_actor
                    AND (assigned.id=b.id OR (ua.inherit_descendants AND b.path <@ assigned.path))))
              OR (g.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_group_members gm
                    WHERE gm.group_id=g.principal_group_id AND gm.user_id=v_actor)
                AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments ga
                  JOIN public.business_units assigned ON assigned.id=ga.bu_id
                    AND assigned.tenant_id=ga.tenant_id AND NOT assigned.is_archived
                  WHERE ga.tenant_id=v_tenant AND ga.group_id=g.principal_group_id
                    AND (assigned.id=b.id OR (ga.inherit_descendants AND b.path <@ assigned.path)))))));
      SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT g.name ORDER BY g.name),ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO v_groups
        FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants grant_row
        JOIN public.tenant_groups g ON g.id=grant_row.principal_group_id
          AND g.tenant_id=grant_row.tenant_id
        WHERE grant_row.tenant_id=v_tenant AND grant_row.registry_id=v_registry
          AND grant_row.principal_type='group' AND grant_row.action='view'
          AND (v_admin OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_group_members gm
            WHERE gm.group_id=g.id AND gm.user_id=v_actor));
    END IF;
    resource_type:='collateral_csa_agreement'; resource_id:=v_id; public_id:=v_key;
    business_unit_names:=v_owners; business_unit_count:=cardinality(v_owners);
    user_group_names:=v_groups; user_group_count:=cardinality(v_groups);
    RETURN NEXT;
  END LOOP;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.recon_multi_bu_shadow_allows_actor(_actor uuid, _recon uuid, _action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
  WITH target AS (
    SELECT d.id, d.tenant_id
    FROM public.recon_definitions d
    WHERE d.id = _recon
      AND d.multi_bu_governed
      AND _action IN ('view', 'read', 'run', 'edit', 'approve')
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_bu
        WHERE owner_bu.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND owner_bu.recon_id = d.id
      )
  ), active_actor AS (
    SELECT t.tenant_id, tm.role
    FROM target t
    JOIN public.tenant_members tm
      ON tm.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND tm.user_id = _actor AND tm.active
  ), actor_owner_bu AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.tenant_id, t.id AS recon_id, owner_bu.bu_id
    FROM target t
    JOIN active_actor aa ON aa.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
    JOIN public.recon_definition_business_units owner_bu
      ON owner_bu.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND owner_bu.recon_id = t.id
    JOIN public.business_units target_bu
      ON target_bu.id = owner_bu.bu_id AND target_bu.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
    WHERE
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.bu_user_assignments ua
        JOIN public.business_units assigned_bu
          ON assigned_bu.id = ua.bu_id AND assigned_bu.tenant_id = ua.tenant_id
        WHERE ua.user_id = _actor AND ua.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
          AND (target_bu.id = assigned_bu.id OR
               (ua.inherit_descendants AND target_bu.path <@ assigned_bu.path))
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.bu_group_assignments ga
        JOIN public.business_units assigned_bu
          ON assigned_bu.id = ga.bu_id AND assigned_bu.tenant_id = ga.tenant_id
        JOIN public.tenant_groups g
          ON g.id = ga.group_id AND g.tenant_id = ga.tenant_id
        JOIN public.tenant_group_members gm ON gm.group_id = g.id AND gm.user_id = _actor
        WHERE ga.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
          AND (target_bu.id = assigned_bu.id OR
               (ga.inherit_descendants AND target_bu.path <@ assigned_bu.path))
      )
  ), matching_grant AS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM target t
    JOIN active_actor aa ON aa.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
    JOIN actor_owner_bu allowed_bu ON allowed_bu.recon_id = t.id
    JOIN public.recon_definition_bu_grants g
      ON g.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND g.recon_id = t.id AND g.bu_id = allowed_bu.bu_id
    WHERE g.action = CASE WHEN _action = 'read' THEN 'view' ELSE _action END
      AND (
        (g.principal_type = 'user' AND g.principal_id = _actor)
        OR
        (g.principal_type = 'group' AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.tenant_groups group_row
          JOIN public.tenant_group_members member_row
            ON member_row.group_id = group_row.id AND member_row.user_id = _actor
          WHERE group_row.id = g.principal_id AND group_row.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
        ))
      )
  )
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN _actor IS NULL OR _recon IS NULL OR _action IS NULL THEN false
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target) THEN false
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active_actor) THEN false
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active_actor WHERE role = 'tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role) THEN true
    ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matching_grant)
  END
$function$

functions.name: get_resource_actor_summary
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_resource_actor_summary(_resource_type text, _resource_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(resource_type text, resource_id uuid, created_by_label text, created_by_status text, updated_by_label text, updated_by_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_row record;
BEGIN
  IF coalesce(auth.role(), '') <> 'authenticated' OR auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF _resource_type IS NULL OR _resource_type NOT IN (
    'data_source','data_source_schedule','db_connection','inline_api_source','erp_connection',
    'file_watcher','aidp_template','aidp_document','reference_table','data_prep_pipeline','reconciliation'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported resource type' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF _resource_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(_resource_ids) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
     OR array_position(_resource_ids, NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'between 1 and 100 resource IDs are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    FOR v_row IN
      WITH visible AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT a.resource_id
        FROM public.get_data_resource_access_summary(_resource_type, _resource_ids) a
      ), roots AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT 'data_source'::text AS resource_type, s.id AS resource_id, s.tenant_id,
          s.created_by_actor_id, s.created_by_actor_status, s.updated_by_actor_id, s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.workspace_data_sources s
        WHERE _resource_type='data_source' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'data_source_schedule',s.id,s.tenant_id,s.created_by_actor_id,s.created_by_actor_status,s.updated_by_actor_id,s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.data_source_schedules s
        WHERE _resource_type='data_source_schedule' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'db_connection',s.id,s.tenant_id,s.created_by_actor_id,s.created_by_actor_status,s.updated_by_actor_id,s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.rekon_db_connections s
        WHERE _resource_type='db_connection' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'inline_api_source',s.id,s.tenant_id,s.created_by_actor_id,s.created_by_actor_status,s.updated_by_actor_id,s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.rekon_inline_api_sources s
        WHERE _resource_type='inline_api_source' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'erp_connection',s.id,s.tenant_id,s.created_by_actor_id,s.created_by_actor_status,s.updated_by_actor_id,s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.erp_connector_configs s
        WHERE _resource_type='erp_connection' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'file_watcher',s.id,s.tenant_id,s.created_by_actor_id,s.created_by_actor_status,s.updated_by_actor_id,s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.data_watchers s
        WHERE _resource_type='file_watcher' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'aidp_template',s.id,s.tenant_id,s.created_by_actor_id,s.created_by_actor_status,s.updated_by_actor_id,s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.aidp_templates s
        WHERE _resource_type='aidp_template' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'aidp_document',s.id,s.tenant_id,s.created_by_actor_id,s.created_by_actor_status,s.updated_by_actor_id,s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.aidp_documents s
        WHERE _resource_type='aidp_document' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'reference_table',s.id,s.tenant_id,s.created_by_actor_id,s.created_by_actor_status,s.updated_by_actor_id,s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.reference_data_tables s
        WHERE _resource_type='reference_table' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'data_prep_pipeline',s.id,s.tenant_id,s.created_by_actor_id,s.created_by_actor_status,s.updated_by_actor_id,s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.data_prep_pipelines s
        WHERE _resource_type='data_prep_pipeline' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'reconciliation',s.id,s.tenant_id,s.created_by_actor_id,s.created_by_actor_status,s.updated_by_actor_id,s.updated_by_actor_status
        FROM public.recon_definitions s
        WHERE _resource_type='reconciliation' AND s.id=ANY(_resource_ids)
      )
      SELECT r.*
      FROM roots r
      JOIN visible v ON v.resource_id = r.resource_id
    LOOP
      resource_type := v_row.resource_type;
      resource_id := v_row.resource_id;
      SELECT x.label,x.status INTO created_by_label,created_by_status
      FROM private.resource_actor_display_label(v_row.tenant_id,v_row.created_by_actor_id,v_row.created_by_actor_status) x;
      SELECT x.label,x.status INTO updated_by_label,updated_by_status
      FROM private.resource_actor_display_label(v_row.tenant_id,v_row.updated_by_actor_id,v_row.updated_by_actor_status) x;
      RETURN NEXT;
    END LOOP;
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    -- Hide database and authorization internals from API clients.
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unable to load resource actor summary' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END;
END
$function$

AS $function$
  WITH direct_user AS (
    SELECT bu_id, inherit_descendants FROM public.bu_user_assignments
    WHERE user_id = _user AND tenant_id = _tenant
  ),
  direct_group AS (
    SELECT bga.bu_id, bga.inherit_descendants FROM public.bu_group_assignments bga
    JOIN public.tenant_group_members tgm ON tgm.group_id = bga.group_id
    WHERE tgm.user_id = _user AND bga.tenant_id = _tenant
  ),
  all_direct AS (
    SELECT * FROM direct_user UNION SELECT * FROM direct_group
  )

  FROM public.business_units bu
  WHERE bu.tenant_id = _tenant
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM all_direct ad

         OR (ad.inherit_descendants AND bu.path <@ src.path)
    )

functions.name: rlnext_scope
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.rlnext_scope(_tenant uuid, _bu uuid, _groups uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE snapshot jsonb; group_snapshot jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF cardinality(_groups) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 20 OR cardinality(_groups)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT x) FROM unnest(_groups) x) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units WHERE id=_bu AND tenant_id=_tenant AND NOT is_archived)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(_groups) x LEFT JOIN public.tenant_groups g ON g.id=x AND g.tenant_id=_tenant AND g.bu_id=_bu WHERE g.id IS NULL)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current tenant BU and groups required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 -- Mirror the reviewed governance scope rules without calling its workspace-
 -- requester guard (a newly approved user has no workspace membership yet).
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_group_roles gr JOIN public.rbac_roles r ON r.id=gr.role_id WHERE gr.group_id=ANY(_groups)
   AND (NOT r.is_assignable OR (r.tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND r.tenant_id<>_tenant) OR r.key ~* '(admin|owner|platform|system)' OR r.key NOT IN('tenant_analyst','tenant_viewer') AND r.is_system))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments WHERE group_id=ANY(_groups) AND (tenant_id<>_tenant OR role::text='bu_admin'))
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=ANY(_groups) AND tenant_id<>_tenant)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_permissions p JOIN public.recon_definitions d ON d.id=p.recon_id WHERE p.principal_type='group' AND p.principal_id=ANY(_groups) AND d.tenant_id<>_tenant)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_group_id=ANY(_groups) AND tenant_id<>_tenant)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_resource_bu_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=ANY(_groups) AND tenant_id<>_tenant)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Privileged or cross-tenant group scope unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 SELECT jsonb_build_object(
   'groups',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY g.id) FROM public.tenant_groups g WHERE id=ANY(_groups)),'[]'::jsonb),
   'roles',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('group_id',gr.group_id,'role',to_jsonb(r)) ORDER BY gr.group_id,r.id) FROM public.tenant_group_roles gr JOIN public.rbac_roles r ON r.id=gr.role_id WHERE gr.group_id=ANY(_groups)),'[]'::jsonb),
   'permissions',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('group_id',gr.group_id,'permission',to_jsonb(p)) ORDER BY gr.group_id,p.id) FROM public.tenant_group_roles gr JOIN public.rbac_role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id=gr.role_id JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE gr.group_id=ANY(_groups)),'[]'::jsonb),
   'bu_assignments',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY g.group_id,g.bu_id) FROM public.bu_group_assignments g WHERE group_id=ANY(_groups)),'[]'::jsonb),
   'reconciliation_grants',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY g.id) FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=ANY(_groups)),'[]'::jsonb),
   'legacy_reconciliation_grants',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY g.id) FROM public.recon_permissions g WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=ANY(_groups)),'[]'::jsonb),
   'data_resource_grants',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY g.id) FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants g WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_group_id=ANY(_groups)),'[]'::jsonb),
   'legacy_data_resource_grants',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY g.id) FROM public.data_resource_bu_grants g WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=ANY(_groups)),'[]'::jsonb)
 ) INTO group_snapshot;
 snapshot:=jsonb_build_object('bu_id',_bu,'groups',group_snapshot,'scope','Existing group roles, permissions, department/team/feature and workspace rights apply; no new role definition is created.');
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('snapshot',snapshot,'hash',encode(extensions.digest(snapshot::text,'sha256'),'hex'));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.rlnext_session_gate()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE applicant private.rlnext_accounts;
BEGIN
 IF private.rlnext_account_allowed(NEW.user_id,NULL) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO applicant FROM private.rlnext_accounts WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id;
 -- This is a normal Supabase session restricted by unchanged business/RLS
 -- gates, not an application session or permission grant.
 IF applicant.mfa_required AND applicant.status IN('pending_verification','pending_approval') AND applicant.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND private.rlnext_domain(applicant.tenant_id,applicant.email)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth.users WHERE id=NEW.user_id AND lower(email)=applicant.email AND email_confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members WHERE user_id=NEW.user_id) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'Account lifecycle prevents sign-in' USING ERRCODE='42501';
END $function$

functions.name: rate_limit_hit
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rate_limit_hit(_key text, _window_seconds integer, _limit integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(allowed boolean, current_count integer, retry_after_seconds integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_window timestamptz;
  v_count int;
BEGIN
  v_window := to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch FROM now()) / _window_seconds) * _window_seconds);
  INSERT INTO public.rate_limit_buckets(bucket_key, window_start, count)
    VALUES (_key, v_window, 1)
  ON CONFLICT (bucket_key, window_start)
    DO UPDATE SET count = public.rate_limit_buckets.count + 1
  RETURNING count INTO v_count;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT (v_count <= _limit), v_count,
    GREATEST(0, _window_seconds - extract(epoch FROM (now() - v_window))::int);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mkt_get_llm_secret(_provider_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE _secret text;
BEGIN
  IF auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'service_role' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT v.decrypted_secret INTO _secret
  FROM public.mkt_llm_providers AS p
  JOIN vault.decrypted_secrets AS v
    ON v.name = p.api_key_ref
  WHERE p.id = _provider_id
    AND p.enabled = true
    AND p.api_key_ref = 'fvi_mkt_llm_' || p.id::text;
  RETURN _secret;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_csa_synthetic_tenant()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenants t
    WHERE t.id=NEW.tenant_id AND t.slug::text='falcon-veritas-assurance-lab-prod')
    OR (TG_OP='UPDATE' AND NEW.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'CSA lifecycle is limited to the synthetic Assurance tenant'
      USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_recon_shadow_access_summary(_tenant_id uuid, _recon_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR _recon_ids IS NULL
    OR cardinality(_recon_ids) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m
                   WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND m.user_id=v_actor AND m.active)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized'; END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'resource_type','reconciliation','resource_id',d.id,'public_id',d.recon_code,
    'access_state',CASE WHEN cardinality(owner_names.names)>0 THEN 'mapped' ELSE 'unmapped' END,
    'business_unit_names',to_jsonb(owner_names.names),
    'business_unit_count',cardinality(owner_names.names),
    'user_group_names',to_jsonb(group_names.names),
    'user_group_count',cardinality(group_names.names)
  ) ORDER BY d.recon_code),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_result
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(_recon_ids) AS id) requested
  JOIN public.recon_definitions d ON d.id=requested.id AND d.tenant_id=_tenant_id
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT b.name FROM public.recon_definition_business_units o
      JOIN public.business_units b ON b.id=o.bu_id AND b.tenant_id=o.tenant_id
      WHERE o.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND o.recon_id=d.id ORDER BY b.name) AS names
  ) owner_names
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT g.name FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
      JOIN public.tenant_groups g ON g.id=grant_row.principal_id AND g.tenant_id=grant_row.tenant_id
      WHERE grant_row.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND grant_row.recon_id=d.id
        AND grant_row.principal_type='group' ORDER BY g.name) AS names
  ) group_names
  WHERE private.user_can_access_recon(v_actor,d.id,'read');
  RETURN v_result;
END
$function$

functions.name: tg_guard_recon_definition_governance
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_guard_recon_definition_governance()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  request_id uuid;
  request_row public.recon_definition_governance_requests%ROWTYPE;
  actor uuid := auth.uid();
  is_internal_transition boolean := false;
  retirement_transition boolean := false;
  owner_binding_transition boolean := false;
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' AND NEW.access_mode='mapped_exact' THEN
    RETURN private.mapped_recon_governance_stage_insert(NEW);
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND OLD.access_mode='mapped_exact' AND OLD.governance_state<>'legacy_mapped'
     AND NEW.retired_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.retired_at
     AND NEW.retirement_request_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.retirement_request_id THEN
    RETURN private.mapped_recon_governance_update(OLD,NEW);
  END IF;
  IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
    request_id := nullif(current_setting('fvi.recon_governance_request_id',true),'')::uuid;
    IF request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT * INTO request_row FROM public.recon_definition_governance_requests q WHERE q.id=request_id;
    END IF;
    IF NEW.access_mode <> 'unmapped_pending' OR NEW.environment='production'
       OR NOT (
         (NEW.governance_state='development_draft' AND NEW.created_by=actor
           AND (private.recon_governance_is_active_admin(NEW.tenant_id,actor)
             OR private.recon_governance_is_active_analyst(NEW.tenant_id,actor))
           AND NEW.governance_parent_id IS NULL
           AND NEW.staging_original_name IS NULL AND NEW.staging_generated_name IS NULL
           AND NOT NEW.multi_bu_governed)
         OR (NEW.governance_state='staging_copy'
           AND private.recon_governance_is_active_admin(NEW.tenant_id,actor)
           AND request_id IS NOT NULL
           AND request_row.request_kind='edit' AND request_row.status='approved'
           AND request_row.decided_by=actor AND request_row.tenant_id=NEW.tenant_id
           AND request_row.staging_definition_id IS NULL
           AND request_row.parent_definition_id=NEW.governance_parent_id
           AND NEW.staging_original_name IS NOT NULL AND NEW.staging_generated_name=NEW.name
           AND private.recon_governance_is_active_admin(NEW.tenant_id,actor))
       ) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'new reconciliation definitions must begin as unmapped development drafts'
        USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.governance_parent_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.governance_parent_id
     OR NEW.staging_original_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.staging_original_name
     OR NEW.staging_generated_name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.staging_generated_name THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reconciliation staging identity is immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;

  IF OLD.access_mode='legacy_passthrough' THEN
    IF NEW.access_mode IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.access_mode
       OR NEW.governance_state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.governance_state
       OR NEW.multi_bu_governed IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.multi_bu_governed THEN
      IF NOT (
        NEW.access_mode='mapped_exact' AND NEW.governance_state='legacy_mapped'
        AND OLD.governance_state='legacy_unreviewed'
        AND NEW.multi_bu_governed=true AND OLD.multi_bu_governed=false
        AND NEW.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id
        AND NEW.id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
        AND NEW.created_by IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by
        AND NEW.created_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
        AND NEW.status IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.status
        AND NEW.bu_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.bu_id
        AND NEW.visibility IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.visibility
        AND NEW.environment IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment
        AND NEW.name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.name
        AND NEW.description IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.description
        AND NEW.recon_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.recon_type
        AND NEW.sides IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.sides
        AND NEW.rules IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.rules
        AND NEW.extension IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.extension
        AND NEW.retired_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.retired_at
        AND NEW.retirement_request_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.retirement_request_id
        AND NEW.governance_parent_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.governance_parent_id
        AND NEW.staging_original_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.staging_original_name
        AND NEW.staging_generated_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.staging_generated_name
        AND NEW.starter_template_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.starter_template_id
        AND NEW.starter_template_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.starter_template_code
        AND NEW.starter_template_snapshot IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.starter_template_snapshot
        AND NEW.tenant_template_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_template_id
        AND private.recon_legacy_mapping_transition_authorized(OLD.tenant_id,OLD.id,auth.uid())
      ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy reconciliation governance state requires an owner-reviewed cutover'
          USING ERRCODE='23514';
      END IF;
      RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  owner_binding_transition := OLD.access_mode='unmapped_pending'
    AND NEW.access_mode='mapped_exact'
    AND OLD.governance_state='development_draft'
    AND NEW.governance_state='development_draft'
    AND OLD.environment='development' AND NEW.environment='development'
    AND OLD.multi_bu_governed=false AND NEW.multi_bu_governed=true
    AND (
      private.recon_governance_is_active_admin(OLD.tenant_id,actor)
      OR (OLD.created_by=actor
        AND private.recon_governance_is_active_analyst(OLD.tenant_id,actor)
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_row
          WHERE owner_row.tenant_id=OLD.tenant_id AND owner_row.recon_id=OLD.id
            AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['view','edit','run']::text[]) required_action(action_name)
              WHERE NOT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
                WHERE grant_row.tenant_id=owner_row.tenant_id AND grant_row.recon_id=owner_row.recon_id
                  AND grant_row.bu_id=owner_row.bu_id AND grant_row.principal_type='user'
                  AND grant_row.principal_id=actor AND grant_row.action=required_action.action_name
              )
            )
        )
      )
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_row
      JOIN public.business_units owner_unit
        ON owner_unit.id=owner_row.bu_id AND owner_unit.tenant_id=owner_row.tenant_id
      WHERE owner_row.tenant_id=OLD.tenant_id AND owner_row.recon_id=OLD.id
        AND NOT owner_unit.is_archived
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_row
      LEFT JOIN public.business_units owner_unit
        ON owner_unit.id=owner_row.bu_id AND owner_unit.tenant_id=owner_row.tenant_id
      WHERE owner_row.tenant_id=OLD.tenant_id AND owner_row.recon_id=OLD.id
        AND (owner_unit.id IS NULL OR owner_unit.is_archived)
    );

  IF NEW.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_id OR NEW.id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.id
     OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at
     OR NEW.bu_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.bu_id OR NEW.visibility IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.visibility
     OR (NEW.multi_bu_governed IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.multi_bu_governed AND NOT owner_binding_transition) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reconciliation identity and access metadata are immutable outside the reviewed Access cutover'
      USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  IF OLD.access_mode IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.access_mode AND NOT owner_binding_transition THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reconciliation access mode requires an owner-reviewed Access cutover'
      USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;

    IF OLD.governance_state='legacy_mapped' THEN
    IF NEW.governance_state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.governance_state
       OR NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status
       OR NEW.environment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment
       OR NEW.name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.name
       OR NEW.description IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.description
       OR NEW.recon_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.recon_type
       OR NEW.sides IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.sides
       OR NEW.rules IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.rules
       OR NEW.extension IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.extension
       OR NEW.retired_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.retired_at
       OR NEW.retirement_request_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.retirement_request_id
       OR NEW.starter_template_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.starter_template_id
       OR NEW.starter_template_code IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.starter_template_code
       OR NEW.starter_template_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.starter_template_snapshot
       OR NEW.tenant_template_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.tenant_template_id THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'mapped legacy reconciliation content is immutable pending governed review'
        USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

request_id := nullif(current_setting('fvi.recon_governance_request_id',true),'')::uuid;
  IF request_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT * INTO request_row FROM public.recon_definition_governance_requests q WHERE q.id=request_id;
    IF FOUND AND request_row.tenant_id=OLD.tenant_id
       AND request_row.decided_by=actor
       AND private.recon_governance_is_active_admin(OLD.tenant_id,actor) THEN
      is_internal_transition := true;
    ELSIF FOUND AND request_row.tenant_id=OLD.tenant_id
       AND request_row.status='pending' AND request_row.requested_by=actor
       AND request_row.request_kind IN ('edit','promotion')
       AND private.recon_governance_is_active_admin(OLD.tenant_id,actor) THEN
      is_internal_transition := true;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.governance_state IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.governance_state THEN
    IF NOT is_internal_transition THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'reconciliation governance state changes require a verified workflow request'
        USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    IF NOT COALESCE((
      (request_row.request_kind='edit' AND request_row.status='pending'
        AND request_row.requested_by=actor AND request_row.parent_definition_id=OLD.id
        AND OLD.governance_state='approved_locked' AND NEW.governance_state='edit_request_pending')
      OR (request_row.request_kind='edit' AND request_row.status='approved'
        AND request_row.decided_by=actor AND request_row.parent_definition_id=OLD.id
        AND OLD.governance_state='edit_request_pending' AND NEW.governance_state='approved_locked')
      OR (request_row.request_kind='edit' AND request_row.status='rejected'
        AND request_row.decided_by=actor AND request_row.parent_definition_id=OLD.id
        AND OLD.governance_state='edit_request_pending' AND NEW.governance_state='approved_locked')
      OR (request_row.request_kind='promotion' AND request_row.status='pending'
        AND request_row.requested_by=actor AND request_row.staging_definition_id=OLD.id
        AND OLD.governance_state IN ('development_draft','staging_copy')
        AND NEW.governance_state='promotion_request_pending')
      OR (request_row.request_kind='promotion' AND request_row.status='approved'
        AND request_row.decided_by=actor AND request_row.staging_definition_id=OLD.id
        AND OLD.governance_state='promotion_request_pending'
        AND NEW.governance_state IN ('approved_locked','promoted'))
      OR (request_row.request_kind='promotion' AND request_row.status='rejected'
        AND request_row.decided_by=actor AND request_row.staging_definition_id=OLD.id
        AND OLD.governance_state='promotion_request_pending'
        AND NEW.governance_state IN ('development_draft','staging_copy'))
    ),false) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid reconciliation governance transition' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF OLD.governance_state='approved_locked' THEN
    retirement_transition := NEW.status='archived' AND OLD.status='active'
      AND NEW.retired_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.retirement_request_id IS NOT NULL
      AND NEW.governance_state=OLD.governance_state AND NEW.access_mode=OLD.access_mode
      AND NEW.environment=OLD.environment AND NEW.name=OLD.name AND NEW.description IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.description
      AND NEW.recon_type=OLD.recon_type AND NEW.sides=OLD.sides AND NEW.rules=OLD.rules
      AND NEW.extension=OLD.extension AND NEW.retired_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.retired_at
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_retirement_requests rr WHERE rr.id=NEW.retirement_request_id
        AND rr.tenant_id=OLD.tenant_id AND rr.recon_id=OLD.id AND rr.status='approved'
        AND rr.decided_by=actor AND rr.requested_by<>actor AND rr.decided_at IS NOT NULL);
    IF (NEW.name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.name OR NEW.description IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.description
        OR NEW.recon_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.recon_type OR NEW.sides IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.sides
        OR NEW.rules IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.rules OR NEW.extension IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.extension
        OR NEW.environment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment OR NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status)
       AND NOT retirement_transition AND NOT (is_internal_transition AND request_row.request_kind='promotion'
         AND request_row.status='approved' AND request_row.parent_definition_id=OLD.id
         AND request_row.snapshot IS NOT NULL
         AND request_row.snapshot_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(request_row.snapshot::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
         AND NEW.name=request_row.snapshot->>'name'
         AND NEW.description IS NOT DISTINCT FROM request_row.snapshot->>'description'
         AND NEW.recon_type=request_row.snapshot->>'recon_type'
         AND NEW.sides=request_row.snapshot->'sides' AND NEW.rules=request_row.snapshot->'rules'
         AND NEW.extension=request_row.snapshot->'extension'
         AND NEW.environment='production' AND NEW.status='active') THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'approved reconciliation definitions are locked; use the maker-checker workflow'
        USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
  ELSIF OLD.governance_state IN ('edit_request_pending','promotion_request_pending','promoted') THEN
    IF NEW.name IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.name OR NEW.description IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.description
       OR NEW.recon_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.recon_type OR NEW.sides IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.sides
       OR NEW.rules IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.rules OR NEW.extension IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.extension
       OR NEW.environment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment OR NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
      IF NOT (OLD.governance_state='promotion_request_pending' AND OLD.id=NEW.id
        AND request_row.request_kind='promotion' AND request_row.status='approved'
        AND request_row.staging_definition_id=OLD.id AND request_row.parent_definition_id=OLD.id
        AND request_row.snapshot_sha256=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(request_row.snapshot::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
        AND NEW.name=request_row.snapshot->>'name'
        AND NEW.description IS NOT DISTINCT FROM request_row.snapshot->>'description'
        AND NEW.recon_type=request_row.snapshot->>'recon_type'
        AND NEW.sides=request_row.snapshot->'sides' AND NEW.rules=request_row.snapshot->'rules'
        AND NEW.extension=request_row.snapshot->'extension'
        AND NEW.environment='production' AND NEW.status='active') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'pending or promoted reconciliation definitions are immutable' USING ERRCODE='23514';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  ELSIF OLD.governance_state IN ('development_draft','staging_copy') THEN
    IF NEW.environment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.environment OR NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'draft environment and business status are controlled by governance' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    IF OLD.governance_state='staging_copy' AND NOT private.recon_governance_is_active_admin(OLD.tenant_id,actor) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'staging edits currently require an active tenant administrator' USING ERRCODE='42501';
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.environment='production' AND NEW.governance_state NOT IN ('approved_locked','edit_request_pending') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'production environment requires an approved locked version' USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: get_recon_list_scope_ids
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_recon_list_scope_ids(_tenant_id uuid, _scope text, _bu_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid[]
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_ids uuid[];
BEGIN
  -- Registered workspace availability; original authorization and entire body follow unchanged.
  PERFORM private.wfm_assert_enabled(_tenant_id,'recons');

  IF v_actor IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR _scope NOT IN ('all','my')
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m
      WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND m.user_id=v_actor AND m.active)
    OR (_bu_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units b
      WHERE b.id=_bu_id AND b.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND NOT b.is_archived))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized'; END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(d.id ORDER BY d.id),ARRAY[]::uuid[]) INTO v_ids
  FROM public.recon_definitions d
  WHERE d.tenant_id=_tenant_id
    AND private.user_can_access_recon(v_actor,d.id,'read')
    AND (_bu_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_bu
      WHERE owner_bu.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND owner_bu.recon_id=d.id AND owner_bu.bu_id=_bu_id))
    AND (_scope='all' OR d.created_by=v_actor
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
        WHERE grant_row.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND grant_row.recon_id=d.id
          AND grant_row.principal_type='user' AND grant_row.principal_id=v_actor AND grant_row.action='view')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
        JOIN public.tenant_groups group_row ON group_row.id=grant_row.principal_id
          AND group_row.tenant_id=grant_row.tenant_id
        JOIN public.tenant_group_members member_row ON member_row.group_id=group_row.id
          AND member_row.user_id=v_actor
        WHERE grant_row.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND grant_row.recon_id=d.id
          AND grant_row.principal_type='group' AND grant_row.action='view'));
  RETURN v_ids;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_recon_run_result_page(_tenant_id uuid, _run_id uuid, _page integer DEFAULT 0, _status text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  definition_id uuid;
  result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _tenant_id IS NULL OR _run_id IS NULL OR _page IS NULL OR _page < 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant, run and non-negative page are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF _status IS NULL OR _status NOT IN ('all','match','partial','missing','duplicate','invalid_key','other','unavailable') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported run result status' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m
    WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.active) THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  SELECT r.definition_id INTO definition_id FROM public.recon_runs r
    WHERE r.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND r.id = _run_id;
  IF definition_id IS NULL OR NOT public.user_can_access_recon(auth.uid(), definition_id, 'read') THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;

  WITH exception_base AS (
    SELECT e.*,
      CASE WHEN e.payload->>'disposition' = 'keyless_input' THEN 'invalid_key'
        WHEN CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload)) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload)) > 0 ELSE false END THEN 'missing'
        WHEN e.payload->>'rule_kind' = 'unique' THEN 'duplicate'
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'key') = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'sides') = 'object' THEN 'partial'
        WHEN e.payload IS NULL OR e.payload = '{}'::jsonb THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'other' END AS status_bucket,
      CASE WHEN CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload)) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload)) > 0 ELSE false END
          AND jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'key') = 'string'
        THEN 'missing:' || jsonb_build_array(e.payload->'key', private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload))::text
        ELSE 'exception:' || e.id::text END AS parent_key
    FROM public.recon_exceptions e WHERE e.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND e.run_id = _run_id
  ), exception_items AS (
    SELECT parent_key, status_bucket, min(created_at) AS created_at,
      jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'public_case_id',public_case_id,'side',side,'reason',reason,'status',status,
        'payload',payload,'created_at',created_at) ORDER BY created_at,id) AS items
    FROM exception_base GROUP BY parent_key,status_bucket
  ), source_rows AS (
    SELECT parent_key, side, jsonb_agg(source_row ORDER BY created_at,id,member_order) AS rows
    FROM (
      SELECT parent_key,side,payload->'row' AS source_row,created_at,id,1 AS member_order
      FROM exception_base WHERE jsonb_typeof(payload->'row') = 'object'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT e.parent_key,side_entry.key,member_rows.row_data,e.created_at,e.id,member_rows.ordinality::integer
      FROM exception_base e
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'members')='object' THEN e.payload->'members' WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'sides')='object' THEN e.payload->'sides' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) side_entry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(side_entry.value)='array' THEN side_entry.value ELSE jsonb_build_array(side_entry.value) END
      ) WITH ORDINALITY AS member_rows(row_data,ordinality)
    ) values_by_side
    GROUP BY parent_key,side
  ), source_members AS (
    SELECT parent_key, jsonb_object_agg(side,rows) AS members
    FROM source_rows GROUP BY parent_key
  ), exception_parents AS (
    SELECT i.parent_key,i.status_bucket,i.created_at,i.items,
      COALESCE(s.members,'{}'::jsonb) AS members
    FROM exception_items i LEFT JOIN source_members s USING (parent_key)
  ), result_rows AS (
    SELECT m.created_at,'match:'||m.id::text AS result_id,'match'::text AS status_bucket,
      jsonb_build_object('kind','match','id',m.id,'created_at',m.created_at,'rule_id',m.rule_id,
        'cardinality',m.cardinality,'members',m.members,'exception_items','[]'::jsonb) AS row
    FROM public.recon_matches m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND m.run_id=_run_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.created_at,p.parent_key,p.status_bucket,
      jsonb_build_object('kind','exception','id',p.parent_key,'created_at',p.created_at,
        'status_bucket',p.status_bucket,'members',p.members,'exception_items',p.items) AS row
    FROM exception_parents p
  ), filtered AS (
    SELECT * FROM result_rows WHERE _status='all' OR status_bucket=_status
  ), counts AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS parent_count FROM filtered
  ), page AS (
    SELECT row,created_at,result_id FROM filtered ORDER BY created_at,result_id OFFSET _page*50 LIMIT 50
  ), fields AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(field_name ORDER BY field_name),'[]'::jsonb) AS names
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT field_name FROM (
        SELECT field.key AS field_name
        FROM public.recon_matches m
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m.members)='object' THEN m.members ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) side
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(side.value)='array' THEN side.value ELSE jsonb_build_array(side.value) END) member
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(member.value)='object' THEN member.value ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) field(key)
        WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND m.run_id=_run_id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT field.key
        FROM public.recon_exceptions e
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'row')='object' THEN e.payload->'row' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) field(key)
        WHERE e.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND e.run_id=_run_id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT field.key
        FROM public.recon_exceptions e
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'members')='object' THEN e.payload->'members' WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'sides')='object' THEN e.payload->'sides' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) side
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(side.value)='array' THEN side.value ELSE jsonb_build_array(side.value) END) AS member_rows(row_data)
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(member_rows.row_data)='object' THEN member_rows.row_data ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) field(key)
        WHERE e.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND e.run_id=_run_id
      ) all_fields
    ) distinct_fields
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(page.row ORDER BY page.created_at,page.result_id) FROM page),'[]'::jsonb),
    'field_names',fields.names,
    'parent_count',counts.parent_count,'page',_page,'page_size',50,
    'has_next',((_page+1)*50 < counts.parent_count)) INTO result FROM counts CROSS JOIN fields;
  RETURN result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.validate_data_resource_owner()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_table text; v_exists boolean;
BEGIN
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units bu
    WHERE bu.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id AND bu.id = NEW.bu_id AND NOT bu.is_archived
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'owning business unit must be active in the same tenant'; END IF;
  v_table := CASE NEW.resource_type
    WHEN 'data_source' THEN 'workspace_data_sources'
    WHEN 'db_connection' THEN 'rekon_db_connections'
    WHEN 'inline_api_source' THEN 'rekon_inline_api_sources'
    WHEN 'erp_connection' THEN 'erp_connector_configs'
    WHEN 'file_watcher' THEN 'data_watchers'
    WHEN 'aidp_template' THEN 'aidp_templates'
    WHEN 'aidp_document' THEN 'aidp_documents'
    WHEN 'reference_table' THEN 'reference_data_tables'
    WHEN 'data_prep_pipeline' THEN 'data_prep_pipelines'
    ELSE NULL
  END;
  IF v_table IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported data resource type'; END IF;
  EXECUTE format('SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.%I WHERE id = $1 AND tenant_id = $2)', v_table)
    INTO v_exists USING NEW.resource_id, NEW.tenant_id;
  IF NOT v_exists THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'resource must exist in the same tenant'; END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jsonb_deep_merge(a jsonb, b jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN a IS NULL THEN b
    WHEN b IS NULL THEN a
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(a)='object' AND jsonb_typeof(b)='object' THEN
      (SELECT jsonb_object_agg(k, CASE
        WHEN a ? k AND b ? k AND jsonb_typeof(a->k)='object' AND jsonb_typeof(b->k)='object'
          THEN public.jsonb_deep_merge(a->k, b->k)
        WHEN a ? k THEN a->k
        ELSE b->k END)
       FROM (SELECT jsonb_object_keys(a) UNION SELECT jsonb_object_keys(b)) t(k))
    ELSE COALESCE(a, b)
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_regulatory_install(_install_id uuid, _recon_id uuid, _pipeline_ids uuid[], _folder_name text, _field_count integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_old_status text;
  v_tenant uuid;
  v_actor uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT status, tenant_id, installed_by
    INTO v_old_status, v_tenant, v_actor
    FROM public.regulatory_pack_installs
   WHERE id = _install_id
   FOR UPDATE;

  UPDATE public.regulatory_pack_installs
     SET status = 'ready', completed_at = now(), materialized_at = now(),
         generated_process_count = COALESCE(array_length(_pipeline_ids, 1), 0) + 1,
         tenant_root_process_id = _recon_id, recon_id = _recon_id,
         materialized_artifacts = jsonb_build_object(
           'folder', _folder_name, 'pipeline_ids', to_jsonb(_pipeline_ids),
           'recon_id', _recon_id, 'field_count', _field_count
         )
   WHERE id = _install_id;

  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(
    actor_user_id, tenant_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context
  ) VALUES (
    v_actor, v_tenant, 'tenant',
    'regulatory.install.transition',
    'regulatory_pack_installs', _install_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'from', v_old_status, 'to', 'ready',
      'transitioned_at', now(), 'worker', 'regulatory-install-worker',
      'recon_id', _recon_id,
      'pipeline_count', COALESCE(array_length(_pipeline_ids, 1), 0),
      'folder', _folder_name, 'field_count', _field_count
    )
  );
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.enforce_sod_on_grant()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r record;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    SELECT s.name, s.permission_a, s.permission_b, s.severity
    FROM public.rbac_sod_rules s
    WHERE (s.tenant_id IS NULL OR s.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id)
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.rbac_role_permissions rp
        WHERE rp.role_id = NEW.role_id AND rp.permission_id = s.permission_a
      )
  LOOP
    IF EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.rbac_user_grants g2
      JOIN public.rbac_role_permissions rp2 ON rp2.role_id = g2.role_id
      WHERE g2.user_id = NEW.user_id
        AND g2.tenant_id = NEW.tenant_id
        AND g2.revoked_at IS NULL
        AND rp2.permission_id = r.permission_b
    ) THEN
      IF r.severity = 'block' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'SoD violation: % (permissions % and %)', r.name, r.permission_a, r.permission_b
          USING ERRCODE = '23514';
      END IF;
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.effective_retention_days(_tenant uuid, _table text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    (SELECT retention_days FROM public.tenant_retention_overrides
      WHERE tenant_id = _tenant AND table_name = _table),
    (SELECT retention_days FROM public.retention_policies WHERE table_name = _table),
    365

functions.name: record_pipeline_sample
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_pipeline_sample(_sink text, _status text, _latency_ms integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  _bucket timestamptz := date_trunc('minute', now());
  _lat    integer := GREATEST(COALESCE(_latency_ms, 0), 0);
BEGIN
  IF _sink NOT IN ('apm','siem') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid sink %', _sink;
  END IF;
  IF _status NOT IN ('ok','drop','error') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid status %', _status;
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.observability_pipeline_stats
    (bucket_ts, sink, ok_count, drop_count, error_count, latency_sum_ms, latency_max_ms)
  VALUES (
    _bucket, _sink,
    CASE WHEN _status = 'ok'    THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    CASE WHEN _status = 'drop'  THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    CASE WHEN _status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    _lat, _lat
  )
  ON CONFLICT (bucket_ts, sink) DO UPDATE SET
    ok_count       = observability_pipeline_stats.ok_count
                     + CASE WHEN _status = 'ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    drop_count     = observability_pipeline_stats.drop_count
                     + CASE WHEN _status = 'drop' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    error_count    = observability_pipeline_stats.error_count
                     + CASE WHEN _status = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
    latency_sum_ms = observability_pipeline_stats.latency_sum_ms + _lat,
    latency_max_ms = GREATEST(observability_pipeline_stats.latency_max_ms, _lat);
END;
$function$

functions.name: get_kg_neighbors
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_kg_neighbors(_tenant_id uuid, _start_node uuid, _max_depth integer DEFAULT 3)
 RETURNS TABLE(node_id uuid, depth integer, edge_type text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH RECURSIVE walk AS (
    SELECT _start_node AS node_id, 0 AS depth, NULL::text AS edge_type,
           ARRAY[_start_node] AS visited
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.dst_node_id, w.depth + 1, e.edge_type, w.visited || e.dst_node_id
    FROM walk w
    JOIN public.recon_kg_edges e
      ON e.src_node_id = w.node_id AND e.tenant_id = _tenant_id
    WHERE w.depth < _max_depth AND NOT (e.dst_node_id = ANY(w.visited))
  )
  SELECT node_id, depth, edge_type FROM walk WHERE depth > 0;
$function$

functions.name: data_resource_shadow_allows_actor
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.data_resource_shadow_allows_actor(_actor uuid, _registry_id uuid, _action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
  WITH target AS (
    SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id
    FROM public.data_resource_registry r
    WHERE r.id = _registry_id
      AND _action IN ('view', 'ingest', 'run', 'edit', 'manage', 'approve')
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.data_resource_registry_owner_bu owner_link
        JOIN public.business_units owner_bu ON owner_bu.id = owner_link.bu_id
          AND owner_bu.tenant_id = owner_link.tenant_id AND NOT owner_bu.is_archived
        WHERE owner_link.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND owner_link.registry_id = r.id
      )
  ), active_actor AS (
    SELECT t.tenant_id, tm.role
    FROM target t
    JOIN public.tenant_members tm ON tm.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND tm.user_id = _actor AND tm.active
  ), admin_override AS (
    SELECT 1 FROM active_actor WHERE role = 'tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role
  ), direct_grant AS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM target t
    JOIN active_actor aa ON aa.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
    JOIN public.data_resource_registry_owner_bu o ON o.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND o.registry_id = t.id
    JOIN public.business_units target_bu ON target_bu.id = o.bu_id AND target_bu.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND NOT target_bu.is_archived
    JOIN public.data_resource_registry_grants g ON g.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND g.registry_id = t.id AND g.bu_id = o.bu_id
    WHERE g.action = _action AND g.principal_type = 'user' AND g.principal_user_id = _actor
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_user_assignments ua
        JOIN public.business_units assigned_bu ON assigned_bu.id = ua.bu_id AND assigned_bu.tenant_id = ua.tenant_id AND NOT assigned_bu.is_archived
        WHERE ua.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND ua.user_id = _actor
          AND (assigned_bu.id = target_bu.id OR (ua.inherit_descendants AND target_bu.path <@ assigned_bu.path))
      )
  ), group_grant AS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM target t
    JOIN active_actor aa ON aa.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
    JOIN public.data_resource_registry_owner_bu o ON o.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND o.registry_id = t.id
    JOIN public.business_units target_bu ON target_bu.id = o.bu_id AND target_bu.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND NOT target_bu.is_archived
    JOIN public.data_resource_registry_grants g ON g.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND g.registry_id = t.id AND g.bu_id = o.bu_id
    JOIN public.tenant_groups grant_group ON grant_group.id = g.principal_group_id AND grant_group.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
    JOIN public.tenant_group_members gm ON gm.group_id = grant_group.id AND gm.user_id = _actor
    WHERE g.action = _action AND g.principal_type = 'group'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments ga
        JOIN public.business_units assigned_bu ON assigned_bu.id = ga.bu_id AND assigned_bu.tenant_id = ga.tenant_id AND NOT assigned_bu.is_archived
        WHERE ga.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND ga.group_id = grant_group.id
          AND (assigned_bu.id = target_bu.id OR (ga.inherit_descendants AND target_bu.path <@ assigned_bu.path))
      )
  )
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN _actor IS NULL OR _registry_id IS NULL OR _action NOT IN ('view', 'ingest', 'run', 'edit', 'manage', 'approve') THEN false
    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM target) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM active_actor) THEN false
    -- The generic ledger cannot prove a lifecycle request maker. Never let a
    -- grant or admin override substitute for workflow-specific SoD evidence.
    WHEN _action = 'approve' THEN false
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM admin_override) THEN true
    ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM direct_grant) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_grant)
  END
$function$

          OR private.has_tenant_role(_user, d.tenant_id, 'tenant_admin')

              AND rp.principal_id = _user AND rp.permission = _perm)

            JOIN public.tenant_group_members gm ON gm.group_id = rp.principal_id AND gm.user_id = _user

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fail_regulatory_install(_install_id uuid, _error text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_old_status text;
  v_tenant uuid;
  v_actor uuid;
BEGIN
  SELECT status, tenant_id, installed_by
    INTO v_old_status, v_tenant, v_actor
    FROM public.regulatory_pack_installs
   WHERE id = _install_id
   FOR UPDATE;

  UPDATE public.regulatory_pack_installs
     SET status = 'failed',
         error_message = _error,
         materialization_error = _error
   WHERE id = _install_id;

  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(
    actor_user_id, tenant_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context
  ) VALUES (
    v_actor, v_tenant, 'tenant',
    'regulatory.install.transition',
    'regulatory_pack_installs', _install_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'from', v_old_status, 'to', 'failed',
      'transitioned_at', now(), 'worker', 'regulatory-install-worker',
      'error', _error
    )
  );
END $function$

functions.name: tg_regulatory_install_audit
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_regulatory_install_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP = 'INSERT' THEN
    INSERT INTO public.audit_log(
      actor_user_id, tenant_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context
    ) VALUES (
      NEW.installed_by, NEW.tenant_id, 'tenant',
      'regulatory.install.transition',
      'regulatory_pack_installs', NEW.id::text,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'from', NULL, 'to', NEW.status,
        'transitioned_at', now(),
        'pack_id', NEW.pack_id,
        'installed_version', NEW.installed_version
      )
    );
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE' AND NEW.status IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.status THEN
    -- Skip if the transition came from one of our SECURITY DEFINER RPCs,
    -- which already insert their own (richer) audit row. We detect that via
    -- the action label seen on the most recent audit row for this resource
    -- within the current statement window.
    IF NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.audit_log
       WHERE resource_type = 'regulatory_pack_installs'
         AND resource_id = NEW.id::text
         AND action = 'regulatory.install.transition'
         AND occurred_at > now() - interval '2 seconds'
         AND (context->>'to') = NEW.status
    ) THEN
      INSERT INTO public.audit_log(
        actor_user_id, tenant_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context
      ) VALUES (
        COALESCE(auth.uid(), NEW.installed_by), NEW.tenant_id, 'tenant',
        'regulatory.install.transition',
        'regulatory_pack_installs', NEW.id::text,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'from', OLD.status, 'to', NEW.status,
          'transitioned_at', now(),
          'source', 'trigger'
        )
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.rlnext_base_public_has_permission(_user_id uuid, _permission text, _tenant_id uuid, _scope_type rbac_scope_type DEFAULT 'tenant'::rbac_scope_type, _scope_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.rbac_user_grants g
    JOIN public.rbac_role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = g.role_id
    WHERE g.user_id = _user_id
      AND g.tenant_id = _tenant_id
      AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at > now())
      AND rp.permission_id = _permission
      AND (
        -- Tenant-wide grant covers any scope
        g.scope_type = 'tenant'
        -- Exact scope match
        OR (g.scope_type = _scope_type AND g.scope_id = _scope_id)
        -- BU grant inherits down (via ltree)
        OR (g.scope_type = 'business_unit' AND _scope_type = 'business_unit'
            AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units child
              JOIN public.business_units parent ON parent.id = g.scope_id
              WHERE child.id = _scope_id
                AND child.tenant_id = _tenant_id
                AND child.path <@ parent.path
            ))
      )
  );
$function$

functions.name: worker_record_failure
functions.identity: _tenant uuid, _scope worker_breaker_scope, _target uuid, _step text, _run_id uuid, _attempt integer, _max_attempts integer, _error text, _backoff_seconds integer
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.worker_record_failure(_tenant uuid, _scope worker_breaker_scope, _target uuid, _step text, _run_id uuid, _attempt integer, _max_attempts integer, _error text, _backoff_seconds integer)
 RETURNS TABLE(breaker_state worker_breaker_state, action text, next_probe_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_row public.worker_circuit_breakers%ROWTYPE;
  v_action text;
  v_new_state public.worker_breaker_state;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.worker_circuit_breakers (tenant_id, scope, target_id, last_failure_at, last_error, consecutive_failures)
  VALUES (_tenant, _scope, _target, now(), _error, 1)
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, scope, target_id) DO UPDATE
    SET consecutive_failures = public.worker_circuit_breakers.consecutive_failures + 1,
        last_failure_at = now(),
        last_error = _error,
        updated_at = now()
  RETURNING * INTO v_row;

  v_new_state := v_row.state;
  v_action := CASE WHEN _attempt < _max_attempts THEN 'retry_scheduled' ELSE 'retry_exhausted' END;

  IF v_row.consecutive_failures >= v_row.failure_threshold AND v_row.state <> 'open' THEN
    UPDATE public.worker_circuit_breakers
       SET state = 'open',
           opened_at = now(),
           next_probe_at = now() + make_interval(secs => v_row.cooldown_seconds),
           updated_at = now()
     WHERE id = v_row.id
    RETURNING * INTO v_row;
    v_new_state := 'open';
    v_action := 'breaker_open';

    INSERT INTO public.audit_log(actor_user_id, tenant_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context)
    VALUES (NULL, _tenant, 'tenant', 'worker.breaker.open', _scope::text, _target::text,
            jsonb_build_object('consecutive_failures', v_row.consecutive_failures,
                               'threshold', v_row.failure_threshold,
                               'cooldown_seconds', v_row.cooldown_seconds,
                               'last_error', _error,
                               'step', _step,
                               'run_id', _run_id));
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.worker_retry_attempts(
    tenant_id, pipeline_id, data_source_id, run_id, step, attempt, max_attempts,
    status, error, backoff_seconds, breaker_state
  ) VALUES (
    _tenant,
    CASE WHEN _scope = 'pipeline' THEN _target ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN _scope = 'data_source' THEN _target ELSE NULL END,
    _run_id, _step, _attempt, _max_attempts,
    v_action, _error, _backoff_seconds, v_new_state
  );

  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(actor_user_id, tenant_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context)
  VALUES (NULL, _tenant, 'tenant', 'worker.step.retry', _scope::text, _target::text,
          jsonb_build_object('step', _step, 'attempt', _attempt, 'max_attempts', _max_attempts,
                             'backoff_seconds', _backoff_seconds, 'breaker_state', v_new_state,
                             'action', v_action, 'error', _error, 'run_id', _run_id));

  RETURN QUERY SELECT v_new_state, v_action, v_row.next_probe_at;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.worker_record_success(_tenant uuid, _scope worker_breaker_scope, _target uuid, _step text, _run_id uuid, _attempt integer)
 RETURNS worker_breaker_state
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_row public.worker_circuit_breakers%ROWTYPE; v_prev public.worker_breaker_state;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.worker_circuit_breakers (tenant_id, scope, target_id, last_success_at, consecutive_failures, state)
  VALUES (_tenant, _scope, _target, now(), 0, 'closed')
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, scope, target_id) DO UPDATE
    SET last_success_at = now(),
        consecutive_failures = 0,
        state = 'closed',
        opened_at = NULL,
        next_probe_at = NULL,
        updated_at = now()
  RETURNING * INTO v_row;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_prev = ROW_COUNT;

  INSERT INTO public.worker_retry_attempts(
    tenant_id, pipeline_id, data_source_id, run_id, step, attempt, max_attempts,
    status, breaker_state
  ) VALUES (
    _tenant,
    CASE WHEN _scope = 'pipeline' THEN _target ELSE NULL END,
    CASE WHEN _scope = 'data_source' THEN _target ELSE NULL END,
    _run_id, _step, _attempt, _attempt, 'success', 'closed'
  );

  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(actor_user_id, tenant_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context)
  VALUES (NULL, _tenant, 'tenant', 'worker.step.success', _scope::text, _target::text,
          jsonb_build_object('step', _step, 'attempt', _attempt, 'run_id', _run_id, 'breaker_state', 'closed'));

  RETURN 'closed'::public.worker_breaker_state;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dump_public_schema_ddl()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_out text;
BEGIN
  SELECT string_agg(ddl, E'\n\n' ORDER BY ord)
  INTO v_out
  FROM (
    SELECT 1 AS ord, '-- FVI schema dump generated ' || now()::text AS ddl
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 2, 'SET statement_timeout = 0;'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 3, pg_catalog.pg_get_viewdef(v.oid, true)
    FROM pg_class v WHERE v.relkind = 'v' AND v.relnamespace =
      (SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'public')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 4, pg_catalog.pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)
    FROM pg_proc p WHERE p.pronamespace =
      (SELECT oid FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'public')
      AND p.prokind = 'f'
  ) sub;
  RETURN COALESCE(v_out, '-- No schema objects found');
END $function$

functions.name: get_digital_twin_subgraph
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_digital_twin_subgraph(_tenant_id uuid, _root_node_id uuid, _max_depth integer DEFAULT 2)
 RETURNS TABLE(node_id uuid, depth integer, parent_id uuid, rel text, label text, node_type text, status text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH RECURSIVE walk AS (
    SELECT n.id AS node_id, 0 AS depth, NULL::uuid AS parent_id, NULL::text AS rel, n.label, n.node_type, n.status
      FROM public.digital_twin_nodes n
      WHERE n.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND n.id = _root_node_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n.id, w.depth + 1, e.src_node_id, e.rel, n.label, n.node_type, n.status
      FROM walk w
      JOIN public.digital_twin_edges e ON e.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND e.src_node_id = w.node_id
      JOIN public.digital_twin_nodes n ON n.id = e.dst_node_id AND n.tenant_id = _tenant_id
      WHERE w.depth < LEAST(_max_depth, 5)
  )
  SELECT node_id, depth, parent_id, rel, label, node_type, status FROM walk;
$function$
