CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bulk_upsert_tenant_backup_slas(_tenant_ids uuid[], _snapshot_sla_hours integer, _alerts_enabled boolean, _change_note text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  affected int := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_platform_admin(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Forbidden: platform admin required';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO public.tenant_backup_slas (tenant_id, snapshot_sla_hours, alerts_enabled, notes, updated_by)
  SELECT tid, _snapshot_sla_hours, _alerts_enabled, _change_note, auth.uid()
  FROM unnest(_tenant_ids) AS tid
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id) DO UPDATE
    SET snapshot_sla_hours = EXCLUDED.snapshot_sla_hours,
        alerts_enabled     = EXCLUDED.alerts_enabled,
        notes              = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.notes, public.tenant_backup_slas.notes),
        updated_by         = auth.uid(),
        updated_at         = now();

  GET DIAGNOSTICS affected = ROW_COUNT;

  INSERT INTO public.audit_log (actor_user_id, action, scope, resource_type, resource_id, context)
  VALUES (
    auth.uid(),
    'platform_backup.tenant_sla_bulk_update',
    'platform',
    'tenant_backup_slas',
    'bulk',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'tenant_ids', _tenant_ids,
      'snapshot_sla_hours', _snapshot_sla_hours,
      'alerts_enabled', _alerts_enabled,
      'change_note', _change_note,
      'affected', affected
    )
  );

  RETURN affected;
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.registered_typed_resource_allows(_actor uuid, _tenant_id uuid, _resource_type text, _resource_id uuid, _action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_registry_id uuid;
BEGIN
  IF _actor IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR _resource_id IS NULL
    OR _resource_type NOT IN ('data_source','data_source_schedule','db_connection','inline_api_source',
      'erp_connection','file_watcher','aidp_template','aidp_document','reference_table','data_prep_pipeline','tenant_template','collateral_schedule')
    OR _action NOT IN ('view','ingest','edit','manage','run') THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;
  SELECT r.id INTO v_registry_id
  FROM public.data_resource_registry r
  WHERE r.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND r.resource_type = _resource_type
    AND CASE _resource_type
      WHEN 'data_source' THEN r.data_source_id
      WHEN 'data_source_schedule' THEN r.data_source_schedule_id
      WHEN 'db_connection' THEN r.db_connection_id
      WHEN 'inline_api_source' THEN r.inline_api_source_id
      WHEN 'erp_connection' THEN r.erp_connection_id
      WHEN 'file_watcher' THEN r.file_watcher_id
      WHEN 'aidp_template' THEN r.aidp_template_id
      WHEN 'aidp_document' THEN r.aidp_document_id
      WHEN 'reference_table' THEN r.reference_table_id
      WHEN 'data_prep_pipeline' THEN r.data_prep_pipeline_id
      WHEN 'tenant_template' THEN r.tenant_template_id
      WHEN 'collateral_schedule' THEN r.collateral_schedule_id
    END = _resource_id;
  IF v_registry_id IS NULL THEN RETURN true; END IF;
  RETURN private.data_resource_shadow_allows_actor(_actor, v_registry_id, _action);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_typed_data_resource_editor(_tenant_id uuid, _resource_type text, _resource_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_registry uuid; v_owners uuid[]; v_groups uuid[];
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR _resource_id IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members tm WHERE tm.tenant_id=_tenant_id
      AND tm.user_id=auth.uid() AND tm.active AND tm.role='tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role)
    OR private.typed_resource_root_tenant(_resource_type,_resource_id) IS DISTINCT FROM _tenant_id
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized'; END IF;
  SELECT r.id INTO v_registry FROM public.data_resource_registry r
  WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND r.resource_type=_resource_type
    AND CASE _resource_type
      WHEN 'data_source' THEN r.data_source_id WHEN 'data_source_schedule' THEN r.data_source_schedule_id
      WHEN 'db_connection' THEN r.db_connection_id WHEN 'inline_api_source' THEN r.inline_api_source_id
      WHEN 'erp_connection' THEN r.erp_connection_id WHEN 'file_watcher' THEN r.file_watcher_id
      WHEN 'aidp_template' THEN r.aidp_template_id WHEN 'aidp_document' THEN r.aidp_document_id
      WHEN 'reference_table' THEN r.reference_table_id WHEN 'data_prep_pipeline' THEN r.data_prep_pipeline_id
      WHEN 'tenant_template' THEN r.tenant_template_id WHEN 'collateral_schedule' THEN r.collateral_schedule_id
    END=_resource_id;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(o.bu_id ORDER BY o.bu_id),ARRAY[]::uuid[]) INTO v_owners
    FROM public.data_resource_registry_owner_bu o WHERE o.registry_id=v_registry AND o.tenant_id=_tenant_id;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT g.principal_group_id ORDER BY g.principal_group_id),ARRAY[]::uuid[]) INTO v_groups
    FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants g WHERE g.registry_id=v_registry AND g.tenant_id=_tenant_id
      AND g.principal_type='group' AND g.action='view';
  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'registered',v_registry IS NOT NULL,'owner_bu_ids',v_owners,'group_ids',v_groups,
    'business_units',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'name',b.name) ORDER BY b.name,b.id),'[]'::jsonb)
      FROM public.business_units b WHERE b.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND NOT b.is_archived),
    'user_groups',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',g.id,'name',g.name) ORDER BY g.name,g.id),'[]'::jsonb)
      FROM public.tenant_groups g WHERE g.tenant_id=_tenant_id)
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_tenant_health_trend(_tenant_id uuid, _days integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS TABLE(day date, overall_score numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with days as (
    select generate_series(
      (current_date - (_days - 1))::date,
      current_date::date,
      '1 day'::interval
    )::date as day
  ),
  ranked as (
    select
      date_trunc('day', computed_at)::date as day,
      overall_score,
      row_number() over (
        partition by date_trunc('day', computed_at)::date
        order by computed_at desc
      ) as rn
    from public.tenant_health_scores
    where tenant_id = _tenant_id
      and computed_at >= (current_date - _days + 1)
  )
  select
    d.day,
    coalesce(r.overall_score, 0) as overall_score
  from days d
  left join ranked r on r.day = d.day and r.rn = 1
  order by d.day asc;
$function$

functions.name: claim_aidp_api_job
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_aidp_api_job(_job_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(claimed boolean, job jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  claimed_row public.aidp_api_jobs%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT q.* INTO claimed_row
  FROM public.aidp_api_jobs q
  WHERE q.status = 'queued'
    AND q.available_at <= now()
    AND q.attempts < q.max_attempts
    AND (_job_id IS NULL OR q.id = _job_id)
  ORDER BY q.created_at
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT 1;

  IF claimed_row.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN QUERY SELECT false, NULL::jsonb;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.aidp_api_jobs q
  SET status = 'running',
      attempts = q.attempts + 1,
      locked_at = now(),
      last_error = NULL
  WHERE q.id = claimed_row.id
  RETURNING q.* INTO claimed_row;

  RETURN QUERY SELECT true, to_jsonb(claimed_row);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_workflow_api_job(_job_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF workflow_api_jobs
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  claimed public.workflow_api_jobs%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT job.* INTO claimed
  FROM public.workflow_api_jobs job
  WHERE job.status IN ('queued', 'failed')
    AND job.job_kind <> 'connector_agent_run'
    AND job.available_at <= now()
    AND job.attempts < job.max_attempts
    AND (_job_id IS NULL OR job.id = _job_id)
  ORDER BY job.created_at
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT 1;

  IF claimed.id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;

  UPDATE public.workflow_api_jobs AS expired
  SET status = 'running', attempts = attempts + 1, claimed_at = now(), error_code = NULL
  WHERE id = claimed.id
  RETURNING * INTO claimed;

  RETURN NEXT claimed;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.engage_ai_kill_switch(p_tenant uuid, p_scope text, p_reason text)
 RETURNS ai_governance_kill_switches
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r public.ai_governance_kill_switches;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (has_tenant_role(auth.uid(), p_tenant, 'tenant_admin') OR is_platform_admin(auth.uid())) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.ai_governance_kill_switches(tenant_id, scope, engaged, engaged_by, engaged_at, reason)
  VALUES (p_tenant, p_scope, true, auth.uid(), now(), p_reason)
  ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, scope) DO UPDATE
    SET engaged = true, engaged_by = auth.uid(), engaged_at = now(),
        released_by = NULL, released_at = NULL, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, updated_at = now()
  RETURNING * INTO r;

  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(tenant_id, actor_user_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context)
  VALUES (p_tenant, auth.uid(), 'tenant', 'ai.kill_switch.engaged', 'ai_governance_kill_switches', r.id::text,
          jsonb_build_object('scope', p_scope, 'reason', p_reason));
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.aidp_purge_stale_pages(_max_age_days integer DEFAULT 90)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'storage'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_deleted int;
BEGIN
  WITH stale AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.image_uri
    FROM public.aidp_pages p
    WHERE p.rendered_at < now() - make_interval(days => _max_age_days)
  ),
  del_obj AS (
    DELETE FROM storage.objects o
     USING stale s
     WHERE o.bucket_id = 'aidp' AND o.name = s.image_uri
     RETURNING 1
  ),
  del_rows AS (
    DELETE FROM public.aidp_pages WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM stale) RETURNING 1
  )
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_deleted FROM del_rows;
  RETURN v_deleted;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.decide_break_write_off(_tenant_id uuid, _request_id uuid, _approver_id uuid, _decision text, _decision_note text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(request_id uuid, exception_id uuid, decision_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE req public.break_write_off_requests%ROWTYPE; BEGIN IF _decision NOT IN('approved','rejected') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid write-off decision'; END IF; SELECT * INTO req FROM public.break_write_off_requests WHERE id=_request_id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id FOR UPDATE; IF NOT FOUND OR req.status<>'pending' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pending write-off request not found'; END IF; IF req.requested_by=_approver_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Maker cannot approve or reject their own write-off request'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members tm WHERE tm.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND tm.user_id=_approver_id AND tm.active AND tm.role='tenant_admin') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active tenant administrator approval required'; END IF; IF auth.role()<>'service_role' AND auth.uid() IS DISTINCT FROM _approver_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Approver identity mismatch'; END IF; UPDATE public.break_write_off_requests SET status=_decision,decided_by=_approver_id,decided_at=now(),decision_note=nullif(trim(_decision_note),''),updated_at=now() WHERE id=req.id; IF _decision='approved' THEN UPDATE public.recon_exceptions SET write_off_amount=req.amount,write_off_currency=req.currency,write_off_gl_account=req.gl_account,write_off_reason=req.reason,write_off_approved_by=_approver_id,write_off_approved_at=now(),lifecycle_state='written_off',status='resolved',resolved_by=_approver_id,resolved_at=now() WHERE id=req.exception_id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id; END IF; INSERT INTO public.recon_exception_transitions(tenant_id,exception_id,actor_user_id,from_state,to_state,transition_type,reason,context) VALUES(_tenant_id,req.exception_id,_approver_id,NULL,CASE WHEN _decision='approved' THEN 'written_off' ELSE 'pending_write_off' END,'write_off_'||_decision,coalesce(_decision_note,req.reason),jsonb_build_object('request_id',req.id,'amount',req.amount,'currency',req.currency,'gl_account',req.gl_account)); RETURN QUERY SELECT req.id,req.exception_id,_decision; END; $function$

functions.name: request_break_write_off

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.request_break_write_off(_tenant_id uuid, _exception_id uuid, _requester_id uuid, _amount numeric, _currency text, _gl_account text, _reason text)
 RETURNS TABLE(request_id uuid, request_status text, requested_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE prior_state text; created public.break_write_off_requests%ROWTYPE; BEGIN IF _amount<0 OR _currency!~'^[A-Z]{3}$' OR length(_gl_account) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR length(_reason) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 4000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid write-off request'; END IF; IF auth.role()<>'service_role' AND auth.uid() IS DISTINCT FROM _requester_id THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Requester identity mismatch'; END IF; IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members tm WHERE tm.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND tm.user_id=_requester_id AND tm.active AND tm.role IN('tenant_admin','tenant_analyst')) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active analyst or administrator required'; END IF; SELECT lifecycle_state INTO prior_state FROM public.recon_exceptions WHERE id=_exception_id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id FOR UPDATE; IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Break not found in active tenant scope'; END IF; INSERT INTO public.break_write_off_requests(tenant_id,exception_id,requested_by,amount,currency,gl_account,reason) VALUES(_tenant_id,_exception_id,_requester_id,_amount,_currency,_gl_account,_reason) RETURNING * INTO created; INSERT INTO public.recon_exception_transitions(tenant_id,exception_id,actor_user_id,from_state,to_state,transition_type,reason,context) VALUES(_tenant_id,_exception_id,_requester_id,prior_state,'pending_write_off','write_off_requested',_reason,jsonb_build_object('request_id',created.id,'amount',_amount,'currency',_currency,'gl_account',_gl_account)); RETURN QUERY SELECT created.id,created.status,created.created_at; END; $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_connector_agent_job(_tenant_id uuid, _token_id uuid, _agent_id text, _lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 120)
 RETURNS TABLE(job_id uuid, schedule_id uuid, connector_type text, config jsonb, attempt integer, lease_expires_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  claimed public.workflow_api_jobs%ROWTYPE;
  schedule public.data_source_schedules%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF _agent_id !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{2,63}$' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid agent identifier';
  END IF;
  IF _lease_seconds < 30 OR _lease_seconds > 300 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid lease duration';
  END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.api_tokens token
    WHERE token.id = _token_id
      AND token.tenant_id = _tenant_id
      AND token.revoked_at IS NULL
      AND (token.expires_at IS NULL OR token.expires_at > now())
      AND ('connectors.agent' = ANY(token.scopes) OR '*' = ANY(token.scopes))
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Connector agent token is not authorized';
  END IF;

  WITH expired AS (
    UPDATE public.workflow_api_jobs AS job
    SET status = CASE WHEN job.attempts < job.max_attempts THEN 'failed' ELSE 'dead' END,
        available_at = now(),
        completed_at = CASE WHEN job.attempts < job.max_attempts THEN NULL ELSE now() END,
        lease_token_id = NULL,
        lease_agent_id = NULL,
        lease_expires_at = NULL,
        error_code = 'connector_agent_lease_expired'
    WHERE job.tenant_id = _tenant_id
      AND job.job_kind = 'connector_agent_run'
      AND job.status = 'running'
      AND job.lease_expires_at < now()
    RETURNING job.id, job.actor_user_id, job.tenant_id, job.resource_id,
      job.attempts, job.attempts < job.max_attempts AS retryable
  )
  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(
    actor_user_id, tenant_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context
  )
  SELECT actor_user_id, tenant_id, 'workspace',
    CASE WHEN retryable THEN 'connector.agent.lease_expired' ELSE 'connector.agent.dead' END,
    'workflow_api_job', id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('schedule_id', resource_id, 'attempt', attempts,
      'error_code', 'connector_agent_lease_expired')
  FROM expired;

  SELECT job.* INTO claimed
  FROM public.workflow_api_jobs job
  JOIN public.data_source_schedules candidate ON candidate.id = job.resource_id
  WHERE job.tenant_id = _tenant_id
    AND job.job_kind = 'connector_agent_run'
    AND job.status IN ('queued', 'failed')
    AND job.available_at <= now()
    AND job.attempts < job.max_attempts
    AND candidate.tenant_id = _tenant_id
    AND candidate.connector_type IN ('sftp', 'ftp', 'local', 'network_drive')
    AND candidate.config->>'agent_id' = _agent_id
  ORDER BY job.created_at
  FOR UPDATE OF job SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT 1;

  IF claimed.id IS NULL THEN RETURN; END IF;

  UPDATE public.workflow_api_jobs
  SET status = 'running',
      attempts = attempts + 1,
      claimed_at = now(),
      lease_token_id = _token_id,
      lease_agent_id = _agent_id,
      lease_expires_at = now() + make_interval(secs => _lease_seconds),
      error_code = NULL
  WHERE id = claimed.id
  RETURNING * INTO claimed;

  SELECT * INTO schedule
  FROM public.data_source_schedules
  WHERE id = claimed.resource_id AND tenant_id = _tenant_id;

  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(
    actor_user_id, tenant_id, scope, action, resource_type, resource_id, context
  ) VALUES (
    claimed.actor_user_id, _tenant_id, 'workspace', 'connector.agent.lease',
    'workflow_api_job', claimed.id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('agent_id', _agent_id, 'connector_type', schedule.connector_type,
      'schedule_id', schedule.id, 'attempt', claimed.attempts, 'lease_token_id', _token_id)
  );

  RETURN QUERY SELECT
    claimed.id,
    schedule.id,
    schedule.connector_type,
    CASE schedule.connector_type
      WHEN 'sftp' THEN jsonb_build_object(
        'host', schedule.config->'host', 'port', schedule.config->'port',
        'remote_path', COALESCE(schedule.config->'remote_path', schedule.config->'path'),
        'file_pattern', schedule.config->'file_pattern',
        'credential_ref', COALESCE(schedule.config->'credential_ref', schedule.config->'secret_key'),
        'host_key_sha256', schedule.config->'host_key_sha256', 'format', schedule.config->'format',
        'max_files', schedule.config->'max_files', 'max_bytes', schedule.config->'max_bytes')
      WHEN 'ftp' THEN jsonb_build_object(
        'host', schedule.config->'host', 'port', schedule.config->'port',
        'remote_path', COALESCE(schedule.config->'remote_path', schedule.config->'path'),
        'file_pattern', schedule.config->'file_pattern',
        'credential_ref', COALESCE(schedule.config->'credential_ref', schedule.config->'secret_key'),
        'secure', schedule.config->'secure', 'format', schedule.config->'format',
        'max_files', schedule.config->'max_files', 'max_bytes', schedule.config->'max_bytes')
      WHEN 'local' THEN jsonb_build_object(
        'root_alias', schedule.config->'root_alias',
        'relative_path', COALESCE(schedule.config->'relative_path', schedule.config->'path'),
        'file_pattern', schedule.config->'file_pattern', 'format', schedule.config->'format',
        'max_files', schedule.config->'max_files', 'max_bytes', schedule.config->'max_bytes')
      ELSE jsonb_build_object(
        'root_alias', schedule.config->'root_alias',
        'relative_path', COALESCE(schedule.config->'relative_path', schedule.config->'unc_path'),
        'file_pattern', schedule.config->'file_pattern',
        'credential_ref', COALESCE(schedule.config->'credential_ref', schedule.config->'secret_key'),
        'format', schedule.config->'format', 'max_files', schedule.config->'max_files',
        'max_bytes', schedule.config->'max_bytes')
    END,
    claimed.attempts,
    claimed.lease_expires_at;
END;
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb

 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE p private.dpw_attachment_retention_defaults%ROWTYPE;t private.dpw_attachment_retention_overrides%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO p FROM private.dpw_attachment_retention_defaults WHERE singleton=true;
 IF NOT FOUND OR p.period_days<=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.retention_default_missing';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO t FROM private.dpw_attachment_retention_overrides WHERE tenant_id=_tenant;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('policy_id',CASE WHEN t.period_days IS NOT NULL AND t.period_days>=p.period_days THEN t.policy_id ELSE p.policy_id END,
 'version',CASE WHEN t.period_days IS NOT NULL AND t.period_days>=p.period_days THEN t.version::text ELSE p.version::text END,
 'source',CASE WHEN t.period_days IS NOT NULL AND t.period_days>=p.period_days THEN 'tenant' ELSE 'platform' END,
 'period_days',greatest(p.period_days,coalesce(t.period_days,p.period_days)),
 'platform_version',p.version::text,'tenant_override_version',t.version::text,
 'effective_at',greatest(p.effective_at,coalesce(t.effective_at,p.effective_at)));
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.copilot_broker_context(_verified_actor uuid, _verified_aal text, _verified_expires_at timestamp with time zone, _tenant_id uuid, _scope copilot_scope, _thread_id uuid, _request_ip text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE policy jsonb; choices jsonb;
BEGIN
 policy:=private.copilot_broker_authorize(_verified_actor,_verified_aal,_verified_expires_at,_tenant_id,_scope,_thread_id,_request_ip);
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',q.id,'label',q.label,'provider',q.provider,'model',q.model,
   'available',true,'reason',NULL,'maxInputTokens',q.max_input,'maxOutputTokens',q.max_output) ORDER BY q.priority,q.id),'[]')
 INTO choices FROM (
  SELECT l.id,coalesce(l.display_name,l.provider::text) AS label,l.provider::text AS provider,l.model AS model,l.priority,
    least(c.max_input_tokens,c.context_window-c.max_output_tokens) AS max_input,least(c.max_output_tokens,4096) AS max_output
  FROM public.llm_providers l JOIN public.ai_model_catalog c ON c.id=l.model_catalog_id AND c.model_key=l.model
  JOIN public.ai_provider_instances i ON i.id=l.provider_instance_id AND i.id=c.provider_instance_id
  JOIN public.ai_provider_registry reg ON reg.code=i.provider_code AND reg.enabled
  JOIN LATERAL(SELECT pr.* FROM public.ai_model_pricing pr WHERE pr.provider_code=i.provider_code AND pr.model_key=c.model_key
    AND pr.active AND pr.currency='USD' AND pr.effective_at<=clock_timestamp()
    AND (pr.expires_at IS NULL OR pr.expires_at>clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY pr.effective_at DESC,pr.id LIMIT 1) rate ON true
  WHERE l.is_active AND l.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _tenant_id AND i.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _tenant_id
    AND l.base_url IS NOT NULL AND l.base_url LIKE 'https://%' AND i.vault_secret_id IS NOT NULL
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.app_vault_secrets sv WHERE sv.id=i.vault_secret_id AND sv.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _tenant_id
      AND sv.scope=(CASE WHEN _tenant_id IS NULL THEN 'platform' ELSE 'tenant' END) AND sv.secret_class::text='llm_api_key'
      AND sv.name=upper(coalesce(nullif(l.key_secret_name,''),l.provider::text)))
    AND l.scope::text=(CASE WHEN _tenant_id IS NULL THEN 'platform' ELSE 'tenant' END)
    AND c.approval_status='approved' AND c.availability_status IN ('available','limited') AND i.status='active'
    AND c.max_input_tokens>0 AND c.max_output_tokens>0 AND c.context_window>c.max_output_tokens
    AND (jsonb_array_length(policy->'allowed_models')=0 OR (policy->'allowed_models') ? c.model_key OR (policy->'allowed_models') ? (i.provider_code||'/'||c.model_key))
    AND rate.input_usd_per_1m>0 AND rate.output_usd_per_1m>0
    AND rate.input_usd_per_1m::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') AND rate.output_usd_per_1m::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
  ORDER BY l.priority ASC NULLS LAST,l.id LIMIT 100
 )q;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('actor_id',_verified_actor,'tenant_id',_tenant_id,'scope',_scope,'thread_id',_thread_id,
   'allowed',true,'write_proposals',(policy->>'write_proposals')::boolean,'providers',choices);
END $function$

functions.name: claim_tenant_signup_events
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_tenant_signup_events(_batch_size integer DEFAULT 20, _lease_seconds integer DEFAULT 120)
 RETURNS TABLE(event_id uuid, request_id uuid, tenant_id uuid, user_id uuid, event_name text, occurred_at timestamp with time zone, lease_token uuid, lease_until timestamp with time zone, attempt_count integer, idempotency_key text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF _batch_size IS NULL OR _batch_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100
     OR _lease_seconds IS NULL OR _lease_seconds NOT BETWEEN 30 AND 900 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid claim bounds' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH picked AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT e.id FROM public.tenant_signup_events e
    WHERE e.notified_at IS NULL AND e.dead_lettered_at IS NULL
      AND e.next_attempt_at <= now()
      AND (e.lease_until IS NULL OR e.lease_until <= now())
    ORDER BY e.next_attempt_at,e.occurred_at,e.id
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT _batch_size
  )
  UPDATE public.tenant_signup_events e
    SET lease_token=pg_catalog.gen_random_uuid(),
        lease_until=now()+make_interval(secs=>_lease_seconds),
        attempt_count=e.attempt_count+1
  FROM picked p WHERE e.id=p.id
  RETURNING e.id,e.request_id,e.tenant_id,e.user_id,e.event_name,e.occurred_at,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_tenant_email_domain_change()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF TG_OP='DELETE' THEN
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m
               WHERE m.tenant_id=OLD.tenant_id AND NOT public.is_platform_admin(m.user_id)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Remove tenant memberships before changing its email domain'
        USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN OLD;
  END IF;
  IF (OLD.domain IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.domain OR OLD.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.tenant_id
      OR (OLD.status='verified' AND NEW.status<>'verified'))
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m
                 WHERE m.tenant_id=OLD.tenant_id AND NOT public.is_platform_admin(m.user_id)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Remove tenant memberships before changing its email domain'
      USING ERRCODE='23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: recon_authoritative_access_decision_as
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.recon_authoritative_access_decision_as(_actor uuid, _recon uuid, _action text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_definition public.recon_definitions%ROWTYPE;
  v_member_role text;
  v_owner_count integer;
  v_action text;
BEGIN
  IF _actor IS NULL OR _recon IS NULL OR _action IS NULL
     OR _action NOT IN ('view','read','run','edit','approve') THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  SELECT d.* INTO v_definition
  FROM public.recon_definitions d
  WHERE d.id = _recon;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF (v_definition.retired_at IS NOT NULL OR v_definition.status = 'archived')
     AND _action NOT IN ('view','read') THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  -- Keep exact legacy parity with the auth.uid()-bound evaluator.
  IF v_definition.access_mode = 'legacy_passthrough' THEN
    IF NOT private.is_platform_admin(_actor) AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members
      WHERE tenant_id=v_definition.tenant_id AND user_id=_actor AND active=true
    ) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
    RETURN private.user_can_access_recon(
      _actor,
      v_definition.id,
      CASE WHEN _action = 'view' THEN 'read' ELSE _action END
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT tm.role::text INTO v_member_role
  FROM public.tenant_members tm
  WHERE tm.tenant_id = v_definition.tenant_id
    AND tm.user_id = _actor
    AND tm.active = true
  LIMIT 1;
  IF v_member_role IS NULL AND NOT (
    v_definition.access_mode = 'mapped_exact' AND _action IN ('view','read')
    AND private.recon_platform_support_grant_active(_actor, v_definition.tenant_id, 'recon_read')
  ) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  IF v_definition.access_mode = 'unmapped_pending' THEN
    IF v_member_role <> 'tenant_admin' THEN
      RETURN false;
    END IF;
    IF _action IN ('view','read') THEN
      RETURN true;
    END IF;
    RETURN _action IN ('edit','run')
      AND v_definition.environment IN ('development','staging')
      AND v_definition.governance_state IN ('development_draft','staging_copy');
  END IF;

  IF v_definition.access_mode <> 'mapped_exact' THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  -- A mapped definition requires at least one valid, tenant-local owner BU.
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_owner_count
  FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_bu
  WHERE owner_bu.tenant_id = v_definition.tenant_id
    AND owner_bu.recon_id = v_definition.id;
  IF v_owner_count = 0 OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_bu
    LEFT JOIN public.business_units owner_unit
      ON owner_unit.id = owner_bu.bu_id
     AND owner_unit.tenant_id = owner_bu.tenant_id
    WHERE owner_bu.recon_id = v_definition.id
      AND (owner_bu.tenant_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_definition.tenant_id
        OR owner_unit.id IS NULL
        OR owner_unit.is_archived)
  ) THEN
    RETURN false;
  END IF;

  -- Tenant-admin override is deliberately tenant-scoped. Approval separation
  -- of duties remains the responsibility of its calling workflow.
  IF v_member_role = 'tenant_admin' THEN
    RETURN true;
  END IF;

  IF _action IN ('view','read')
     AND private.recon_platform_support_grant_active(_actor, v_definition.tenant_id, 'recon_read') THEN
    RETURN true;
  END IF;

  v_action := CASE WHEN _action IN ('view','read') THEN 'view' ELSE _action END;

  -- Direct grants require a current assignment to the owner BU, or to an
  -- ancestor whose assignment explicitly inherits descendants.
  RETURN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
    JOIN public.recon_definition_business_units owner_bu
      ON owner_bu.tenant_id = grant_row.tenant_id
     AND owner_bu.recon_id = grant_row.recon_id
     AND owner_bu.bu_id = grant_row.bu_id
    JOIN public.business_units owner_unit
      ON owner_unit.id = owner_bu.bu_id
     AND owner_unit.tenant_id = owner_bu.tenant_id
     AND NOT owner_unit.is_archived
    WHERE grant_row.tenant_id = v_definition.tenant_id
      AND grant_row.recon_id = v_definition.id
      AND grant_row.action = v_action
      AND grant_row.principal_type = 'user'
      AND grant_row.principal_id = _actor
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.bu_user_assignments assignment
        JOIN public.business_units assigned_unit
          ON assigned_unit.id = assignment.bu_id
         AND assigned_unit.tenant_id = assignment.tenant_id
         AND NOT assigned_unit.is_archived
        WHERE assignment.tenant_id = v_definition.tenant_id
          AND assignment.user_id = _actor
          AND (owner_unit.id = assigned_unit.id
            OR (assignment.inherit_descendants AND owner_unit.path <@ assigned_unit.path))
      )
  ) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
    JOIN public.recon_definition_business_units owner_bu
      ON owner_bu.tenant_id = grant_row.tenant_id
     AND owner_bu.recon_id = grant_row.recon_id
     AND owner_bu.bu_id = grant_row.bu_id
    JOIN public.business_units owner_unit
      ON owner_unit.id = owner_bu.bu_id
     AND owner_unit.tenant_id = owner_bu.tenant_id
     AND NOT owner_unit.is_archived
    JOIN public.tenant_groups grant_group
      ON grant_group.id = grant_row.principal_id
     AND grant_group.tenant_id = grant_row.tenant_id
    JOIN public.tenant_group_members group_member
      ON group_member.group_id = grant_group.id
     AND group_member.user_id = _actor
    JOIN public.bu_group_assignments assignment
      ON assignment.group_id = grant_group.id
     AND assignment.tenant_id = v_definition.tenant_id
    JOIN public.business_units assigned_unit
      ON assigned_unit.id = assignment.bu_id
     AND assigned_unit.tenant_id = assignment.tenant_id
     AND NOT assigned_unit.is_archived
    WHERE grant_row.tenant_id = v_definition.tenant_id
      AND grant_row.recon_id = v_definition.id
      AND grant_row.action = v_action
      AND grant_row.principal_type = 'group'
      AND (owner_unit.id = assigned_unit.id
        OR (assignment.inherit_descendants AND owner_unit.path <@ assigned_unit.path))
  );
END
$function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mkt_cta_analytics(_days integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  pii_reader boolean := public.has_mkt_pii_read_access();
  since_at timestamptz;
  result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT (
    public.has_mkt_role(auth.uid(), 'super_admin'::public.mkt_admin_role)
    OR public.has_mkt_role(auth.uid(), 'sales_admin'::public.mkt_admin_role)
    OR public.has_mkt_role(auth.uid(), 'marketing_admin'::public.mkt_admin_role)
    OR public.has_mkt_role(auth.uid(), 'ai_admin'::public.mkt_admin_role)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF _days IS NULL OR _days NOT IN (1, 7, 30, 90) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported range' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  since_at := now() - make_interval(days => _days);

  WITH totals_by_type AS (
    SELECT event_type, count(*) AS total
    FROM public.mkt_cta_events
    WHERE created_at >= since_at
    GROUP BY event_type
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'restricted', NOT pii_reader,
    'totals', jsonb_build_object(
      'view', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR coalesce((SELECT total FROM totals_by_type WHERE event_type = 'view'), 0) >= 5
        THEN coalesce((SELECT total FROM totals_by_type WHERE event_type = 'view'), 0) ELSE NULL END,
      'click', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR coalesce((SELECT total FROM totals_by_type WHERE event_type = 'click'), 0) >= 5
        THEN coalesce((SELECT total FROM totals_by_type WHERE event_type = 'click'), 0) ELSE NULL END,
      'form_submit', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR coalesce((SELECT total FROM totals_by_type WHERE event_type = 'form_submit'), 0) >= 5
        THEN coalesce((SELECT total FROM totals_by_type WHERE event_type = 'form_submit'), 0) ELSE NULL END,
      'pack_download', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR coalesce((SELECT total FROM totals_by_type WHERE event_type = 'pack_download'), 0) >= 5
        THEN coalesce((SELECT total FROM totals_by_type WHERE event_type = 'pack_download'), 0) ELSE NULL END
    ),
    'byCta', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'cta_id', cta_id,
        'view', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR view_count >= 5 THEN view_count ELSE NULL END,
        'click', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR click_count >= 5 THEN click_count ELSE NULL END,
        'form_submit', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR form_count >= 5 THEN form_count ELSE NULL END,
        'pack_download', CASE WHEN pii_reader OR download_count >= 5 THEN download_count ELSE NULL END
      ) ORDER BY click_count + form_count + download_count DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT CASE WHEN e.cta_id IN ('due_diligence_cta','buyers_guide_form','due_diligence_page','due_diligence_form','due_diligence_pack')
          THEN e.cta_id ELSE '(other)' END AS cta_id,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'view') AS view_count,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'click') AS click_count,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'form_submit') AS form_count,
          count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.event_type = 'pack_download') AS download_count
        FROM public.mkt_cta_events e
        WHERE e.created_at >= since_at
        GROUP BY 1
      ) AS grouped_ctas
      WHERE pii_reader OR view_count + click_count + form_count + download_count >= 5
    ),
    'bySource', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('source', source, 'total', total) ORDER BY total DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT CASE WHEN e.source IN ('book_demo','contact_form','due_diligence_page','home_popup','buyers_guide_teaser','home_inline','home_procurement_pathway','security_page_hero','security_aligned_vs_certified','roi_estimator','other','chatbot','talk_to_falcon')
          THEN e.source ELSE '(other)' END AS source,
          count(*) AS total
        FROM public.mkt_cta_events e
        WHERE e.created_at >= since_at
        GROUP BY 1
      ) AS grouped_sources
      WHERE pii_reader OR total >= 5
    ),
    'byRegion', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('region', region, 'total', total) ORDER BY total DESC), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT CASE WHEN e.region ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' THEN e.region ELSE '(other)' END AS region,
          count(*) AS total
        FROM public.mkt_cta_events e
        WHERE e.created_at >= since_at
        GROUP BY 1
      ) AS grouped_regions
      WHERE pii_reader OR total >= 5
    ),
    'recent', (
      SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('day', day, 'event_type', event_type, 'total', total) ORDER BY day DESC, event_type), '[]'::jsonb)
      FROM (
        SELECT to_char(e.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS day,
               e.event_type,
               count(*) AS total
        FROM public.mkt_cta_events e
        WHERE e.created_at >= since_at
        GROUP BY 1, 2
      ) AS grouped_recent
      WHERE pii_reader OR total >= 5
    )
  ) INTO result;

  RETURN result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_api_token_principal_classification_requests(_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id
      AND m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.active AND m.role='tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',r.id,'token_id',r.token_id,'kind',r.requested_kind,
    'subject_user_id',r.subject_user_id,'service_principal_id',r.service_principal_id,
    'owner_approval_ref',r.owner_approval_ref,'evidence_ref',r.evidence_ref,
    'reason',r.reason,'requested_by',r.requested_by,'requested_at',r.requested_at,
    'status',r.status,'decided_by',r.decided_by,'decided_at',r.decided_at,
    'decision_receipt_id',(SELECT a.id FROM public.api_token_principal_decision_audit a
      WHERE a.request_id=r.id AND a.event IN ('approved','rejected') LIMIT 1)
  ) ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_result
  FROM public.api_token_principal_requests r WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant_id;
  RETURN v_result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpdi_reviewer_visible(_tenant uuid, _kind text, _request uuid, _actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb:=private.dpdi_reviewer_reference(_tenant,_kind,_request);j private.dpdi_jobs%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO j FROM private.dpdi_jobs WHERE id=(r->>'job_id')::uuid AND tenant_id=_tenant AND setup_id=(r->>'setup_id')::uuid;
 RETURN r IS NOT NULL AND j.id IS NOT NULL AND _actor IS DISTINCT FROM (r->>'requested_by')::uuid AND _actor IS DISTINCT FROM j.actor_id AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members tm WHERE tm.tenant_id=_tenant AND tm.user_id=_actor AND tm.active AND tm.role='tenant_admin')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_groups g JOIN public.tenant_group_members m ON m.group_id=g.id WHERE g.id=(r->>'approver_group_id')::uuid AND g.tenant_id=_tenant AND m.user_id=_actor)
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_pipelines p WHERE p.id=(j.snapshot->>'pipeline_id')::uuid AND p.tenant_id=_tenant AND p.lifecycle_state<>'archived' AND private.data_prep_pipeline_scope_allows(_actor,_tenant,p.id,'view') IS TRUE)
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.dpdi_run_inputs i JOIN private.dpd_original_intents o ON o.id=i.original_file_id WHERE i.job_id=j.id AND (o.created_by=_actor OR private.dpw_source_allows(_actor,_tenant,i.data_source_id,'view') IS DISTINCT FROM true));
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.request_api_token_principal_classification(_tenant_id uuid, _token_id uuid, _kind text, _subject_user_id uuid, _service_principal_id uuid, _owner_approval_ref text, _evidence_ref text, _reason text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_actor uuid:=auth.uid(); v_request uuid; v_token public.api_tokens%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR _token_id IS NULL
    OR _kind NOT IN ('user_delegated','tenant_machine')
    OR _owner_approval_ref !~ '^FVI-[A-Z0-9-]{8,80}$'
    OR _evidence_ref !~ '^FVI-[A-Z0-9-]{8,80}$'
    OR _reason IS NULL OR char_length(btrim(_reason)) NOT BETWEEN 10 AND 500
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m
      WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND m.user_id=v_actor AND m.active
        AND m.role='tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'classification request is not authorized' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_token FROM public.api_tokens t
    WHERE t.id=_token_id AND t.tenant_id=_tenant_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_token.principal_kind<>'unclassified' OR v_token.revoked_at IS NOT NULL
    OR (v_token.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND v_token.expires_at<=now())
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'token is not eligible for classification' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF (_kind='user_delegated' AND (_subject_user_id IS NULL OR _service_principal_id IS NOT NULL
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m
        WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND m.user_id=_subject_user_id AND m.active)))
    OR (_kind='tenant_machine' AND (_subject_user_id IS NOT NULL OR _service_principal_id IS NULL
      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.api_service_principals p
        WHERE p.id=_service_principal_id AND p.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND p.active)))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'designated subject is unavailable in this tenant' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.api_token_principal_requests(
    tenant_id,token_id,requested_kind,subject_user_id,service_principal_id,
    owner_approval_ref,evidence_ref,reason,requested_by)
  VALUES (_tenant_id,_token_id,_kind,_subject_user_id,_service_principal_id,
    _owner_approval_ref,_evidence_ref,btrim(_reason),v_actor)
  RETURNING id INTO v_request;
  INSERT INTO public.api_token_principal_decision_audit(
    request_id,tenant_id,token_id,event,actor_id,principal_kind,
    subject_user_id,service_principal_id,owner_approval_ref,evidence_ref)
  VALUES (v_request,_tenant_id,_token_id,'requested',v_actor,_kind,
    _subject_user_id,_service_principal_id,_owner_approval_ref,_evidence_ref);
  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(actor_user_id,tenant_id,scope,action,resource_type,resource_id,context)
  VALUES (v_actor,_tenant_id,'tenant','api_token.principal.requested','api_token',_token_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('request_id',v_request,'kind',_kind,'owner_approval_ref',_owner_approval_ref,
      'evidence_ref',_evidence_ref));
  RETURN v_request;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_api_token_principal_admin(_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_tokens jsonb; v_members jsonb; v_services jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id
      AND m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.active AND m.role='tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
    'id',t.id,'name',t.name,'scopes',t.scopes,'principal_kind',t.principal_kind,
    'subject_user_id',t.subject_user_id,'service_principal_id',t.service_principal_id,
    'revoked',t.revoked_at IS NOT NULL,'expired',t.expires_at IS NOT NULL AND t.expires_at<=now()
  ) ORDER BY t.name),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_tokens
  FROM public.api_tokens t WHERE t.tenant_id=_tenant_id;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',m.user_id,'role',m.role)
    ORDER BY m.user_id),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_members
  FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND m.active;
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',p.id,'name',p.name)
    ORDER BY p.name),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_services
  FROM public.api_service_principals p WHERE p.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND p.active;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('actor_user_id',auth.uid(),'tokens',v_tokens,
    'active_members',v_members,'active_service_principals',v_services,
    'requests',public.list_api_token_principal_classification_requests(_tenant_id));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.rs_carry_candidates(_tenant uuid, _run uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE q private.rs_requests%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN SELECT * INTO q FROM private.rs_requests WHERE run_id=_run AND tenant_id=_tenant AND actor_id=auth.uid();
 IF NOT FOUND OR q.phase<>'completed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rs.owned_completed_request_required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 PERFORM private.rs_actor(_tenant,q.definition_id,'edit');
 RETURN coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('new_case_id',n.native_id,'source_case_id',prior.native_id,'source_run_id',prior.run_id))
 FROM private.rs_groups n CROSS JOIN LATERAL(SELECT o.native_id,o.run_id FROM private.rs_groups o
 JOIN private.rs_requests oq ON oq.run_id=o.run_id AND oq.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND oq.definition_id=q.definition_id AND oq.phase='completed'
 WHERE o.match_status='break' AND o.identity_key=n.identity_key AND o.run_id<>_run AND oq.created_at<q.created_at
 ORDER BY oq.created_at DESC,oq.run_id DESC LIMIT 1) prior WHERE n.run_id=_run AND n.match_status='break'),'[]');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_recon_run_revision_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.approved_revision_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_revision_id
     OR NEW.approved_revision_number IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_revision_number
     OR NEW.approved_revision_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.approved_revision_sha256 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'reconciliation run approved revision binding is immutable'
      USING ERRCODE = '23514';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.status_rollup_today()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  WITH component_days AS (
    SELECT id AS component_id, (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day FROM public.status_components
    UNION
    SELECT component_id, (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date FROM public.status_probe_runs
    -- Only recompute full retained UTC days: the oldest partial retention day
    -- must not overwrite its previously finalized complete rollup.
    WHERE created_at >= (((now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - 6)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AND created_at <= now()
    UNION
    -- Incident/maintenance floors must also exist on days without any probes.
    SELECT c.id, d.day FROM public.status_components c
    CROSS JOIN (SELECT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date - n AS day FROM generate_series(0,6) n) d
    WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.status_incidents i
      WHERE (i.component_id IS NULL OR i.component_id = c.id)
        AND i.started_at < LEAST((d.day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', now())
        AND COALESCE(i.resolved_at, now()) > (d.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.status_maintenance_windows m
        WHERE m.state <> 'cancelled' AND (m.component_id IS NULL OR m.component_id = c.id)
          AND m.scheduled_start < LEAST((d.day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', now())
          AND m.scheduled_end > (d.day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))
  ), day_bounds AS (
    SELECT *, day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS day_start,
      (day + 1)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS day_end FROM component_days
  ), classified AS (
    SELECT p.*, EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.status_maintenance_windows m
      WHERE m.state <> 'cancelled' AND (m.component_id IS NULL OR m.component_id = p.component_id)
        AND p.created_at >= m.scheduled_start AND p.created_at < m.scheduled_end
    ) AS excluded FROM public.status_probe_runs p WHERE p.created_at <= now()
  ), measurements AS (
    SELECT d.*, a.total, a.ok, a.last_probe_at, a.worst_level,
      i.incident_count, i.incident_level, EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.status_maintenance_windows m WHERE m.state <> 'cancelled'
        AND (m.component_id IS NULL OR m.component_id = d.component_id)
        AND m.scheduled_start < LEAST(d.day_end, now()) AND m.scheduled_end > d.day_start
      ) AS has_maintenance
    FROM day_bounds d
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.excluded)::int AS total,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT p.excluded AND p.success)::int AS ok,
        MAX(p.created_at) AS last_probe_at,
        MAX(CASE WHEN p.success THEN 0 WHEN p.error IS NOT NULL OR p.status_code >= 500 THEN 3 WHEN p.status_code >= 400 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
          FILTER (WHERE NOT p.excluded) AS worst_level
      FROM classified p WHERE p.component_id = d.component_id AND p.created_at >= d.day_start AND p.created_at < d.day_end
    ) a
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS incident_count,
        MAX(CASE severity WHEN 'critical' THEN 3 WHEN 'major' THEN 2 WHEN 'minor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS incident_level
      FROM public.status_incidents i WHERE (i.component_id IS NULL OR i.component_id = d.component_id)
        AND i.started_at < LEAST(d.day_end, now()) AND COALESCE(i.resolved_at, now()) > d.day_start
    ) i
  )
  INSERT INTO public.status_component_history (component_id, day, uptime_pct, worst_state, incident_count, probe_count, last_probe_at)
  SELECT component_id, day, CASE WHEN total > 0 THEN ROUND(100.0 * ok / total, 3) ELSE NULL END,
    CASE GREATEST(COALESCE(worst_level, 0), COALESCE(incident_level, 0))
      WHEN 3 THEN 'major_outage' WHEN 2 THEN 'partial_outage' WHEN 1 THEN 'degraded_performance'
      ELSE CASE WHEN has_maintenance THEN 'maintenance' ELSE 'operational' END END,
    incident_count, total, last_probe_at FROM measurements
  ON CONFLICT (component_id, day) DO UPDATE SET
    uptime_pct = EXCLUDED.uptime_pct, worst_state = EXCLUDED.worst_state,
    incident_count = EXCLUDED.incident_count, probe_count = EXCLUDED.probe_count,
    last_probe_at = EXCLUDED.last_probe_at;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.rs_signal_head(_tenant uuid, _definition uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE q private.rs_requests%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 -- Invoked only after authenticated admission/completion/failure. Target is the
 -- exact next persisted intent, never an arbitrary recipient or actor alias.
 PERFORM private.rs_actor(_tenant,_definition,'run');
 SELECT * INTO q FROM private.rs_requests WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND definition_id=_definition AND phase='queued' ORDER BY created_at,run_id LIMIT 1;
 IF FOUND AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_runs WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND definition_id=_definition AND status='running') THEN
  INSERT INTO public.recon_execution_dispatch_events(tenant_id,definition_id,actor_id,run_id,kind)
  VALUES(q.tenant_id,q.definition_id,q.actor_id,q.run_id,'ready_for_authenticated_dispatch') ON CONFLICT(run_id,kind) DO NOTHING;
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.rs_schema_profile(_tenant uuid, _source uuid, _mapping jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE p private.rs_schema_profiles%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated' OR private.rlnext_account_allowed(auth.uid(),_tenant) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR private.data_source_child_allows(auth.uid(),_tenant,_source,'view') IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rs.schema_source_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO p FROM private.rs_schema_profiles WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND data_source_id=_source AND column_mapping=_mapping
 AND qualification->>'state'='native_qualified' AND qualification->>'kind'='authoritative_schema_configuration'
 AND qualification->>'producer_source_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' ORDER BY version DESC;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NULL;END IF;
 -- Ambiguous profile selections require an explicit source configuration choice.
 IF (SELECT count(*) FROM private.rs_schema_profiles WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND data_source_id=_source AND column_mapping=_mapping
 AND qualification->>'state'='native_qualified' AND qualification->>'kind'='authoritative_schema_configuration')<>1
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rs.explicit_schema_profile_required' USING ERRCODE='PT409';END IF;
 IF p.logical_side='' OR jsonb_array_length(p.fields)=0 OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'name') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.fields) x)<>jsonb_array_length(p.fields)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.fields) f WHERE coalesce(f->>'name','')='' OR (f->>'json_type' IN('string','number','boolean','object','array')) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR jsonb_typeof(f->'required') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean')
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'rs.qualified_schema_invalid' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('profile_id',p.profile_id,'profile_version',p.version,'logical_side',p.logical_side,'fields',p.fields,
 'column_mapping',p.column_mapping,'schema_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_object('logical_side',p.logical_side,'fields',p.fields,'column_mapping',p.column_mapping)::text,'UTF8')),'hex'));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpw_recon_schema_contract(_tenant uuid, _definition uuid, _revision uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE contract jsonb;
BEGIN
 contract:=private.rs_recon_input_contracts(_tenant,_definition,_revision);
 -- Existing fixed approved pins do not borrow invented expected types. DPW's
 -- preflight requires typed contracts for EACH selected prepared_dataset side.
 IF jsonb_typeof(contract->'input_contracts') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpw.approved_typed_input_contract_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 RETURN contract;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_copilot_binding_options(_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NOT coalesce(private.can_configure_copilot_binding(auth.uid(),_tenant_id),false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'copilot.forbidden'; END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object(
   'providers',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'provider',provider,'model',model,
     'model_catalog_id',model_catalog_id,'provider_instance_id',provider_instance_id) ORDER BY id),'[]'::jsonb)
     FROM public.llm_providers WHERE tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _tenant_id AND is_active
       AND scope::text=CASE WHEN _tenant_id IS NULL THEN 'platform' ELSE 'tenant' END),
   'models',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'model_key',c.model_key,'provider_instance_id',i.id,
     'provider_code',i.provider_code,'display_name',c.display_name,'max_input_tokens',c.max_input_tokens,'max_output_tokens',c.max_output_tokens,
     'priced',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.ai_model_pricing price WHERE price.provider_code=i.provider_code AND price.model_key=c.model_key
       AND price.active AND price.currency='USD' AND price.effective_at<=clock_timestamp() AND (price.expires_at IS NULL OR price.expires_at>clock_timestamp())
       AND price.input_usd_per_1m>0 AND price.output_usd_per_1m>0)) ORDER BY c.id),'[]'::jsonb)
     FROM public.ai_model_catalog c JOIN public.ai_provider_instances i ON i.id=c.provider_instance_id
     JOIN public.ai_provider_registry reg ON reg.code=i.provider_code
     WHERE i.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _tenant_id AND i.status='active' AND reg.enabled
       AND c.approval_status='approved' AND c.availability_status IN ('available','limited')));
END $function$

  'bu_id',_item.governance_snapshot->'group'->>'bu_id',
  'bu_name',(SELECT string_agg(b->>'name',', ' ORDER BY b->>'name') FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(_item.governance_snapshot->'business_units','[]')) b),
  'workspace_id',_item.subject_scope->>'workspace_id','workspace_name',_item.governance_snapshot->'workspace'->>'name',
  'environment',CASE WHEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT r->>'environment') FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(_item.governance_snapshot->'resource_grants','[]')) r WHERE r->>'environment' IS NOT NULL)=1 THEN (SELECT min(r->>'environment') FROM jsonb_array_elements(_item.governance_snapshot->'resource_grants') r) ELSE NULL END,

  'current_rights',coalesce(_item.governance_snapshot->'current_rights','[]'),

  'decided_at',_item.decided_at,'version',_item.governance_version,'snapshot_hash',_item.governance_snapshot_hash,

  'reason',_item.decision_note,'correlation_id',_item.governance_correlation_id,'historical',_item.governance_snapshot IS NULL,
  'effective_scope',jsonb_build_object('workspace_context_only',true,'group_membership_scope','tenant group; all existing group grants across workspaces',
    'resource_grants',coalesce(_item.governance_snapshot->'resource_grants','[]')))

AS $function$

   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_groups g JOIN public.tenant_group_members gm ON gm.group_id=g.id

         WHERE a.group_id=g.id AND a.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND NOT b.is_archived)
        OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units b WHERE b.id=g.bu_id AND b.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND NOT b.is_archived)))
   AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.effective_user_permissions(auth.uid(),_item.tenant_id,NULL))

functions.name: governance_review_options_scope
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.governance_review_options_scope(_input jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, label text, group_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE t uuid:=(_input->>'tenant_id')::uuid; kind text:=_input->>'kind';
 b uuid:=(_input->>'bu_id')::uuid; g uuid:=(_input->>'group_id')::uuid; w uuid:=(_input->>'workspace_id')::uuid;
BEGIN
 PERFORM private.governance_review_assert_member(t,true);
 IF kind IS NULL OR kind NOT IN ('business_units','groups','workspaces','members','reviewers') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported option kind' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF b IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units WHERE tenant_id=t AND business_units.id=b AND NOT is_archived)
   OR g IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_groups WHERE tenant_id=t AND tenant_groups.id=g)
   OR w IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.workspaces WHERE tenant_id=t AND workspaces.id=w AND status='active') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Selected option is outside current scope' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF kind IN ('members','reviewers') AND g IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Select a group first' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 IF kind='business_units' THEN
   RETURN QUERY SELECT x.id,x.name,NULL::uuid FROM public.business_units x WHERE x.tenant_id=t AND NOT x.is_archived;
 ELSIF kind='groups' THEN
   RETURN QUERY SELECT x.id,x.name,x.id FROM public.tenant_groups x WHERE x.tenant_id=t AND
    (b IS NULL OR x.bu_id=b OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments a JOIN public.business_units target ON target.id=b
      JOIN public.business_units assigned ON assigned.id=a.bu_id AND assigned.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND NOT assigned.is_archived
      WHERE a.tenant_id=t AND a.group_id=x.id AND (a.bu_id=b OR (a.inherit_descendants AND target.path OPERATOR(public.<@) assigned.path))))
    AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units unit WHERE unit.id=x.bu_id AND unit.tenant_id=t AND NOT unit.is_archived)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments a JOIN public.business_units unit ON unit.id=a.bu_id AND unit.tenant_id=a.tenant_id WHERE a.tenant_id=t AND a.group_id=x.id AND NOT unit.is_archived));
 ELSIF kind='workspaces' THEN
   RETURN QUERY SELECT x.id,x.name,g FROM public.workspaces x WHERE x.tenant_id=t AND x.status='active' AND (b IS NULL OR x.business_unit_id=b)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units unit WHERE unit.id=x.business_unit_id AND unit.tenant_id=t AND NOT unit.is_archived)
    AND (g IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_groups tg WHERE tg.id=g AND tg.tenant_id=t AND tg.bu_id=x.business_unit_id)
      OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments a JOIN public.business_units assigned ON assigned.id=a.bu_id AND assigned.tenant_id=a.tenant_id
        JOIN public.business_units target ON target.id=x.business_unit_id AND target.tenant_id=t
        WHERE a.group_id=g AND a.tenant_id=t AND NOT assigned.is_archived AND (a.bu_id=target.id OR (a.inherit_descendants AND target.path OPERATOR(public.<@) assigned.path))));
 ELSIF kind='members' THEN
   RETURN QUERY SELECT m.user_id,NULL::text,g FROM public.tenant_group_members m JOIN public.tenant_members tm ON tm.user_id=m.user_id AND tm.tenant_id=t AND tm.active
    WHERE m.group_id=g AND (w IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace_members wm WHERE wm.workspace_id=w AND wm.tenant_id=t AND wm.user_id=m.user_id));
 ELSE
   RETURN QUERY SELECT tm.user_id,NULL::text,g FROM public.tenant_members tm WHERE tm.tenant_id=t AND tm.active
    AND tm.user_id<>auth.uid() AND tm.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM (_input->>'subject_user_id')::uuid
    AND tm.role::text='tenant_admin';
 END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.wfm_platform_factor_attest()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=auth.uid(); claims jsonb:=auth.jwt(); expires numeric;
BEGIN
 IF actor IS NULL OR auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated'
 OR claims->>'aal' IS DISTINCT FROM 'aal2'
 OR jsonb_typeof(claims->'exp') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
 OR public.is_platform_admin(actor) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR private.rlnext_account_allowed(actor,NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR private.rlnext_has_verified_mfa(actor) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 expires:=(claims->>'exp')::numeric;
 IF expires<=extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()) THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 -- The native account helper intentionally tolerates unmanaged owners. Their
 -- current real user/factor is checked without creating a fictional account row.
 RETURN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id=actor
   AND (u.banned_until IS NULL OR u.banned_until<=clock_timestamp()));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ticket_audit()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='INSERT' THEN
   INSERT INTO public.audit_log(actor_user_id,tenant_id,scope,action,resource_type,resource_id,context)
    VALUES(auth.uid(),NEW.tenant_id,NEW.scope,'ticket.create','support_ticket',NEW.id::text,
      jsonb_build_object('ref',NEW.ref,'sla_snapshot',NEW.sla_snapshot,'assignee_id',NEW.assignee_id));
 ELSE
   IF to_jsonb(NEW)-'updated_at' IS DISTINCT FROM to_jsonb(OLD)-'updated_at' THEN
     INSERT INTO public.audit_log(actor_user_id,tenant_id,scope,action,resource_type,resource_id,context)
      VALUES(auth.uid(),NEW.tenant_id,NEW.scope,CASE WHEN NEW.sla_revision<>OLD.sla_revision THEN 'ticket.sla.assign' WHEN NEW.queue IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.queue THEN 'ticket.escalate' ELSE 'ticket.update' END,'support_ticket',NEW.id::text,
       jsonb_build_object('status_from',OLD.status,'status_to',NEW.status,'assignee_from',OLD.assignee_id,'assignee_to',NEW.assignee_id,
       'sla_revision',NEW.sla_revision,'sla_snapshot_from',OLD.sla_snapshot,'sla_snapshot',NEW.sla_snapshot,'first_response_at',NEW.first_response_at,'csat_score_from',OLD.csat_score,'csat_score_to',NEW.csat_score,'csat_comment_changed',NEW.csat_comment IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.csat_comment));
   END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_workspace_dashboard_team_scope(_tenant_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(team_scope_available boolean, definition_ids uuid[])
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_scope_available boolean;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.tenant_members member_row
    WHERE member_row.tenant_id = _tenant_id
      AND member_row.user_id = v_actor
      AND member_row.active = true
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Workspace dashboard team scope is unavailable'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- Distinguish a caller with a mapped BU/group team from an authorized team
  -- whose current mapping has no reconciliation rows.
  SELECT
    EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.bu_user_assignments user_assignment
      JOIN public.business_units assigned_unit
        ON assigned_unit.id = user_assignment.bu_id
       AND assigned_unit.tenant_id = user_assignment.tenant_id
       AND NOT assigned_unit.is_archived
      WHERE user_assignment.tenant_id = _tenant_id
        AND user_assignment.user_id = v_actor
    )
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM public.tenant_group_members group_member
      JOIN public.tenant_groups group_row
        ON group_row.id = group_member.group_id
       AND group_row.tenant_id = _tenant_id
      JOIN public.bu_group_assignments group_assignment
        ON group_assignment.group_id = group_row.id
       AND group_assignment.tenant_id = _tenant_id
      JOIN public.business_units assigned_unit
        ON assigned_unit.id = group_assignment.bu_id
       AND assigned_unit.tenant_id = _tenant_id
       AND NOT assigned_unit.is_archived
      WHERE group_member.user_id = v_actor
    )
  INTO v_scope_available;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    v_scope_available,
    coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT definition.id ORDER BY definition.id), ARRAY[]::uuid[])
  FROM public.recon_definitions definition
  WHERE definition.tenant_id = _tenant_id
    AND definition.access_mode = 'mapped_exact'
    AND private.recon_authoritative_access_decision(definition.id, 'view')
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_bu
        JOIN public.business_units owner_unit
          ON owner_unit.id = owner_bu.bu_id
         AND owner_unit.tenant_id = owner_bu.tenant_id
         AND NOT owner_unit.is_archived
        JOIN public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
          ON grant_row.tenant_id = owner_bu.tenant_id
         AND grant_row.recon_id = owner_bu.recon_id
         AND grant_row.bu_id = owner_bu.bu_id
        JOIN public.bu_user_assignments user_assignment
          ON user_assignment.tenant_id = owner_bu.tenant_id
         AND user_assignment.user_id = v_actor
        JOIN public.business_units assigned_unit
          ON assigned_unit.id = user_assignment.bu_id
         AND assigned_unit.tenant_id = user_assignment.tenant_id
         AND NOT assigned_unit.is_archived
        WHERE owner_bu.tenant_id = _tenant_id
          AND owner_bu.recon_id = definition.id
          AND grant_row.action IN ('view', 'read')
          AND grant_row.principal_type = 'user'
          AND grant_row.principal_id = v_actor
          AND (
            owner_unit.id = assigned_unit.id
            OR (user_assignment.inherit_descendants AND owner_unit.path <@ assigned_unit.path)
          )
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_bu
        JOIN public.business_units owner_unit
          ON owner_unit.id = owner_bu.bu_id
         AND owner_unit.tenant_id = owner_bu.tenant_id
         AND NOT owner_unit.is_archived
        JOIN public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
          ON grant_row.tenant_id = owner_bu.tenant_id
         AND grant_row.recon_id = owner_bu.recon_id
         AND grant_row.bu_id = owner_bu.bu_id
        JOIN public.tenant_groups grant_group
          ON grant_group.id = grant_row.principal_id
         AND grant_group.tenant_id = _tenant_id
        JOIN public.tenant_group_members group_member
          ON group_member.group_id = grant_group.id
         AND group_member.user_id = v_actor
        JOIN public.bu_group_assignments group_assignment
          ON group_assignment.group_id = grant_group.id
         AND group_assignment.tenant_id = _tenant_id
        JOIN public.business_units assigned_unit
          ON assigned_unit.id = group_assignment.bu_id
         AND assigned_unit.tenant_id = group_assignment.tenant_id
         AND NOT assigned_unit.is_archived
        WHERE owner_bu.tenant_id = _tenant_id
          AND owner_bu.recon_id = definition.id
          AND grant_row.action IN ('view', 'read')
          AND grant_row.principal_type = 'group'
          AND (
            owner_unit.id = assigned_unit.id
            OR (group_assignment.inherit_descendants AND owner_unit.path <@ assigned_unit.path)
          )
      )
    );
END
$function$

AS $function$
DECLARE f jsonb:=private.dpdi_reviewer_frame(_tenant,_kind,_request,_actor);r jsonb:=f->'reference';j private.dpdi_jobs%ROWTYPE;c public.data_prep_configuration_revisions%ROWTYPE;e private.dpdi_job_events%ROWTYPE;ctx private.dpd_request_contexts%ROWTYPE;available boolean:=f->>'availability'='available';
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO j FROM private.dpdi_jobs WHERE id=(f->>'job_id')::uuid;SELECT * INTO c FROM public.data_prep_configuration_revisions WHERE id=(f->>'configuration_id')::uuid;e:=private.dpdi_head(j.id);SELECT * INTO ctx FROM private.dpd_request_contexts WHERE id=_context AND tenant_id=_tenant AND actor_id=_actor;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('actor_id',_actor,'tenant_id',_tenant,'setup_id',j.setup_id,'request_id',_request,'request_key',r->>'request_key','kind',_kind,'status',r->>'status','requested_by',r->>'requested_by','approver_group_id',r->>'approver_group_id','decision',r->'decision','draft_version',j.draft_version,'pipeline_id',c.pipeline_id,'pipeline_version',c.pipeline_version,'availability',f->>'availability','can_decide',(f->>'can_decide')::boolean,'reason',f->'reason',
 'job',private.dpdi_dto(j)||jsonb_build_object('actor_id',_actor,'execution_actor_id',j.actor_id,'draft_version',j.draft_version,'configuration_id',c.id,'configuration_sha256',c.payload_sha256,'snapshot',CASE WHEN available AND _include_payload THEN j.snapshot ELSE NULL END),
 'configuration',jsonb_build_object('id',c.id,'pipeline_id',c.pipeline_id,'pipeline_version',c.pipeline_version,'payload_sha256',c.payload_sha256,'payload',CASE WHEN available AND _include_payload THEN c.payload ELSE NULL END),
 'quality',jsonb_build_object('phase',e.phase,'source_records',e.source_records::text,'blocking_records',e.blocking_records::text,'output_pages',e.output_pages,'output_root_sha256',e.output_root_sha256,'full_final_ack',e.phase IN('success','blocked'),'records_available',available),
 'current_context',jsonb_build_object('actor_id',_actor,'tenant_id',_tenant,'setup_id',j.setup_id,'request_id',_request,'kind',_kind,'operation',ctx.operation,'issued_at',ctx.created_at,'expires_at',ctx.expires_at,'snapshot_sha256',j.snapshot_sha256,'configuration_sha256',c.payload_sha256,'read_context_sha256',private.dpw_hash(jsonb_build_object('context',ctx.id,'actor',_actor,'tenant',_tenant,'setup',j.setup_id,'request',_request,'kind',_kind,'group',r->>'approver_group_id','configuration_sha256',c.payload_sha256,'snapshot_sha256',j.snapshot_sha256))));

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.rs_queue_snapshot(_tenant uuid, _definition uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=private.rs_actor(_tenant,_definition,'read');items jsonb;active_count integer;
BEGIN
 SELECT count(*) INTO active_count FROM public.recon_runs WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND definition_id=_definition AND status='running';
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',x.id,'public_id',x.run_uid,'status',x.status,'position',x.position,
  'progress',NULL,'owned_intent_available',x.intent_available,'dispatch_actor_is_current',x.run_by=actor) ORDER BY x.position),'[]') INTO items
 FROM (SELECT r.id,r.run_uid,r.status,r.run_by,q.run_id IS NOT NULL AS intent_available,
  row_number() OVER(ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.status='running' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,coalesce(q.created_at,r.started_at),r.id) AS position
  FROM public.recon_runs r LEFT JOIN private.rs_requests q ON q.run_id=r.id
  WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.definition_id=_definition AND r.status IN('queued','running')) x;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('actor_id',actor,'tenant_id',_tenant,'definition_id',_definition,'queue',items,
  'queue_complete',true,'active_count',active_count,'one_active_invariant',active_count<=1,'observed_at',statement_timestamp());
END $function$
