functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.governance_membership_scope(_tenant uuid, _bu uuid, _workspace uuid, _group uuid, _env text, _user uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb; rights text[];
BEGIN
  IF NOT private.governance_membership_active(_tenant,_user) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active tenant membership required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units WHERE id=_bu AND tenant_id=_tenant AND NOT is_archived)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_groups WHERE id=_group AND tenant_id=_tenant AND bu_id=_bu)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.workspaces WHERE id=_workspace AND tenant_id=_tenant AND business_unit_id=_bu AND status='active')
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_environments WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND env::text=_env AND is_active)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current tenant/BU/group/workspace/environment association required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  -- user_bu_scope has no platform-admin shortcut. An actual tenant admin is explicitly accepted.
  IF NOT private.governance_membership_active(_tenant,_user,true) AND (
    NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.user_bu_scope(_user,_tenant) s WHERE s=_bu)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.workspace_members WHERE workspace_id=_workspace AND tenant_id=_tenant AND user_id=_user)
  ) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current BU and workspace access required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_group_roles gr JOIN public.rbac_roles r ON r.id=gr.role_id
    WHERE gr.group_id=_group AND (NOT r.is_assignable OR (r.tenant_id IS NOT NULL AND r.tenant_id<>_tenant)
      OR r.key ~* '(admin|owner|platform|system)' OR r.key NOT IN ('tenant_analyst','tenant_viewer') AND r.is_system))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_group_roles gr JOIN public.rbac_role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id=gr.role_id
      JOIN public.permissions p ON p.id=rp.permission_id WHERE gr.group_id=_group
      AND ((p.category IN ('admin','security','billing') OR p.resource ~* '(^|[.])(role|user|group|tenant|platform|vault|environment)([.]|$)') AND p.action NOT IN ('read','view')))
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments WHERE group_id=_group AND (tenant_id<>_tenant OR role::text='bu_admin'))
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Administrative or cross-tenant group privileges cannot be requested' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=_group AND tenant_id<>_tenant)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_permissions g JOIN public.recon_definitions d ON d.id=g.recon_id WHERE g.principal_type='group' AND g.principal_id=_group AND d.tenant_id<>_tenant)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_group_id=_group AND tenant_id<>_tenant)
    OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_resource_bu_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=_group AND tenant_id<>_tenant)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Cross-tenant resource rights cannot be requested' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT permission_id ORDER BY permission_id),'{}'::text[]) INTO rights FROM (
    SELECT rp.permission_id FROM public.tenant_group_roles gr JOIN public.rbac_role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id=gr.role_id WHERE gr.group_id=_group
    UNION SELECT 'reconciliation:'||recon_id::text||':'||action FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=_group
    UNION SELECT 'legacy_reconciliation:'||recon_id::text||':'||permission FROM public.recon_permissions WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=_group
    UNION SELECT 'data_resource:'||registry_id::text||':'||action FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_group_id=_group
    UNION SELECT 'legacy_data_resource:'||resource_type||':'||resource_id::text||':'||action FROM public.data_resource_bu_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=_group
  ) all_rights;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'scope_label','Tenant group membership; existing group rights can apply across workspaces',
    'group', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'bu_id',bu_id,'is_system',is_system,'preset_key',preset_key) FROM public.tenant_groups WHERE id=_group),
    'workspace', (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'business_unit_id',business_unit_id,'status',status) FROM public.workspaces WHERE id=_workspace),
    'environment',_env,
    'requested_rights',to_jsonb(rights),
    'roles',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',r.id,'key',r.key,'tenant_id',r.tenant_id,'is_system',r.is_system,'is_assignable',r.is_assignable) ORDER BY r.id)
      FROM public.tenant_group_roles gr JOIN public.rbac_roles r ON r.id=gr.role_id WHERE gr.group_id=_group),'[]'::jsonb),
    'bu_assignments',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('bu_id',bu_id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'role',role,'inherit_descendants',inherit_descendants) ORDER BY bu_id) FROM public.bu_group_assignments WHERE group_id=_group),'[]'::jsonb),
    'reconciliation_grants',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',g.id,'tenant_id',g.tenant_id,'bu_id',g.bu_id,'recon_id',g.recon_id,'action',g.action,'environment',d.environment) ORDER BY g.id)
      FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g JOIN public.recon_definitions d ON d.id=g.recon_id AND d.tenant_id=g.tenant_id
      WHERE g.principal_type='group' AND g.principal_id=_group),'[]'::jsonb),
    'legacy_reconciliation_grants',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',g.id,'recon_id',g.recon_id,'permission',g.permission,'tenant_id',d.tenant_id,'environment',d.environment) ORDER BY g.id) FROM public.recon_permissions g JOIN public.recon_definitions d ON d.id=g.recon_id WHERE g.principal_type='group' AND g.principal_id=_group),'[]'::jsonb),
    'legacy_data_resource_grants',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'bu_id',bu_id,'resource_type',resource_type,'resource_id',resource_id,'action',action) ORDER BY id)
      FROM public.data_resource_bu_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_id=_group),'[]'::jsonb),
    'data_resource_grants',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'tenant_id',tenant_id,'bu_id',bu_id,'registry_id',registry_id,'action',action) ORDER BY id)
      FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants WHERE principal_type='group' AND principal_group_id=_group),'[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.governance_membership_record(_r governance_membership_requests, _action text, _actor uuid, _reason text, _outcome text)
 RETURNS bigint
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE audit_id bigint;
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(actor_user_id,tenant_id,scope,action,resource_type,resource_id,context)
  VALUES(_actor,_r.tenant_id,'tenant',_action,'governance_membership_request',_r.id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('request_id',_r.id,'actor_role',CASE WHEN private.governance_membership_active(_r.tenant_id,_actor,true) THEN 'tenant_admin' ELSE 'tenant_member' END,
      'bu_id',_r.bu_id,'workspace_id',_r.workspace_id,'group_id',_r.group_id,'environment',_r.environment,
      'reason',_reason,'version',_r.version,'correlation_id',_r.correlation_id,'outcome',_outcome,
      'scope_label','Tenant group membership; existing group rights can apply across workspaces')) RETURNING id INTO audit_id;
  INSERT INTO public.governance_membership_events(tenant_id,request_id,actor_user_id,action,version,reason,outcome,correlation_id,audit_id)
  VALUES(_r.tenant_id,_r.id,_actor,_action,_r.version,_reason,_outcome,_r.correlation_id,audit_id);
  RETURN audit_id;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_governance_membership_requests(_tenant_id uuid, _page integer DEFAULT 1, _page_size integer DEFAULT 25, _search text DEFAULT ''::text, _status text DEFAULT NULL::text, _bu_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _environment text DEFAULT NULL::text, _own_only boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb; admin boolean;
BEGIN
  IF NOT private.governance_membership_active(_tenant_id,auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active tenant membership required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF _own_only IS NULL OR _page IS NULL OR _page<1 OR _page>100000 OR _page_size IS NULL OR _page_size NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR _search IS NULL OR length(_search)>200
     OR _status IS NOT NULL AND _status NOT IN ('pending','approved','rejected','withdrawn')
     OR _environment IS NOT NULL AND _environment NOT IN ('prod','dev','sandbox','uat')
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid list filter or pagination' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  admin:=private.governance_membership_active(_tenant_id,auth.uid(),true);
  WITH visible AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r.*,p.full_name AS requester_name,a.full_name AS approver_name,b.name AS bu_name,
      w.name AS workspace_name,NULL::text AS team_name,g.name AS group_name,
      (admin AND r.requested_by<>auth.uid() AND r.status='pending') AS can_decide,
      (r.requested_by=auth.uid() AND r.status='pending') AS can_withdraw
    FROM public.governance_membership_requests r
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=r.requested_by
      LEFT JOIN public.profiles a ON a.id=r.approved_by
      LEFT JOIN public.business_units b ON b.id=r.bu_id AND b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
      LEFT JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id=r.workspace_id AND w.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
      LEFT JOIN public.tenant_groups g ON g.id=r.group_id AND g.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
    WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND (NOT _own_only OR r.requested_by=auth.uid()) AND (_status IS NULL OR r.status=_status)
      AND (_bu_id IS NULL OR r.bu_id=_bu_id) AND (_environment IS NULL OR r.environment=_environment)
      AND (_search='' OR strpos(lower(concat_ws(' ',r.id::text,p.full_name,a.full_name,b.name,w.name,w.department,g.name,r.environment,r.correlation_id::text)),lower(_search))>0)
  ), page_rows AS (
    SELECT * FROM visible ORDER BY requested_at DESC,id DESC OFFSET ((_page-1)*_page_size) LIMIT _page_size
  ) SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY requested_at DESC,id DESC) FROM page_rows p),'[]'::jsonb),
    'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM visible),'page',_page,'page_size',_page_size,
    'kpis',jsonb_build_object('awaiting_decision',(SELECT count(*) FROM visible WHERE status='pending'),
      'approved_last_7_days',(SELECT count(*) FROM visible WHERE status='approved' AND decided_at>=now()-interval '7 days'),
      'independent_checker_needed',(SELECT count(*) FROM visible WHERE status='pending' AND requested_by=auth.uid()),
      'rejected_or_withdrawn',(SELECT count(*) FROM visible WHERE status IN ('rejected','withdrawn'))),
    'permissions',jsonb_build_object('can_submit',true,'can_review_queue',admin)) INTO result;
  RETURN result;
END $function$

functions.name: get_governance_membership_request
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_governance_membership_request(_tenant_id uuid, _request_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE result jsonb; admin boolean;
BEGIN
  IF NOT private.governance_membership_active(_tenant_id,auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active tenant membership required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  admin:=private.governance_membership_active(_tenant_id,auth.uid(),true);
  SELECT to_jsonb(r)||jsonb_build_object('requester_name',p.full_name,'approver_name',a.full_name,
    'bu_name',b.name,'workspace_name',w.name,'team_name',NULL,'group_name',g.name,
    'effective_scope',r.scope_snapshot,'scope_label',r.scope_snapshot->>'scope_label',
    'membership_active',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_group_members gm WHERE gm.group_id=r.group_id AND gm.user_id=r.requested_by),
    'history',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY e.id) FROM public.governance_membership_events e WHERE e.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND e.request_id=r.id),'[]'::jsonb),
    'permissions',jsonb_build_object('can_approve',admin AND r.requested_by<>auth.uid() AND r.status='pending',
      'can_reject',admin AND r.requested_by<>auth.uid() AND r.status='pending','can_withdraw',r.requested_by=auth.uid() AND r.status='pending'))
    INTO result FROM public.governance_membership_requests r
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.id=r.requested_by LEFT JOIN public.profiles a ON a.id=r.approved_by
    LEFT JOIN public.business_units b ON b.id=r.bu_id AND b.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
    LEFT JOIN public.workspaces w ON w.id=r.workspace_id AND w.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
    LEFT JOIN public.tenant_groups g ON g.id=r.group_id AND g.tenant_id=r.tenant_id
    WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND r.id=_request_id;
  IF result IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Request not found in authorized scope' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.governance_review_assert_member(_tenant uuid, _admin boolean DEFAULT false)

   FROM public.teams t JOIN public.team_members tm ON tm.team_id=t.id AND tm.tenant_id=t.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_id=(_input->>'tenant_id')::uuid AND tm.user_id=_subject AND t.is_active),
   'group_name',snap->'group'->>'name','bu_name',(SELECT string_agg(b->>'name',', ' ORDER BY b->>'name') FROM jsonb_array_elements(snap->'business_units') b),
   'workspace_id',_input->>'workspace_id','workspace_name',snap->'workspace'->>'name',
   'environment',CASE WHEN (SELECT count(DISTINCT r->>'environment') FROM jsonb_array_elements(snap->'resource_grants') r WHERE r->>'environment' IS NOT NULL)=1
     THEN (SELECT min(r->>'environment') FROM jsonb_array_elements(snap->'resource_grants') r) ELSE NULL END,
   'current_rights',snap->'current_rights','snapshot_hash',private.governance_review_hash(snap),'version',1,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.governance_access_review_list(_input jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE t uuid:=(_input->>'tenant_id')::uuid; p int:=coalesce((_input->>'page')::int,1);
 n int:=coalesce((_input->>'page_size')::int,25); result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p<1 OR p>100000 OR n<1 OR n>100 OR length(coalesce(_input->>'search',''))>160
   OR (_input->>'outcome' IS NOT NULL AND _input->>'outcome' NOT IN ('pending','retained','change_requested','revoked','historical_unknown')) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid list bounds/filter' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 WITH scoped AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT r->>'id' id,r->>'campaign_id' campaign_id,r->>'_campaign_status' campaign_status,
     (r->>'due_at')::timestamptz due_at,(r->>'_created_at')::timestamptz created_at,
     r->>'outcome' governance_outcome,(r->>'decided_at')::timestamptz decided_at,
     (r-'_campaign_status'-'_created_at')||jsonb_build_object('member_name',member.full_name,'reviewer_name',reviewer.full_name) row
   FROM private.governance_review_list_rows(t) AS source(r)
   LEFT JOIN public.profiles member ON member.id=(r->>'subject_user_id')::uuid
   LEFT JOIN public.profiles reviewer ON reviewer.id=(r->>'reviewer_id')::uuid
   WHERE (_input->>'campaign_id' IS NULL OR (r->>'campaign_id')::uuid=(_input->>'campaign_id')::uuid)
     AND (_input->>'reviewer_id' IS NULL OR (r->>'reviewer_id')::uuid=(_input->>'reviewer_id')::uuid)
     AND (_input->>'outcome' IS NULL OR r->>'outcome'=_input->>'outcome')
 ), filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT * FROM scoped WHERE coalesce(_input->>'search','')='' OR position(lower(_input->>'search') IN lower(row::text))>0
 ), paged AS (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT n OFFSET (p-1)*n)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(row ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC),'[]') FROM paged),
   'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),'page',p,'page_size',n,'kpis',jsonb_build_object(
    'open_campaigns',(SELECT count(DISTINCT campaign_id) FROM filtered WHERE campaign_status='active'),
    'memberships_to_review',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered WHERE governance_outcome IN ('pending','change_requested')),
    'overdue_decisions',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered WHERE governance_outcome IN ('pending','change_requested') AND due_at<now()),
    'completed_last_30_days',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered WHERE governance_outcome IN ('retained','revoked') AND decided_at>=now()-interval '30 days')),
   'permissions',jsonb_build_object('can_create_campaign',private.governance_review_is_admin(t),'can_decide',private.governance_review_is_admin(t))) INTO result;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.governance_access_review_options(_input jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE p int:=coalesce((_input->>'page')::int,1); n int:=coalesce((_input->>'page_size')::int,25); result jsonb;
BEGIN
 IF p<1 OR p>100000 OR n<1 OR n>100 OR length(coalesce(_input->>'search',''))>160 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid option bounds' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 WITH eligible AS MATERIALIZED (
   SELECT x.id,coalesce(x.label,profile.full_name) label,x.group_id FROM private.governance_review_options_scope(_input) x
   LEFT JOIN public.profiles profile ON profile.id=x.id AND _input->>'kind' IN ('members','reviewers')
 ), filtered AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM eligible WHERE coalesce(_input->>'search','')=''
   OR position(lower(_input->>'search') IN lower(coalesce(label,'')||' '||id::text))>0),
 paged AS (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY label NULLS LAST,id LIMIT n OFFSET (p-1)*n)
 SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x)||CASE WHEN _input->>'kind'='members'
     THEN private.governance_review_member_option(_input,x.id)||jsonb_build_object('member_name',x.label) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END ORDER BY x.label NULLS LAST,x.id),'[]') FROM paged x),
   'total',(SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),'page',p,'page_size',n) INTO result;
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ssb_actor(_tenant uuid, _bu uuid, _create boolean)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE actor uuid:=private.wfm_actor(_tenant);
BEGIN
 -- Bare WFM actor attests actual account/factor/expiry without a Prep circular
 -- dependency. The feature checks apply to this Data Prep bootstrap purpose.
 PERFORM private.wfm_assert_enabled(_tenant,'prep');PERFORM private.wfm_assert_enabled(_tenant,'data');
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND user_id=actor AND active)
 OR (_bu IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.business_units WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND id=_bu AND is_archived IS NOT TRUE))
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ssb.current_tenant_bu_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 IF _create AND public.user_has_permission(actor,_tenant,'data.source.create',_bu) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ssb.source_create_permission_required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 RETURN actor;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.ssb_status(_actor uuid, _tenant uuid, _source uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE s public.workspace_data_sources%ROWTYPE;r private.ssb_create_receipts%ROWTYPE;mapped boolean;creator boolean;admin boolean;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO s FROM public.workspace_data_sources WHERE id=_source AND tenant_id=_tenant;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ssb.source_unknown' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO r FROM private.ssb_create_receipts WHERE source_id=s.id AND tenant_id=_tenant;
 creator:=r.actor_id=_actor;admin:=private.ssb_is_admin(_actor,_tenant);mapped:=private.ssb_is_mapped(_tenant,s.id);
 IF NOT coalesce(creator,false) AND NOT admin AND (NOT mapped OR private.registered_typed_resource_allows(_actor,_tenant,'data_source',s.id,'view') IS DISTINCT FROM true)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'ssb.source_scope_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('actor_id',_actor,'tenant_id',_tenant,'source',private.ssb_source_metadata(s),'registered',mapped,
 'request_key',CASE WHEN creator THEN r.request_key ELSE NULL END,'audit_event_id',CASE WHEN creator OR admin THEN r.audit_event_id::text ELSE NULL END,
 'ownership_state',CASE WHEN s.status='archived' THEN 'archived' WHEN mapped THEN 'registered' ELSE 'awaiting_tenant_admin' END,
 'can_save_ownership',admin,'ownership_policy','actual_active_tenant_admin',
 'can_bind',mapped AND s.status<>'archived' AND private.registered_typed_resource_allows(_actor,_tenant,'data_source',s.id,'view') IS TRUE,
 'can_ingest',mapped AND s.status<>'archived' AND private.registered_typed_resource_allows(_actor,_tenant,'data_source',s.id,'ingest') IS TRUE,
 'can_edit',mapped AND s.status<>'archived' AND private.registered_typed_resource_allows(_actor,_tenant,'data_source',s.id,'edit') IS TRUE,
 'ownership_editor',jsonb_build_object('rpc','get_typed_data_resource_editor','resource_type','data_source','tenant_id',_tenant,'resource_id',s.id),
 'ownership_save',jsonb_build_object('rpc','save_typed_data_resource_access','resource_type','data_source','tenant_id',_tenant,'resource_id',s.id),
 'ownership_is_approval_queue',false);
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cutover_legacy_recon_definition_mapping(_tenant_id uuid, _recon_id uuid, _owner_bu_ids uuid[], _maker_user_id uuid, _checker_user_id uuid, _reason text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_definition public.recon_definitions%ROWTYPE;
  v_owner_ids uuid[];
  v_existing_owner_ids uuid[];
  v_maker_role text;
  v_checker_role text;
  v_receipt_id uuid;
BEGIN
  -- Registered workspace availability; original authorization and entire body follow unchanged.
  PERFORM private.wfm_assert_enabled(_tenant_id,'recons');

  IF v_actor IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR _recon_id IS NULL
     OR _maker_user_id IS NULL OR _checker_user_id IS NULL
     OR _maker_user_id=_checker_user_id OR v_actor IN (_maker_user_id,_checker_user_id)
     OR _reason IS NULL OR length(btrim(_reason)) NOT BETWEEN 3 AND 1000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid legacy mapping cutover request' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF NOT private.recon_governance_is_active_admin(_tenant_id,v_actor) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'active same-tenant administrator required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_definition
  FROM public.recon_definitions d
  WHERE d.id=_recon_id AND d.tenant_id=_tenant_id
  FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_definition.access_mode<>'legacy_passthrough'
     OR v_definition.governance_state<>'legacy_unreviewed'
     OR v_definition.multi_bu_governed THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'definition is not an unmapped legacy reconciliation' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT requested.bu_id ORDER BY requested.bu_id),ARRAY[]::uuid[])
  INTO v_owner_ids FROM unnest(coalesce(_owner_bu_ids,ARRAY[]::uuid[])) requested(bu_id);
  IF cardinality(v_owner_ids)=0 OR cardinality(v_owner_ids)<>cardinality(coalesce(_owner_bu_ids,ARRAY[]::uuid[])) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'one or more distinct owner business units are required' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(owner_row.bu_id ORDER BY owner_row.bu_id),ARRAY[]::uuid[])
  INTO v_existing_owner_ids
  FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_row
  WHERE owner_row.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND owner_row.recon_id=_recon_id;
  IF v_existing_owner_ids IS DISTINCT FROM v_owner_ids OR cardinality(v_existing_owner_ids)<>cardinality(v_owner_ids)
     OR EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM unnest(v_owner_ids) requested(bu_id)
       LEFT JOIN public.business_units owner_unit
         ON owner_unit.id=requested.bu_id AND owner_unit.tenant_id=_tenant_id
       WHERE owner_unit.id IS NULL OR owner_unit.is_archived
     ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'owner links must exactly match active same-tenant business units' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  -- Serialize owner replacement and grant revocation/insertion across the
  -- validation-to-transition interval. The parent definition lock above also
  -- serializes set_recon_owners, which locks that row before changing links.
  PERFORM owner_row.bu_id
  FROM public.recon_definition_business_units owner_row
  WHERE owner_row.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND owner_row.recon_id=_recon_id
  ORDER BY owner_row.bu_id FOR UPDATE;
  PERFORM grant_row.id
  FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
  WHERE grant_row.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND grant_row.recon_id=_recon_id
  ORDER BY grant_row.id FOR SHARE;

  SELECT tm.role::text INTO v_maker_role FROM public.tenant_members tm
  WHERE tm.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND tm.user_id=_maker_user_id AND tm.active;
  SELECT tm.role::text INTO v_checker_role FROM public.tenant_members tm
  WHERE tm.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND tm.user_id=_checker_user_id AND tm.active;
  IF v_maker_role IS NULL OR v_checker_role IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'maker and checker must be active members of the same tenant' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;

  -- Each synthetic actor needs current assignment to every owner BU and a
  -- reviewed direct-user or assigned same-tenant group grant for every action.
  IF EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM unnest(v_owner_ids) owner(bu_id)
    CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['view','run','edit']::text[]) needed(action_name)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_user_assignments assignment
      JOIN public.business_units assigned_unit ON assigned_unit.id=assignment.bu_id
        AND assigned_unit.tenant_id=assignment.tenant_id AND NOT assigned_unit.is_archived
      JOIN public.business_units owner_unit ON owner_unit.id=owner.bu_id
        AND owner_unit.tenant_id=assignment.tenant_id AND NOT owner_unit.is_archived
      WHERE assignment.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND assignment.user_id=_maker_user_id
        AND (assigned_unit.id=owner_unit.id OR
             (assignment.inherit_descendants AND owner_unit.path <@ assigned_unit.path))
    ) OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
      WHERE grant_row.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND grant_row.recon_id=_recon_id
        AND grant_row.bu_id=owner.bu_id AND grant_row.action=needed.action_name
        AND ((grant_row.principal_type='user' AND grant_row.principal_id=_maker_user_id)
          OR (grant_row.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_groups group_row
            JOIN public.tenant_group_members group_member ON group_member.group_id=group_row.id
              AND group_member.user_id=_maker_user_id
            JOIN public.tenant_members active_member ON active_member.tenant_id=_tenant_id
              AND active_member.user_id=group_member.user_id AND active_member.active
            JOIN public.bu_group_assignments group_assignment ON group_assignment.tenant_id=_tenant_id
              AND group_assignment.group_id=group_row.id
            JOIN public.business_units assigned_unit ON assigned_unit.id=group_assignment.bu_id
              AND assigned_unit.tenant_id=group_assignment.tenant_id AND NOT assigned_unit.is_archived
            JOIN public.business_units owner_unit ON owner_unit.id=owner.bu_id
              AND owner_unit.tenant_id=group_assignment.tenant_id AND NOT owner_unit.is_archived
            WHERE group_row.id=grant_row.principal_id AND group_row.tenant_id=_tenant_id
              AND (assigned_unit.id=owner_unit.id OR
                   (group_assignment.inherit_descendants AND owner_unit.path <@ assigned_unit.path))
          )))
    )
  ) OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM unnest(v_owner_ids) owner(bu_id)
    CROSS JOIN unnest(ARRAY['view','approve']::text[]) needed(action_name)
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_user_assignments assignment
      JOIN public.business_units assigned_unit ON assigned_unit.id=assignment.bu_id
        AND assigned_unit.tenant_id=assignment.tenant_id AND NOT assigned_unit.is_archived
      JOIN public.business_units owner_unit ON owner_unit.id=owner.bu_id
        AND owner_unit.tenant_id=assignment.tenant_id AND NOT owner_unit.is_archived
      WHERE assignment.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND assignment.user_id=_checker_user_id
        AND (assigned_unit.id=owner_unit.id OR
             (assignment.inherit_descendants AND owner_unit.path <@ assigned_unit.path))
    ) OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row
      WHERE grant_row.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND grant_row.recon_id=_recon_id
        AND grant_row.bu_id=owner.bu_id AND grant_row.action=needed.action_name
        AND ((grant_row.principal_type='user' AND grant_row.principal_id=_checker_user_id)
          OR (grant_row.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_groups group_row
            JOIN public.tenant_group_members group_member ON group_member.group_id=group_row.id
              AND group_member.user_id=_checker_user_id
            JOIN public.tenant_members active_member ON active_member.tenant_id=_tenant_id
              AND active_member.user_id=group_member.user_id AND active_member.active
            JOIN public.bu_group_assignments group_assignment ON group_assignment.tenant_id=_tenant_id
              AND group_assignment.group_id=group_row.id
            JOIN public.business_units assigned_unit ON assigned_unit.id=group_assignment.bu_id
              AND assigned_unit.tenant_id=group_assignment.tenant_id AND NOT assigned_unit.is_archived
            JOIN public.business_units owner_unit ON owner_unit.id=owner.bu_id
              AND owner_unit.tenant_id=group_assignment.tenant_id AND NOT owner_unit.is_archived
            WHERE group_row.id=grant_row.principal_id AND group_row.tenant_id=_tenant_id
              AND (assigned_unit.id=owner_unit.id OR
                   (group_assignment.inherit_descendants AND owner_unit.path <@ assigned_unit.path))
          )))
    )
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'maker/checker assignments and reviewed grants are incomplete' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;

  INSERT INTO private.recon_legacy_mapping_cutover_receipts(
    tenant_id,recon_id,actor_id,owner_bu_ids,maker_user_id,checker_user_id,reason
  ) VALUES (_tenant_id,_recon_id,v_actor,v_owner_ids,_maker_user_id,_checker_user_id,btrim(_reason))
  RETURNING id INTO v_receipt_id;
  INSERT INTO public.recon_definition_bu_admin_audit(
    tenant_id,recon_id,operation,actor_id,reason,details
  ) VALUES (_tenant_id,_recon_id,'map_legacy',v_actor,btrim(_reason),jsonb_build_object(
    'receipt_id',v_receipt_id,'owner_bu_ids',v_owner_ids,'maker_user_id',_maker_user_id,
    'maker_actions',ARRAY['view','run','edit'],'checker_user_id',_checker_user_id,
    'checker_actions',ARRAY['view','approve'],'previous_access_mode',v_definition.access_mode,
    'previous_governance_state',v_definition.governance_state,'new_access_mode','mapped_exact',
    'new_governance_state','legacy_mapped','status_preserved',v_definition.status,
    'legacy_bu_id_preserved',v_definition.bu_id,'scope','owner_authorized_synthetic_assurance'
  ));
  UPDATE public.recon_definitions
  SET access_mode='mapped_exact', governance_state='legacy_mapped', multi_bu_governed=true
  WHERE id=_recon_id AND tenant_id=_tenant_id
    AND access_mode='legacy_passthrough' AND governance_state='legacy_unreviewed';
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'legacy definition changed during mapping cutover'; END IF;
  INSERT INTO public.audit_log(actor_user_id,tenant_id,scope,action,resource_type,resource_id,context)
  VALUES (v_actor,_tenant_id,'workspace','recon.legacy_mapping.cutover','recon_definition',_recon_id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('receipt_id',v_receipt_id,'recon_code',v_definition.recon_code,
      'owner_bu_ids',v_owner_ids,'maker_user_id',_maker_user_id,'checker_user_id',_checker_user_id,
      'reason',btrim(_reason),'status_preserved',v_definition.status,
      'legacy_bu_id_preserved',v_definition.bu_id,'governance_state','legacy_mapped'));
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('recon_id',_recon_id,'recon_code',v_definition.recon_code,
    'access_mode','mapped_exact','governance_state','legacy_mapped','status',v_definition.status,
    'legacy_bu_id',v_definition.bu_id,'owner_bu_ids',v_owner_ids,'audit_receipt_id',v_receipt_id);
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_collateral_csa_access_editor(_tenant_id uuid, _agreement_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_registry uuid; v_owners uuid[]; v_groups uuid[];
BEGIN
  -- Registered workspace availability; original authorization and entire body follow unchanged.
  PERFORM private.wfm_assert_enabled(_tenant_id,'collateral');

  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL OR _agreement_id IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id
      AND m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.active AND m.role='tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role)
    OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.collateral_csa_agreements a
      WHERE a.id=_agreement_id AND a.tenant_id=_tenant_id)
  THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not authorized' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT r.id INTO v_registry FROM public.data_resource_registry r
    WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND r.resource_type='collateral_csa_agreement'
      AND r.collateral_csa_agreement_id=_agreement_id;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(o.bu_id ORDER BY o.bu_id),ARRAY[]::uuid[]) INTO v_owners
    FROM public.data_resource_registry_owner_bu o
    WHERE o.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND o.registry_id=v_registry;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT g.principal_group_id ORDER BY g.principal_group_id),ARRAY[]::uuid[])
    INTO v_groups FROM public.data_resource_registry_grants g
    WHERE g.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND g.registry_id=v_registry
      AND g.principal_type='group' AND g.action='view';
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('registered',v_registry IS NOT NULL,
    'owner_bu_ids',v_owners,'group_ids',v_groups,
    'business_units',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'name',b.name)
      ORDER BY b.name,b.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.business_units b
      WHERE b.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND NOT b.is_archived),
    'user_groups',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',g.id,'name',g.name)
      ORDER BY g.name,g.id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM public.tenant_groups g
      WHERE g.tenant_id=_tenant_id));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.mapped_recon_governance_lock_scope(_tenant uuid, _recon uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- A single per-parent workflow lock precedes request/definition locks. Parent
 -- Root FOR UPDATE fences new owner rows. Owner FOR UPDATE separately fences
 -- new grant FK references; FOR SHARE would still admit their KEY SHARE lock.
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.recon_definitions WHERE id=_recon AND tenant_id=_tenant FOR UPDATE;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units WHERE recon_id=_recon ORDER BY bu_id FOR UPDATE;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants WHERE recon_id=_recon ORDER BY id FOR SHARE;
 -- Protect the active owner/ancestor association used by native effective scope.
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.business_units b WHERE b.tenant_id=_tenant AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units o JOIN public.business_units owner ON owner.id=o.bu_id AND owner.tenant_id=o.tenant_id
  WHERE o.recon_id=_recon AND o.tenant_id=_tenant AND owner.path <@ b.path) ORDER BY b.id FOR UPDATE;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.tenant_groups g WHERE g.tenant_id=_tenant AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants grant_row WHERE grant_row.recon_id=_recon
   AND grant_row.principal_type='group' AND grant_row.principal_id=g.id) ORDER BY g.id FOR UPDATE;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.bu_user_assignments a WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE g.recon_id=_recon AND g.tenant_id=_tenant
   AND g.principal_type='user' AND g.principal_id=a.user_id) ORDER BY a.bu_id,a.user_id FOR SHARE;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments a WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE g.recon_id=_recon AND g.tenant_id=_tenant
   AND g.principal_type='group' AND g.principal_id=a.group_id) ORDER BY a.bu_id,a.group_id FOR SHARE;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.tenant_group_members m WHERE EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE g.recon_id=_recon AND g.tenant_id=_tenant
   AND g.principal_type='group' AND g.principal_id=m.group_id) ORDER BY m.group_id,m.user_id FOR SHARE;
 PERFORM 1 FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant AND EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE g.recon_id=_recon AND
   ((g.principal_type='user' AND g.principal_id=m.user_id) OR
    (g.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_group_members gm WHERE gm.group_id=g.principal_id AND gm.user_id=m.user_id))))
 ORDER BY m.user_id FOR SHARE;
END $function$

functions.name: mapped_recon_governance_mapping
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.mapped_recon_governance_mapping(_tenant uuid, _recon uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
AS $function$
DECLARE d public.recon_definitions%ROWTYPE; result jsonb;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO d FROM public.recon_definitions WHERE id=_recon AND tenant_id=_tenant;
 IF NOT FOUND OR d.access_mode<>'mapped_exact' THEN PERFORM private.mapped_recon_governance_conflict('mapped_scope_required'); END IF;
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND recon_id=_recon)
 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units o LEFT JOIN public.business_units b ON b.id=o.bu_id AND b.tenant_id=o.tenant_id
  WHERE o.recon_id=_recon AND (o.tenant_id<>_tenant OR b.id IS NULL OR b.is_archived)) THEN
  PERFORM private.mapped_recon_governance_conflict('owner_scope_inactive_or_cross_tenant');
 END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE g.recon_id=_recon AND
  (g.tenant_id<>_tenant OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units o WHERE o.tenant_id=_tenant AND o.recon_id=_recon AND o.bu_id=g.bu_id)
   OR (g.principal_type='user' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant AND m.user_id=g.principal_id AND m.active))
   OR (g.principal_type='group' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_groups t WHERE t.id=g.principal_id AND t.tenant_id=_tenant))
   OR (g.principal_type='user' AND NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_user_assignments a
     JOIN public.business_units assigned ON assigned.id=a.bu_id AND assigned.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND NOT assigned.is_archived
     JOIN public.business_units owner ON owner.id=g.bu_id AND owner.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND NOT owner.is_archived
     WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant AND a.user_id=g.principal_id
     AND (owner.id=assigned.id OR (a.inherit_descendants AND owner.path <@ assigned.path))))
   OR (g.principal_type='group' AND NOT EXISTS(
     SELECT 1 FROM public.bu_group_assignments a
     JOIN public.business_units assigned ON assigned.id=a.bu_id AND assigned.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND NOT assigned.is_archived
     JOIN public.business_units owner ON owner.id=g.bu_id AND owner.tenant_id=g.tenant_id AND NOT owner.is_archived
     WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant AND a.group_id=g.principal_id
     AND (owner.id=assigned.id OR (a.inherit_descendants AND owner.path <@ assigned.path))))
   OR g.principal_type NOT IN ('user','group'))) THEN
  PERFORM private.mapped_recon_governance_conflict('grant_scope_inactive_or_cross_tenant');
 END IF;
 result:=jsonb_build_object('contract_version',1,'tenant_id',_tenant,'recon_id',_recon,'access_mode',d.access_mode,'multi_bu_governed',d.multi_bu_governed,
  'owners',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) ORDER BY o.bu_id),'[]') FROM public.recon_definition_business_units o WHERE o.tenant_id=_tenant AND o.recon_id=_recon),
  'grants',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(g) ORDER BY g.id),'[]') FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE g.tenant_id=_tenant AND g.recon_id=_recon),
  'owner_ancestors',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',b.id,'tenant_id',b.tenant_id,'path',b.path,'is_archived',b.is_archived) ORDER BY b.id),'[]') FROM public.business_units b WHERE b.tenant_id=_tenant AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_business_units o JOIN public.business_units owner ON owner.id=o.bu_id AND owner.tenant_id=o.tenant_id WHERE o.tenant_id=_tenant AND o.recon_id=_recon AND owner.path <@ b.path)),
  'groups',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',g.id,'tenant_id',g.tenant_id,'bu_id',g.bu_id) ORDER BY g.id),'[]') FROM public.tenant_groups g WHERE g.tenant_id=_tenant AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants a WHERE a.recon_id=_recon AND a.principal_type='group' AND a.principal_id=g.id)),
  'user_assignments',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.bu_id,a.user_id),'[]') FROM public.bu_user_assignments a WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE g.recon_id=_recon AND g.principal_type='user' AND g.principal_id=a.user_id)),
  'group_assignments',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) ORDER BY a.bu_id,a.group_id),'[]') FROM public.bu_group_assignments a WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE g.recon_id=_recon AND g.principal_type='group' AND g.principal_id=a.group_id)),
  'group_members',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.group_id,m.user_id),'[]') FROM public.tenant_group_members m WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE g.tenant_id=_tenant AND g.recon_id=_recon AND g.principal_type='group' AND g.principal_id=m.group_id)),
  'principal_memberships',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(m) ORDER BY m.user_id),'[]') FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.recon_definition_bu_grants g WHERE g.recon_id=_recon AND ((g.principal_type='user' AND g.principal_id=m.user_id) OR (g.principal_type='group' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_group_members gm WHERE gm.group_id=g.principal_id AND gm.user_id=m.user_id))))));
 RETURN result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fvi_report_audit_rows(_tenant uuid, _since timestamp with time zone, _at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE rows jsonb; n integer;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated'
 OR current_setting('role',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated'
 OR public.rlnext_actor_allowed() IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR _tenant IS NULL OR _since IS NULL OR _at IS NULL OR _since>_at OR _at-_since>interval '360 days'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant AND m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.active)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'report.current_scope_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 PERFORM public.wfm_assert_current_section(_tenant,'reports');
 IF public.is_platform_admin(auth.uid()) IS DISTINCT FROM true AND public.user_has_permission(auth.uid(),_tenant,'recon.definition.read',NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'report.current_read_permission_required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.id::bigint),'[]'::jsonb),count(*)::integer INTO rows,n
 FROM (SELECT a.id::text AS id,a.occurred_at,a.actor_email,a.actor_user_id,a.scope,a.action,a.resource_type,a.client_ip
 FROM public.audit_log a WHERE a.tenant_id=_tenant AND a.occurred_at>=_since AND a.occurred_at<=_at
 ORDER BY a.id LIMIT 100001) r;
 IF n>100000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'report.interactive_row_limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('contract','fvi-complete-report-rows-v1','source','audit_log','tenant_id',_tenant,'actor_id',auth.uid(),'since',_since,'through',_at,'complete',true,'count',n,'rows',rows);
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fvi_report_run_rows(_tenant uuid, _ids uuid[], _since timestamp with time zone, _at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE rows jsonb; n integer;
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR auth.role() IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated'
 OR current_setting('role',true) IS DISTINCT FROM 'authenticated'
 OR public.rlnext_actor_allowed() IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR _tenant IS NULL OR _ids IS NULL OR array_position(_ids,NULL::uuid) IS NOT NULL OR cardinality(_ids)>100000
 OR _since IS NULL OR _at IS NULL OR _since>_at OR _at-_since>interval '360 days'
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant AND m.user_id=auth.uid() AND m.active)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'report.current_scope_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 IF (_ids <@ public.get_recon_list_scope_ids(_tenant,'all',NULL)) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'report.definition_scope_unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 PERFORM public.wfm_assert_current_section(_tenant,'reports');
 IF public.is_platform_admin(auth.uid()) IS DISTINCT FROM true AND public.user_has_permission(auth.uid(),_tenant,'recon.definition.read',NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'report.current_read_permission_required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r) ORDER BY r.id),'[]'::jsonb),count(*)::integer INTO rows,n
 FROM (SELECT r.id,r.started_at,r.completed_at,r.matched_count,r.exception_count,r.status,r.definition_id,r.total_rows,r.stats->'matched_records' AS matched_input_memberships
 FROM public.recon_runs r WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.definition_id=ANY(_ids) AND r.started_at>=_since AND r.started_at<=_at
 ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 100001) r;
 IF n>100000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'report.interactive_row_limit' USING ERRCODE='54000';END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('contract','fvi-complete-report-rows-v1','source','recon_runs','tenant_id',_tenant,'actor_id',auth.uid(),'since',_since,'through',_at,'definition_ids',_ids,'complete',true,'count',n,'rows',rows);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dps_owned_draft_input(_tenant uuid, _source uuid, _configuration uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
 SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.data_prep_configuration_revisions cfg
 JOIN private.dpd_raw_source_links raw ON raw.data_source_id=_source AND raw.tenant_id=_tenant
 JOIN private.dpd_setups setup ON setup.id=raw.setup_id AND setup.tenant_id=raw.tenant_id AND setup.created_by=raw.created_by AND setup.created_by=cfg.created_by
 JOIN private.dpd_original_intents original ON original.id=raw.file_id AND original.setup_id=setup.id AND original.tenant_id=_tenant AND original.created_by=setup.created_by
 JOIN private.dpd_original_receipts receipt ON receipt.file_id=original.id AND receipt.setup_id=original.setup_id AND receipt.tenant_id=original.tenant_id AND receipt.created_by=original.created_by
 AND receipt.verified_original_sha256=original.content_sha256 AND receipt.verified_size_bytes=original.size_bytes
 JOIN public.workspace_data_sources source_row ON source_row.id=raw.data_source_id AND source_row.tenant_id=_tenant AND source_row.created_by=setup.created_by AND source_row.status<>'archived'
 JOIN public.data_resource_registry registry ON registry.data_source_id=source_row.id AND registry.tenant_id=_tenant AND registry.resource_type='data_source' AND registry.created_by=setup.created_by
 WHERE cfg.id=_configuration AND cfg.tenant_id=_tenant
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(cfg.payload->'confirmed_mapping'->'feeds') feed,jsonb_array_elements(feed->'original_refs') ref
  WHERE feed->>'data_source_id'=source_row.id::text AND ref->>'file_id'=original.id::text))

DECLARE actor uuid:=private.dps_admin(_tenant_id);owners uuid[]:=private.dps_ids(_owning_business_unit_ids,100,true);off integer:=private.dpw_page(_page,_page_size);items jsonb;n integer;

 filtered AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT * FROM eligible WHERE cardinality(bu_ids)>0),page AS(SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY name,id LIMIT _page_size OFFSET off)
 SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM filtered),(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(page) ORDER BY name,id),'[]') FROM page) INTO n,items;

END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpd_peer_actor(_tenant uuid, _subject jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid

 OR private.rlnext_account_allowed(actor,NULL) IS DISTINCT FROM true OR private.rlnext_account_allowed(actor,_tenant) IS DISTINCT FROM true
 OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND user_id=actor AND active) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpd.current_verified_subject_denied' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 RETURN actor;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.fvi_report_snapshot(_actor uuid, _tenant uuid, _spec jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE ids uuid[]; anchor timestamptz:=clock_timestamp(); start_at timestamptz; days integer; ops jsonb; ai jsonb; risk jsonb;
  security jsonb; audit jsonb; config jsonb; trend jsonb; users bigint; output jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM private.fvi_report_validate(_spec);ids:=private.fvi_report_scope(_actor,_tenant,_spec);days:=(_spec->>'days')::integer;
  start_at:=((anchor AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date-(days-1))::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
  WITH runs AS (SELECT r.*,CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.stats->'matched_records')='number'
    AND r.stats->>'matched_records' ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND r.total_rows>=0
    AND (r.stats->>'matched_records')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND r.total_rows THEN (r.stats->>'matched_records')::numeric ELSE NULL END AS inputs_matched
    FROM public.recon_runs r WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.definition_id=ANY(ids) AND r.started_at BETWEEN start_at AND anchor),
  totals AS (SELECT count(*) n,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('completed','succeeded')) successes,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='failed') failures,
    CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE matched_count IS NULL OR matched_count<0)>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(matched_count)::numeric END matched_groups,
    CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE exception_count IS NULL OR exception_count<0)>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(exception_count)::numeric END exceptions,
    CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE inputs_matched IS NULL)>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(inputs_matched) END matched_inputs,
    CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE inputs_matched IS NULL OR total_rows IS NULL)>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(total_rows)::numeric END input_rows,
    avg(extract(epoch FROM completed_at-started_at)) FILTER(WHERE completed_at>=started_at) runtime FROM runs)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('runs',n,'success',successes,'failed',failures,'matched',matched_groups,'exceptions',exceptions,
    'matched_input_memberships',matched_inputs,'total_input_rows',input_rows,'match_rate_pct',CASE WHEN input_rows>0 THEN round(100*matched_inputs/input_rows,1) ELSE NULL END,
    'avg_runtime_sec',round(runtime,1),'active_schedules',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.recon_schedules s WHERE s.tenant_id=_tenant AND s.definition_id=ANY(ids) AND s.enabled),
    'members',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.tenant_members m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant AND m.active)) INTO ops FROM totals;
  WITH run_rows AS (SELECT r.*,CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.stats->'matched_records')='number' AND r.stats->>'matched_records' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
    AND r.total_rows>=0 AND (r.stats->>'matched_records')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND r.total_rows THEN (r.stats->>'matched_records')::numeric ELSE NULL END inputs_matched
    FROM public.recon_runs r WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.definition_id=ANY(ids) AND r.started_at BETWEEN start_at AND anchor),
  dates AS (SELECT d::date AS report_day FROM generate_series(start_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',anchor AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',interval '1 day') d),
  daily AS (SELECT d.report_day,count(r.id) n,
    CASE WHEN count(r.id)=0 THEN 0 WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL AND (r.matched_count IS NULL OR r.matched_count<0))>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(r.matched_count) END matched_groups,
    CASE WHEN count(r.id)=0 THEN 0 WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL AND (r.exception_count IS NULL OR r.exception_count<0))>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(r.exception_count) END exceptions,
    CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL AND r.inputs_matched IS NULL)>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(r.inputs_matched) END mi,
    CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.id IS NOT NULL AND r.inputs_matched IS NULL)>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(r.total_rows) END ti
    FROM dates d LEFT JOIN run_rows r ON (r.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date=d.report_day GROUP BY d.report_day)
  SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('day',report_day,'runs',n,'matched',matched_groups,'exceptions',exceptions,'rate',CASE WHEN ti>0 THEN round(100*mi/ti,1) ELSE NULL END) ORDER BY report_day),'[]') INTO trend FROM daily;
  WITH breaks AS (SELECT e.* FROM public.recon_exceptions e JOIN public.recon_runs r ON r.id=e.run_id AND r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id
    WHERE e.tenant_id=_tenant AND r.definition_id=ANY(ids) AND e.created_at BETWEEN start_at AND anchor),
  opened AS (SELECT * FROM breaks WHERE lifecycle_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'resolved' AND lifecycle_state IS DISTINCT FROM 'written_off' AND status IS DISTINCT FROM 'resolved' AND status IS DISTINCT FROM 'wont_fix')
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('open_breaks',count(*),'overdue',count(*) FILTER(WHERE due_date<anchor),
    'critical',count(*) FILTER(WHERE severity='critical'),'high',count(*) FILTER(WHERE severity='high')) INTO risk FROM opened;
  WITH events AS (SELECT * FROM public.ai_usage_events WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND created_at BETWEEN start_at AND anchor),
  models AS (SELECT model,count(*) calls,CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE tokens_in IS NULL OR tokens_out IS NULL OR tokens_in<0 OR tokens_out<0)>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(tokens_in::numeric+tokens_out) END tokens,
    CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE cost_usd IS NULL OR cost_usd::text !~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(cost_usd)::text END cost_usd_exact,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE cost_usd IS NULL OR cost_usd::text !~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') unknown_cost_events FROM events GROUP BY model),
  totals AS (SELECT count(*) calls,
    CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE tokens_in IS NULL OR tokens_in<0)>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(tokens_in::numeric) END ti,
    CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN 0 WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE tokens_out IS NULL OR tokens_out<0)>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(tokens_out::numeric) END tout,
    CASE WHEN count(*)=0 THEN '0' WHEN count(*) FILTER(WHERE cost_usd IS NULL OR cost_usd::text !~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$')>0 THEN NULL ELSE sum(cost_usd)::text END cost,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE cost_usd IS NULL OR cost_usd::text !~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$') missing FROM events)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('calls',calls,'tokens_in',ti,'tokens_out',tout,'total_tokens',ti+tout,'cost_usd_exact',cost,'unknown_cost_events',missing,
    'cost_by_currency',jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('currency','USD','amount',cost)),
    'by_model',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',model,'calls',calls,'tokens',tokens,'cost_usd_exact',cost_usd_exact,'currency','USD','unknown_cost_events',unknown_cost_events) ORDER BY model) FROM models),'[]')) INTO ai FROM totals;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('events_total',count(*),'failed_logins',count(*) FILTER(WHERE event_type ~* 'fail|denied|invalid|lock'),
    'unique_ips',count(DISTINCT ip)) INTO security FROM public.security_events WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND occurred_at BETWEEN start_at AND anchor;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('events_total',count(*),'distinct_actions',count(DISTINCT action),'distinct_actors',count(DISTINCT coalesce(actor_user_id::text,actor_email::text))) INTO audit
    FROM public.audit_log WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND occurred_at BETWEEN start_at AND anchor;
  config:=jsonb_build_object('checks',jsonb_build_array(
    jsonb_build_object('id','sso','name','Single sign-on configured','ok',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_sso_configs WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND enabled),'control','Configuration evidence only'),
    jsonb_build_object('id','ip','name','IP allow-list configured','ok',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_ip_allowlist WHERE tenant_id=_tenant),'control','Configuration evidence only'),
    jsonb_build_object('id','mfa','name','MFA requirement configured','ok',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_security_settings WHERE tenant_id=_tenant AND mfa_required),'control','Configuration evidence only'),
    jsonb_build_object('id','audit','name','Audit events visible in this window','ok',(audit->>'events_total')::numeric>0,'control','Event presence is not chain verification')));
  output:=jsonb_build_object('window_days',days,'generated_at',anchor,'reporting_timezone','UTC','reconciliation_ids',to_jsonb(ids),
    'scope',jsonb_build_object('reconciliation_id',_spec->'reconciliation_id','bu_id',_spec->'bu_id','reconciliation_count',cardinality(ids)),
    'coverage',jsonb_build_object('snapshot','current persisted row state at generation; not historical time travel','tenant_wide_sections',jsonb_build_array('ai','security','configuration','audit','users')),
    'operations',ops,'match_rates',jsonb_build_object('trend',trend),'risk',risk,'ai_usage',ai,'security',security,'audit',audit,'compliance',config);
  IF octet_length(output::text)>1048576 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Report snapshot exceeds safe interactive size' USING ERRCODE='54000'; END IF;
  RETURN output;
END $function$

functions.name: fvi_report_scope
fvi_report_validate
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.fvi_report_validate(_spec jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE allowed text[]:=ARRAY['operations.runs','operations.success','operations.failed','operations.matched','operations.exceptions',
  'operations.match_rate_pct','operations.matched_input_memberships','operations.total_input_rows','operations.avg_runtime_sec',
  'risk.open_breaks','risk.overdue','ai_usage.calls','ai_usage.tokens_in','ai_usage.tokens_out','ai_usage.cost_usd_exact',
  'security.events_total','security.failed_logins','audit.events_total','audit.distinct_actions','audit.distinct_actors']; keys text[];
BEGIN
  IF jsonb_typeof(_spec)<>'object' OR _spec->>'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
     OR NOT _spec ?& ARRAY['schema_version','type','days','metrics','reconciliation_id','bu_id']
     OR (_spec->>'type') IS NULL OR (_spec->>'type') NOT IN ('operations','match_rates','risk','ai','security','configuration','audit','users','usage','cost','custom')
     OR (_spec->>'days') IS NULL OR (_spec->>'days') !~ '^[0-9]+$' OR (_spec->>'days')::integer NOT BETWEEN 7 AND 180
     OR jsonb_typeof(_spec->'metrics') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(_spec) k WHERE k NOT IN ('schema_version','type','days','metrics','reconciliation_id','bu_id')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported report design' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(k),ARRAY[]::text[]) INTO keys FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(_spec->'metrics') k;
  IF cardinality(keys)>20 OR NOT keys <@ allowed OR cardinality(keys)<>(SELECT count(DISTINCT k) FROM unnest(keys) k)
     OR (_spec->>'type'='custom' AND cardinality(keys)=0) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Unsupported report metrics' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  PERFORM nullif(_spec->>'reconciliation_id','')::uuid,nullif(_spec->>'bu_id','')::uuid;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.fvi_report_wall_instants(_wall timestamp without time zone, _zone text)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  WITH offsets AS (SELECT DISTINCT extract(epoch FROM ((s AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')-(s AT TIME ZONE _zone))) AS seconds
    FROM (SELECT _wall+make_interval(hours=>h) s FROM unnest(ARRAY[-48,-24,0,24,48]) h) samples),
  candidates AS (SELECT (_wall AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')-make_interval(secs=>seconds::double precision) instant FROM offsets)
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(instant ORDER BY instant),ARRAY[]::timestamptz[]) FROM candidates WHERE instant AT TIME ZONE _zone=_wall;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_workspace_dashboard_team_metrics(_tenant_id uuid, _window_days integer DEFAULT 30)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private', 'auth'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_actor uuid := auth.uid();
  v_scope boolean;
  v_ids uuid[];
  v_role text;
  v_asof timestamptz := statement_timestamp();
  v_since timestamptz;
  v_previous timestamptz;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF v_actor IS NULL OR _tenant_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Team access unavailable' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  IF _window_days IS NULL OR _window_days NOT BETWEEN 7 AND 180 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid dashboard window' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT role::text INTO v_role FROM public.tenant_members
    WHERE tenant_id=_tenant_id AND user_id=v_actor AND active=true;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Active membership required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  -- The existing helper is the single authority for legitimate team scope.
  SELECT team_scope_available,definition_ids INTO v_scope,v_ids
    FROM public.get_workspace_dashboard_team_scope(_tenant_id);
  IF v_scope IS DISTINCT FROM true OR v_ids IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Mapped team access required' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  -- Mirror the mapped definition/run SELECT policies once per definition,
  -- including their restrictive gate. Refuse mismatches instead of partials.
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM unnest(v_ids) AS scope_id(id)
    LEFT JOIN public.recon_definitions d ON d.id=scope_id.id AND d.tenant_id=_tenant_id
    WHERE d.id IS NULL OR d.access_mode IS DISTINCT FROM 'mapped_exact'
      OR private.recon_authoritative_access_decision(d.id,'read') IS DISTINCT FROM true
      OR private.recon_run_effective_read_allowed(d.id,_tenant_id) IS DISTINCT FROM true) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Current team read access could not be verified' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  v_since := (date_trunc('day',v_asof AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - (_window_days-1)*interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
  v_previous := v_since-_window_days*interval '1 day';

  WITH definitions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d.id,d.name,d.recon_type,d.sides FROM public.recon_definitions d
    WHERE d.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND d.id=ANY(v_ids)
  ), runs AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r.* FROM public.recon_runs r
    JOIN definitions d ON d.id=r.definition_id
    WHERE r.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND r.started_at>=v_previous AND r.started_at<=v_asof
  ), record_values AS (
    SELECT r.*,
      CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.stats->'matched_records')='number'
        THEN (r.stats->>'matched_records')::numeric END AS matched_records,
      coalesce(r.total_rows::numeric,CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(r.stats->'total_rows')='number'
        THEN (r.stats->>'total_rows')::numeric END) AS record_total
    FROM runs r
  ), records AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT r.*,coalesce(matched_records>=0 AND record_total>0 AND matched_records<=record_total
      AND matched_records<=9007199254740991 AND record_total<=9007199254740991,false) AS valid_counts
    FROM record_values r
  ), periods AS (
    SELECT (started_at>=v_since) AS current_period,count(*) AS run_count,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='failed') AS failures,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='completed') AS completed,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE status IN ('completed','failed')) AS finalized,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='completed' AND NOT valid_counts) AS missing,
      coalesce(sum(matched_records) FILTER(WHERE status='completed' AND valid_counts),0) AS matched,
      coalesce(sum(record_total) FILTER(WHERE status='completed' AND valid_counts),0) AS total,
      coalesce(sum(exception_count),0) AS exception_items
    FROM records GROUP BY (started_at>=v_since)
  ), current_totals AS (
    SELECT coalesce(p.run_count,0) AS run_count,coalesce(p.failures,0) AS failures,
      coalesce(p.completed,0) AS completed,coalesce(p.finalized,0) AS finalized,
      coalesce(p.missing,0) AS missing,coalesce(p.matched,0) AS matched,
      coalesce(p.total,0) AS total,coalesce(p.exception_items,0) AS exception_items,
      CASE WHEN p.completed>0 AND p.missing=0 AND p.total>0 THEN round(100*p.matched/p.total,1) END AS rate
    FROM (VALUES(1)) AS base(n) LEFT JOIN periods p ON p.current_period=true
  ), previous_totals AS (
    SELECT coalesce(p.run_count,0) AS run_count,
      CASE WHEN p.completed>0 AND p.missing=0 AND p.total>0 THEN round(100*p.matched/p.total,1) END AS rate
    FROM (VALUES(1)) AS base(n) LEFT JOIN periods p ON p.current_period=false
  ), days AS (
    SELECT generate_series(v_since AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', v_asof AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',interval '1 day')::date AS day
  ), daily_runs AS (
    SELECT (started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day,count(*) AS runs,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='failed') AS failed,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='completed') AS completed,
      count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='completed' AND NOT valid_counts) AS missing,
      coalesce(sum(matched_records) FILTER(WHERE status='completed' AND valid_counts),0) AS matched,
      coalesce(sum(record_total) FILTER(WHERE status='completed' AND valid_counts),0) AS total
    FROM records WHERE started_at>=v_since GROUP BY 1
  ), exceptions AS MATERIALIZED (
    -- Tenant equality on BOTH relations prevents malformed cross-tenant edges.
    -- Do not restrict runs to the chart window: old open/resolved cases count.
    SELECT e.severity,e.lifecycle_state,e.status,e.created_at,e.resolved_at,r.definition_id
    FROM definitions d JOIN public.recon_runs r ON r.definition_id=d.id AND r.tenant_id=_tenant_id
    JOIN public.recon_exceptions e ON e.run_id=r.id AND e.tenant_id=_tenant_id
  ), open_exceptions AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM exceptions WHERE status='open'
  ), opened AS (
    SELECT (created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day,count(*) AS count
    FROM exceptions WHERE created_at>=v_since AND created_at<=v_asof GROUP BY 1
  ), resolved AS (
    SELECT (resolved_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS day,count(*) AS count
    FROM exceptions WHERE resolved_at>=v_since AND resolved_at<=v_asof GROUP BY 1
  ), mttr AS (
    SELECT round(avg(extract(epoch FROM resolved_at-created_at))/3600,1) AS hours
    FROM exceptions WHERE resolved_at>=v_since AND resolved_at<=v_asof AND resolved_at>=created_at
  ), source_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT side->>'data_source_id' AS id FROM definitions d
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(d.sides)='array' THEN d.sides ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) side
  ), sources AS MATERIALIZED (
    -- Mirror the current restrictive typed-resource policy as well as membership;
    -- use only source IDs actually referenced by the authorized definitions.
    SELECT s.id,coalesce(s.source_type,'unknown') AS source_type FROM public.workspace_data_sources s
    JOIN source_ids i ON s.id::text=i.id WHERE s.tenant_id=_tenant_id
      AND private.registered_typed_resource_allows(v_actor,_tenant_id,'data_source',s.id,'view')
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'scope','team','scope_access',jsonb_build_object('my',true,'team',true,'tenant',v_role='tenant_admin'),
    'scope_empty',cardinality(v_ids)=0,
    'provenance','Current readable reconciliations mapped through your effective same-tenant BU/group assignments. Totals include all scoped rows; detail previews show the latest eight runs.',
    'window_days',_window_days,'as_of',to_char(v_asof AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"'),
    'availability',jsonb_build_object('definitions',true,'data_sources',true,'schedules',true,'tickets',false,'ai_usage',false),
    'kpis',jsonb_build_object(
      'reconciliations',jsonb_build_object('value',(SELECT count(*) FROM definitions),'delta',null),
      'match_rate',jsonb_build_object('value',ct.rate,'delta',ct.rate-pt.rate),
      'runs',jsonb_build_object('value',ct.run_count,'delta',ct.run_count-pt.run_count),
      'open_exceptions',jsonb_build_object('value',(SELECT count(*) FROM open_exceptions),'delta',0),
      'mttr_hours',jsonb_build_object('value',(SELECT hours FROM mttr),'delta',0),
      'open_tickets',jsonb_build_object('value',null,'delta',0),
      'success_rate',jsonb_build_object('value',CASE WHEN ct.finalized>0 THEN round(100.0*ct.completed/ct.finalized,1) END,'delta',CASE WHEN ct.finalized>0 THEN 0 END),
      'data_sources',jsonb_build_object('value',(SELECT count(*) FROM sources),'delta',0),
      'schedules_active',jsonb_build_object('value',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.recon_schedules s WHERE s.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND s.definition_id=ANY(v_ids) AND s.enabled),'delta',0)),
    'throughput',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date',d.day,'runs',coalesce(r.runs,0),'failed',coalesce(r.failed,0),'completed',coalesce(r.completed,0),
      'metricsComplete',coalesce(r.missing,0)=0,'matched',CASE WHEN coalesce(r.missing,0)=0 THEN coalesce(r.matched,0) END,
      'unmatched',CASE WHEN coalesce(r.missing,0)=0 THEN coalesce(r.total-r.matched,0) END,
      'rate',CASE WHEN r.completed>0 AND r.missing=0 AND r.total>0 THEN round(100*r.matched/r.total,1) END) ORDER BY d.day) FROM days d LEFT JOIN daily_runs r ON r.day=d.day),
    'exceptions_flow',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date',d.day,'opened',coalesce(o.count,0),'resolved',coalesce(r.count,0)) ORDER BY d.day) FROM days d LEFT JOIN opened o ON o.day=d.day LEFT JOIN resolved r ON r.day=d.day),
    'severity',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',v.name,'value',(SELECT count(*) FROM open_exceptions e WHERE e.severity=v.name))) FROM (VALUES('critical'),('high'),('medium'),('low')) v(name)),
    'lifecycle',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',name,'value',n) ORDER BY name) FROM (SELECT coalesce(lifecycle_state,'new') AS name,count(*) AS n FROM open_exceptions GROUP BY 1) x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'ageing',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',v.name,'value',(SELECT count(*) FROM open_exceptions e WHERE extract(epoch FROM v_asof-e.created_at)/86400>=v.lo AND (v.hi IS NULL OR extract(epoch FROM v_asof-e.created_at)/86400<v.hi)))) FROM (VALUES('<1d',-1e100::numeric,1::numeric),('1-3d',1,3),('3-7d',3,7),('7-30d',7,30),('>30d',30,null)) v(name,lo,hi)),
    'top_recons',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.open DESC,x.id) FROM (SELECT d.id,d.name,coalesce(d.recon_type,'—') AS type,count(*) AS open FROM open_exceptions e JOIN definitions d ON d.id=e.definition_id GROUP BY d.id,d.name,d.recon_type ORDER BY open DESC,d.id LIMIT 6) x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'ds_mix',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',source_type,'value',n) ORDER BY source_type) FROM (SELECT source_type,count(*) AS n FROM sources GROUP BY 1) x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'tickets_by_priority','[]'::jsonb,
    'ai',jsonb_build_object('tokens_in',0,'tokens_out',0,'cost_usd',0,'series',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('date',day,'cost',0,'tokens',0) ORDER BY day) FROM days)),
    'recent_runs',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.started_at DESC,x.id) FROM (
      SELECT r.id,r.definition_id,r.status,r.started_at,r.completed_at,r.matched_count,r.exception_count,r.total_rows,
        d.name AS recon_name,(r.status='completed' AND r.valid_counts) AS record_metrics_available,
        CASE WHEN r.status='completed' AND r.valid_counts THEN r.matched_records END AS matched_records,
        CASE WHEN r.status='completed' AND r.valid_counts THEN r.record_total END AS record_total,
        CASE WHEN r.status='completed' AND r.valid_counts THEN round(100*r.matched_records/r.record_total,1) END AS record_match_rate
      FROM records r JOIN definitions d ON d.id=r.definition_id WHERE r.started_at>=v_since ORDER BY r.started_at DESC,r.id LIMIT 8) x),'[]'::jsonb),
    'totals',jsonb_build_object('matched_records',ct.matched,'total_rows',ct.total,'completed_runs',ct.completed,'runs_missing_record_counts',ct.missing,
      'exception_items',ct.exception_items,'record_metrics_available',ct.completed>0 AND ct.missing=0,'failures',ct.failures)
  ) INTO v_result FROM current_totals ct CROSS JOIN previous_totals pt;
  RETURN v_result;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpd_original_result(_actor uuid, _file uuid, _replay boolean)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE f private.dpd_original_intents%ROWTYPE;r private.dpd_original_receipts%ROWTYPE;sc private.dpd_schema_receipts%ROWTYPE;raw private.dpd_raw_source_links%ROWTYPE;state text;parser text;
BEGIN SELECT * INTO f FROM private.dpd_original_intents WHERE id=_file;SELECT * INTO r FROM private.dpd_original_receipts WHERE file_id=f.id;SELECT * INTO sc FROM private.dpd_schema_receipts WHERE file_id=f.id;SELECT * INTO raw FROM private.dpd_raw_source_links WHERE file_id=f.id;
 state:=CASE WHEN r.file_id IS NULL THEN 'uploading' ELSE 'received' END;parser:=private.dpd_parser_state(f.id);
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('actor_id',_actor,'auth_role','authenticated','tenant_id',f.tenant_id,'setup_id',f.setup_id,'file_id',f.id,'feed_key',f.feed_key,'request_key',f.request_key,'content_sha256',f.content_sha256,'state',state,'parser_state',parser,'descriptor',f.descriptor,
 'storage_bucket',f.storage_bucket,'storage_path',f.original_path,'original_path',f.original_path,'created_by',f.created_by,'uploaded_by',f.created_by,'created_at',f.created_at,'received_at',r.received_at,'expires_at',f.expires_at,
 'verified_original_size_bytes',r.verified_size_bytes::text,'verified_original_sha256',r.verified_original_sha256,'storage_object_id',r.storage_object_id,
 'raw_row_count',sc.raw_row_count::text,'header_fields',CASE WHEN private.dpd_original_viewable(f.id) THEN sc.schema_manifest->'header_fields' ELSE NULL END,
 'sheet_inventory',CASE WHEN private.dpd_original_viewable(f.id) THEN coalesce(sc.schema_manifest->'sheet_inventory',r.sheet_inventory,'[]'::jsonb) ELSE '[]'::jsonb END,
 'retention',f.retention_policy||jsonb_build_object('expires_at',f.expires_at,'available',private.dpd_original_viewable(f.id),'legal_hold',private.dpd_original_has_hold(f.id),'tombstoned',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.dpd_original_tombstones WHERE file_id=f.id)),
 'data_source_id',raw.data_source_id,'upload_id',NULL,'request_replay',_replay,'is_new',NOT _replay,'original_reupload_required',false,'publish_allowed',false);
END $function$
