functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.recon_api_persisted_result_page(_tenant_id uuid, _run_id uuid, _page integer DEFAULT 0, _status text DEFAULT 'all'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  definition_id uuid;
  result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _tenant_id IS NULL OR _run_id IS NULL OR _page IS NULL OR _page < 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant, run and non-negative page are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF _status IS NULL OR _status NOT IN ('all','match','partial','missing','duplicate','invalid_key','other','unavailable') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsupported run result status' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  WITH exception_base AS (
    SELECT e.*,
      CASE WHEN e.payload->>'disposition' = 'keyless_input' THEN 'invalid_key'
        WHEN CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload)) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload)) > 0 ELSE false END THEN 'missing'
        WHEN e.payload->>'rule_kind' = 'unique' THEN 'duplicate'
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'key') = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'sides') = 'object' THEN 'partial'
        WHEN e.payload IS NULL OR e.payload = '{}'::jsonb THEN 'unavailable' ELSE 'other' END AS status_bucket,
      CASE WHEN CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload)) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload)) > 0 ELSE false END
          AND jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'key') = 'string'
        THEN 'missing:' || jsonb_build_array(e.payload->'key', private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload))::text
        ELSE 'exception:' || e.id::text END AS parent_key
    FROM public.recon_exceptions e WHERE e.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND e.run_id = _run_id
  ), exception_items AS (
    SELECT parent_key, status_bucket, min(created_at) AS created_at,
      jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'public_case_id',public_case_id,'side',side,'reason',reason,'status',status,
        'payload',payload,'created_at',created_at) ORDER BY created_at,id) AS items
    FROM exception_base GROUP BY parent_key,status_bucket
  ), source_rows AS (
    SELECT parent_key, side, jsonb_agg(source_row ORDER BY created_at,id,member_order) AS rows
    FROM (
      SELECT parent_key,side,payload->'row' AS source_row,created_at,id,1 AS member_order
      FROM exception_base WHERE jsonb_typeof(payload->'row') = 'object'
      UNION ALL
      SELECT e.parent_key,side_entry.key,member_rows.row_data,e.created_at,e.id,member_rows.ordinality::integer
      FROM exception_base e
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'members')='object' THEN e.payload->'members' WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'sides')='object' THEN e.payload->'sides' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) side_entry
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(side_entry.value)='array' THEN side_entry.value ELSE jsonb_build_array(side_entry.value) END
      ) WITH ORDINALITY AS member_rows(row_data,ordinality)
    ) values_by_side
    GROUP BY parent_key,side
  ), source_members AS (
    SELECT parent_key, jsonb_object_agg(side,rows) AS members
    FROM source_rows GROUP BY parent_key
  ), exception_parents AS (
    SELECT i.parent_key,i.status_bucket,i.created_at,i.items,
      COALESCE(s.members,'{}'::jsonb) AS members
    FROM exception_items i LEFT JOIN source_members s USING (parent_key)
  ), result_rows AS (
    SELECT m.created_at,'match:'||m.id::text AS result_id,'match'::text AS status_bucket,
      jsonb_build_object('kind','match','id',m.id,'created_at',m.created_at,'rule_id',m.rule_id,
        'cardinality',m.cardinality,'members',m.members,'exception_items','[]'::jsonb) AS row
    FROM public.recon_matches m WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND m.run_id=_run_id
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.created_at,p.parent_key,p.status_bucket,
      jsonb_build_object('kind','exception','id',p.parent_key,'created_at',p.created_at,
        'status_bucket',p.status_bucket,'members',p.members,'exception_items',p.items) AS row
    FROM exception_parents p
  ), filtered AS (
    SELECT * FROM result_rows WHERE _status='all' OR status_bucket=_status
  ), counts AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS parent_count FROM filtered
  ), page AS (
    SELECT row,created_at,result_id FROM filtered ORDER BY created_at,result_id OFFSET _page*50 LIMIT 50
  ), fields AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(field_name ORDER BY field_name),'[]'::jsonb) AS names
    FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT field_name FROM (
        SELECT field.key AS field_name
        FROM public.recon_matches m
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m.members)='object' THEN m.members ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) side
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(side.value)='array' THEN side.value ELSE jsonb_build_array(side.value) END) member
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(member.value)='object' THEN member.value ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) field(key)
        WHERE m.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND m.run_id=_run_id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT field.key
        FROM public.recon_exceptions e
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'row')='object' THEN e.payload->'row' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) field(key)
        WHERE e.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND e.run_id=_run_id
        UNION ALL
        SELECT field.key
        FROM public.recon_exceptions e
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'members')='object' THEN e.payload->'members' WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'sides')='object' THEN e.payload->'sides' ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) side
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(side.value)='array' THEN side.value ELSE jsonb_build_array(side.value) END) AS member_rows(row_data)
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_object_keys(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(member_rows.row_data)='object' THEN member_rows.row_data ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) field(key)
        WHERE e.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND e.run_id=_run_id
      ) all_fields
    ) distinct_fields
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('rows',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(page.row ORDER BY page.created_at,page.result_id) FROM page),'[]'::jsonb),
    'field_names',fields.names,
    'parent_count',counts.parent_count,'page',_page,'page_size',50,
    'has_next',((_page+1)*50 < counts.parent_count)) INTO result FROM counts CROSS JOIN fields;
  RETURN result;
END;
$function$

functions.name: recon_api_persisted_result_counts
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.recon_api_persisted_result_counts(_tenant_id uuid, _run_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'private'
 SET row_security TO 'on'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  definition_id uuid;
  match_groups bigint;
  exception_items bigint;
  buckets jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF _tenant_id IS NULL OR _run_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'tenant and run are required' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT count(*) INTO match_groups FROM public.recon_matches m
    WHERE m.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND m.run_id = _run_id;
  WITH categorized AS (
    SELECT CASE
      WHEN e.payload->>'disposition' = 'keyless_input' THEN 'invalid_key'
      WHEN CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload)) = 'array' THEN jsonb_array_length(private.recon_result_missing_sides(e.payload)) > 0 ELSE false END THEN 'missing'
      WHEN e.payload->>'rule_kind' = 'unique' THEN 'duplicate'
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'key') = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'sides') = 'object' THEN 'partial'
      WHEN e.payload IS NULL OR e.payload = '{}'::jsonb THEN 'unavailable'
      ELSE 'other' END AS status_bucket
    FROM public.recon_exceptions e WHERE e.tenant_id = _tenant_id AND e.run_id = _run_id
  ), totals AS (
    SELECT status_bucket,count(*) AS item_count FROM categorized GROUP BY status_bucket
  )
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM categorized), jsonb_build_object(
    'partial',COALESCE((SELECT item_count FROM totals WHERE status_bucket='partial'),0),
    'missing',COALESCE((SELECT item_count FROM totals WHERE status_bucket='missing'),0),
    'duplicate',COALESCE((SELECT item_count FROM totals WHERE status_bucket='duplicate'),0),
    'invalid_key',COALESCE((SELECT item_count FROM totals WHERE status_bucket='invalid_key'),0),
    'other',COALESCE((SELECT item_count FROM totals WHERE status_bucket='other'),0),
    'unavailable',COALESCE((SELECT item_count FROM totals WHERE status_bucket='unavailable'),0)
  ) INTO exception_items,buckets;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('run_id', _run_id, 'match_groups', match_groups,
    'exception_items', exception_items, 'exception_buckets', buckets,
    'semantics', jsonb_build_object('match','persisted recon_matches groups',
      'partial','exception items with persisted key and sides, excluding missing, duplicate and keyless markers',
      'missing','exception items with a non-empty persisted missing_sides array',
      'duplicate','exception items with persisted rule_kind unique',
      'invalid_key','exception items with persisted disposition keyless_input',
      'other','non-empty legacy payload not classified by the markers above',
      'unavailable','exception items with no usable payload', 'workflow_status_is_separate',true));
END;
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM private.dps_context_actor(_tenant_id,_setup_id,'scope.decide',_request_context_id);
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM private.dpd_preview_links l JOIN private.dps_scope_requests q ON q.configuration_id=l.configuration_id AND q.pipeline_id=l.pipeline_id AND q.tenant_id=l.tenant_id WHERE q.id=_request_id AND l.setup_id=_setup_id AND l.tenant_id=_tenant_id)
 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'dps.exact_request_setup_binding_required' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;
 RETURN private.dps_decide_scope_core(_tenant_id,_request_id,_decision,_reason);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.effective_user_permissions(_user_id uuid, _tenant_id uuid, _bu_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(permission_id text, source text, role_id uuid, group_id uuid, bu_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT rp.permission_id, 'direct'::text, g.role_id, NULL::uuid, g.scope_id
    FROM public.rbac_user_grants g
    JOIN public.rbac_role_permissions rp ON rp.role_id = g.role_id
   WHERE (
       _user_id = auth.uid()
       OR public.is_platform_admin(auth.uid()) IS TRUE
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members caller
         WHERE caller.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND caller.user_id=auth.uid()
           AND caller.active AND caller.role='tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role)
       OR auth.role()='service_role'
       OR (auth.role() IS NULL AND session_user IN ('postgres','supabase_admin'))
     ) AND g.user_id = _user_id AND g.tenant_id = _tenant_id
     AND g.revoked_at IS NULL
     AND (g.expires_at IS NULL OR g.expires_at > now())
     AND (_bu_id IS NULL OR g.scope_type <> 'business_unit' OR g.scope_id = _bu_id)
  UNION
  SELECT rp.permission_id, 'group'::text, gr.role_id, tg.id, tg.bu_id
    FROM public.tenant_group_members m
    JOIN public.tenant_groups tg          ON tg.id = m.group_id
    JOIN public.tenant_group_roles gr     ON gr.group_id = tg.id
    JOIN public.rbac_role_permissions rp  ON rp.role_id = gr.role_id
   WHERE (
       _user_id = auth.uid()
       OR public.is_platform_admin(auth.uid()) IS TRUE
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members caller
         WHERE caller.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND caller.user_id=auth.uid()
           AND caller.active AND caller.role='tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role)
       OR auth.role()='service_role'
       OR (auth.role() IS NULL AND session_user IN ('postgres','supabase_admin'))
     ) AND m.user_id = _user_id AND tg.tenant_id = _tenant_id
     AND (_bu_id IS NULL OR tg.bu_id IS NULL OR tg.bu_id = _bu_id)
  UNION
  SELECT rp.permission_id, 'bu_group'::text, gr.role_id, m.group_id, bga.bu_id
    FROM public.bu_group_assignments bga
    JOIN public.tenant_group_members m    ON m.group_id = bga.group_id
    JOIN public.tenant_group_roles gr     ON gr.group_id = bga.group_id
    JOIN public.rbac_role_permissions rp  ON rp.role_id = gr.role_id
   WHERE (
       _user_id = auth.uid()
       OR public.is_platform_admin(auth.uid()) IS TRUE
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.tenant_members caller
         WHERE caller.tenant_id=_tenant_id AND caller.user_id=auth.uid()
           AND caller.active AND caller.role='tenant_admin'::public.tenant_role)
       OR auth.role()='service_role'
       OR (auth.role() IS NULL AND session_user IN ('postgres','supabase_admin'))
     ) AND m.user_id = _user_id AND bga.tenant_id = _tenant_id
     AND (_bu_id IS NULL OR bga.bu_id = _bu_id);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.dpdi_reviewer_reference(_tenant uuid, _kind text, _request uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF _kind='setup' THEN RETURN(SELECT to_jsonb(r)||jsonb_build_object('kind','setup','status',coalesce(d.decision,'pending'),'decision',to_jsonb(d)) FROM private.dpdi_setup_review_requests r LEFT JOIN private.dpdi_setup_review_decisions d ON d.request_id=r.id WHERE r.id=_request AND r.tenant_id=_tenant);
 ELSIF _kind='publication' THEN RETURN(SELECT to_jsonb(r)||jsonb_build_object('kind','publication','status',coalesce(d.decision,'pending'),'decision',to_jsonb(d)) FROM private.dpdi_publication_requests r LEFT JOIN private.dpdi_publication_decisions d ON d.request_id=r.id WHERE r.id=_request AND r.tenant_id=_tenant);
 ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'dpdi.review_kind_required' USING ERRCODE='22023';END IF;
END $function$

CASE resource_type
    WHEN 'data_source'::text THEN (data_source_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'db_connection'::text THEN (db_connection_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'inline_api_source'::text THEN (inline_api_source_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'erp_connection'::text THEN (erp_connection_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'file_watcher'::text THEN (file_watcher_id IS NOT NULL)

    WHEN 'aidp_document'::text THEN (aidp_document_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'reference_table'::text THEN (reference_table_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'data_prep_pipeline'::text THEN (data_prep_pipeline_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'data_source_schedule'::text THEN (data_source_schedule_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'tenant_template'::text THEN (tenant_template_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'collateral_schedule'::text THEN (collateral_schedule_id IS NOT NULL)
    WHEN 'collateral_csa_agreement'::text THEN (collateral_csa_agreement_id IS NOT NULL)
    ELSE false
END))
